tei:div.tei:p: rī// 'u lhapre6rītsho 5 — — pyi //ji 2l+le dzo —— lkene ༷ ri dzo rīcedāstosna sto rīredze+er+sā / ri ne+e sngup+lukrosdetwo〉 — ste snye sdiske/tshojitshoshā/ — —me ru pyo 7 tshosdi kyi ṭ+wāṃ)ji/ga rdokyishā//ṭ+wāṃ//ri ཿ/3/ byuju 'i // /—/ ༷ py-i/ ci ’//sdu zhe4shā tsho kyi stegīkhyi / tsho ji / rdo/ /skolhasnye rdzi 4 0snye3 ṣi/sta/ shārte/ ta chi5 riberista ci /mejiji ji zhi ////snye// //༵pa/ —tsho‘7 // — /0lcakhri sdu( ci spyo/ / cho /sgyuchok+ṣe/ mirdo/rdopy-iṭ+wāṃ/snyo/ /glu tsho/rdo/nya spugli glorīlta 7meṅgārjo ci ri/tshe/ kyi/ ji ṭ+wāṃ/snye sdu rdzisnyesna / / pa ṣi // rdzosnasnye/snya/ sta///sdu/|//—3// — rici snyora'o di da rismyu / tshogs /:( tsālko 1 / zlo//riṅge/ //(/ sdo bu/go // // rkaji //tri// je / ji / tweXmi — zispro /༈ ci sti m+bisdi///// shu /// ci/ /rme1 ji kaskyi ci / dhe— / ram̐ / hūṃkhu / cho/pyi / / ’ // / //snye gyi ‘ / snyeske/5 // / /// sti/// // snye /// ྅//// / / ji h+phu 1 )1khro —ne+e/ / 7 / byuge sgo / / skyi) ji 5 r+ṣa ci /1snyetsho ske ju sto ri 5di // — ni / // ‘ // spu sko 4 ci mu / ‘ 9cerdzipyi/skyi// tsho khri / spre 4 / / skyi stso / /dzo / sto‘ nyurdowa/tsu / sna//sdu trī / /krang 4r+ṣa spre ga gnas darī sgrun khang snye/ skyirtso / //rto/ snye /snyo tre 5gu' ra— ——— —༷ji — rgo — / / snyeṅka / 1 tshotsho 4 ci mi khri — r+sha kau //sa gi

༄7/ /mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rang skyed smyug tshogs kyis brtsams/krung go'i rig gnas dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing bkram/lan gru rong zhin par khang gis dpar/deb tshad/ ho smis880྾1235 1(33 bre kha/ 7 52008lo'i zla5par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2008lo'i zla5par par thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ /—2000 yig grangs / khri151ninikho 686545—88deb rin sgor/ 10 00

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ dkar chagakhro bu/(3)sems kyi gzhis ka dang 'brel ba'i dran gzhigs skyur bo/ 7(8)rang rlom gyi mgo bo rdung ba'i tho ba/ ((14)rigs rus kyis bslangs pa'i na zug((20)rtsom sgrig pa tshos yang snying ci zhig byed kyin yod/ ((25)skya chad sngo sdug gi dus su/ ngas 'di ltar bsam gyin yod/ ((30)'dra mnyam dang bden tshig((33)de ring gi mi khyim/sgren po/(39)mi jus ring lug/sa kyi bsam blo'i dar cha/ ((55)'gyod bshags dang rgyang phud/ ((70)lo rgyus ma shes pa'i nag nyes/ ((79)rang nyid kyi tshe srog la btang ba'i nyen brda thog ma/ ((84)nang ma spro skyid khang nas khyod kyi ngo — 1 —

dkar chagagadong mthong tshul/'dren byed/(95)bdag gi snying stobs kyis bod yul skyod pa'i le'u/ ((112)dgra bo gcer bur phud pa'i mdo dang po/ ((117)'phya dmod rig gnas kyi 'ching sgrog gtor ba/ dze(123)gangs can par phul ba'i shes rab kyi dmar mchod/ ((126)lha 'dre myi gsum gyi snyan ngag((128) ‘me dang 'khyags rom’’gyi bar thag 'jal na/byams phrug(145)klog pa po'i thang gzhung nas/ snyan ngag gi rta rgyug byed/ ((157)yid sems blong blong bor byed pa'i skad cha gsum/ ((169)gcer bur bud pa'i nag nyes/ dze(184)bod kyi pe cin slob chen/zhar bkod/(206)grag 'gul med pa'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i nyen tshabs gleng ba/

—ngas rang gyid5phyi phya5slus9mtha' dag5tshad5 5mar0pazhag5ma smong5lngi/ gzhan9gyikyugardza pyas sdi ga5spyurdza5paden5par9partsi5mi5'dod// rdzas5gnas75 5lugasapadardza5drardza9padenapagyi5spyapa9phriphade5rnyed5na5pasam//khro bu/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/sems kyi gzhis ka dang 'brel ba'i dran gzhigs skyur be+e/sems pa'i ri thang na 'phyur ba'i rgya yan gyi bsam gzhigs drang mo nang du bkugs shing 'tsho ba'i gru zur na 'bur ba'i rmongs mun gyi rang gshis gyong bo dmar rjen du bshams dus/ nga'i drag tu rdol ba'i mchi ma'i bzhur rgyun gyi spobs pas hi ma la'i yang rtser ldog myong la/ thol gyis shor ba'i khrel dgod kyi rlabs’ sgras srid gsum gyi rmi lam dkrogs pa'ang de bas mang /thams cad skyo sdug gis mnaru ba'i sems pa skyur bo zhig gi 'khyug ris su 'khums pa su yis shes/ 'on kyang / nga'i sems pa'i stong glegs na lhog lhog tu gdu ba'i na zug phon po 'di/ gsang stabs kyis mi bshad thabs med byung /— 3 —

khro bu/ nga tshos rtag tu gzhan phan dang yid ches kyirme gtams pa'i glegs bam nag po re khur nas rang mal na grags 'gul ci yang med par ting 'dzin gyi sgom la mur mur bzhugs/ gzhan phan ni bdag las gzhan gces kyi bsam pa'i 'dzin stangs shig ste/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dri mas ring du bral ba'i bla med spyod bzang gi gshis su 'dod na/ nga tshos nga rgyal dang phrag dog gi ri bo rgyab la khur nas byang chub kyi lam du zhugs pa'i stong bsam ring mo zhig mtshan gung gi rmi lam du'ang yong ga la thub/ de ltar yid ches ni las don gang zhig 'grub par rlom pa'i bsam pa yin pas na/ bya ba ci bsgrubs kyang yid ches brtan mo zhig gi rmang gzhi nas 'go rtsom dgos pa bzhi/na/ de'ang 'dor rung ba zhig gtan nas min mod/ 'on kyang / nga tshos rang nyid la yid ches kyi bsam blo ye nas med par gzhan la re ltos dang yid ches kyis rgyang lta rkyang rkyang byed bzhin 'dug gson shugs dang snying stobs kyis kun nas dben pa'i 'u cag tsho/ bar snang du srur ba'i rlung rta khyu gcig gi rnam shes skyong mkhan yin nam/ gyang steng na g.yo ba'i 'jag ma kher skyes de'i rang tshugs slob mkhan yin/ 'di ltar/ ngas ngan 'dogs dang skyon mtshang tag tag gis mi'i khe dbang la dmar gsod brgyab pa min par/ gnas lugs dang drang bden gyis lab pa'i snying gtam 'dis/— 4 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho rang nyid dang bar thag nye ba'i bde skyid kyi lam bu zhig rnyed par skom pas chu 'dod kyi bsam pas smras pa'o/ /nga tsho dang rgyang thag shin tu ring ba'i bar snang na 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod dang yid du 'ong ba'i dag zhing gi gnas mchogamangon par 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdul zhing yod kyang / rang nyid dang bar thag nye sa'i ri lung thang gsum gyi skyo sdug gi mun pa ni a ma'i dpral bar chags pa'i lo ris kyi gnyer ma bzhin mthug nas mthug tu gyur dus/nga tshos rgyang ring gi mdzes sdug la yid smon dang ham sems kyi mig gis spyad pas ci la phan/ 'di ltar bsam na/ nga tshos snga mo nas rang gi rig gnas kyi nying bcud bor te/ rig gnas ni gzhung lugs kho nar bzhag cing glegs bam gyis grub pa'i rin po che'i pho brang tsam du zad pas/ mi'i bsam blo dang gtan du 'dres ma myong ba'i snang brnyan zhig tu grub par byas yod pa gzhi nas rtogs kyang / rang nyid kyi rig gnas yin pas dungs zhen bcangs chog chog red/ 'on kyang / rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad la kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur ba'i gzhan gyi rig gnas dag snyigs dor bcud len gyis nang 'dren byas nas mi rigs gzhan gyi mdun sar ngo gnongs mi dgos pa zhig byed thub pa'i spobs sems dang yid ches ni — 5 —

khro bu/rang nyid la bzhag na 'grigami bu re re'i ngos thad na me ltar 'bar ba'i bsam blo'i snying stobs kyi mtsho mo ldem ldem 'khyil zhing / 'tsho ba'i spro sdug gi dri ngad thul thul ldang na/mi tshe 'od du sgron pa'i gzhal med kyi rin thang zhig ngang gis rnyed nges/ ya chung na khrag rgyun dang mnyam du skyo da pa'i bsam blo 'di/ bang gis rgyugs pa'i rtswa thang gi cang shes bzhin ngar shugs dang spobs pas rgyang du chas na/rang nyid dang rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba rtogs pa'i dran shes lhad med cig ci'i kyang 'tshol thub nges/da lta nga'i brang gzhung na 'khyags shur shur gyis bzhur ba ni/ slog hrul nang gnyid la shor ba'i pha yul gyi spun zla tshor/ mi ring bar khrag rgyun gyi 'phar rtsa'i ldang mtshams 'jog nges par skrag pa dang / smug long na rdzi glu gyer ba'i snang skyid tsho/ mun 'thom gyis 'jigs rngam gyi g.yang la lcebs par skrag da dung lci 'dam dang kha char khrod du lus pa'i a ce tsho'i rkang lag khra/ ga snag gis zad par de bas skrag a pha dang a ma/ nga dang khyod la bde skyid kyi nyi ma sems su ma 'char na/ nga ngo ma 'khyags kiyangs pa'i rtswa thang na me tog gi phreng bas mal gdan bting yang /bdag rang nyid kyis gsos pa'i me tog rkang gcig gi dri zhim la snoms rgyur — 6 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/dga'/ gnas de ni me tog gi zhing khams yin rung / nga de'i pha rol na yod/ rang nyid dang bar thag ring ba'i mang bo zhig ngas rtag tu rang la dbang ba'i bsam blo skye ma myong / ngas rang la gces shing yid ches pa'i blo mig 'dis/ ya nga ba'i gzhan gyi skyo sdug gi lo zla mthong thengs rer/ dgod bro ba'i a ma'i gtam rgyud dran phyir zhe smreng ba'i kho tsho'i nag nyes gleng / 'di ltar/ bris na yag rgyu med kyang bshad na tshar rgyu med pa'i bsam gzhigs dag nam yang sems ngos su 'tshang kha shig shig gis 'phyur 'ong /2)07 9 11

khro bu/rang rlom gyi mgo bo rngung ba'i tho ba/da wabaden pa'i a long la brgyus pa'i snyeng gtam/'gro drug sems can ma ru sgom pa'i bla med kyi byang khog yangs shing che ba'i mtshan snyan can/ byams dang snying rje srog tu zhugs pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang gi kha las thob pa'i rang cag gangs can kha ba ri bo'i ljongs la zhib lta zhig byas tshe/ rang rlom dang nga rgyal/ phrag dog gi dong la lhung ba'i mi rigs gtum drag can zhig gi gzugs brnyan las bdag gis ci yang ma mthong 1ma yin yin mdog dang mtho snang yin snang gis khengs pa'i slob chen dag gi bsam spyod las mi rigs 'di'i mtho rim slob gso'i byang tshad dang slob sbyong gi mkha' dbugs mtshon nas 'dug de'ang / krung dbyang mi — 8 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rigs slob chen/ lho nub mi rigs slob chen/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling / bod ljongs gso rig slob gling / nub byang mi rigs slob chen sogs kyis mtshon pa'i slob gling dag na rang mi rigs kyi slob grogs mi nyung ba zhig gis ngang ngur mtsho la zhugs pa bzhin slob gnyer gyi las la 'bad ba'in yod/ yin na'ang / yid skyo ba zhig la kho tshor mi rigs dar rgud dang 'phel rgyas kyi cha la bsam blo gtong ba'i goms gshiso lobs med pa'am rang rlom gyi bsam blo che drags pa gang rung gis gtses pas/ gzhan la 'brel 'dres dang bsam blo brje res/ snyigs dor bcud len gyi gnas la do snang ci yang mi gnang bar/ rang nyid kyis‘‘bden pa'i mgo bo dgye dgye’’byas shing / gzhan gyi gzhung lugs dang lta bar kha ya mi byed pa'i chig rkyang ba'i bsam blo zhig rum nas rang gi rmi lam rang gis rmi bzhin yod/ de min bsam blo brje res cung tsam re byas tshe/ rang nyid kyi lta tshul mkhregs 'dzin byed pa dang rang la cha rgyus cung yod pa'i gzhung lugs re skabs babs kyi brjod bya dang 'brel mi chags kyang rdo chag btsan bsgrigs kyis drangs nas mkhas mdog ston spyad byed kyin yod/ spyir bgro gleng dang bsam blo brje res la dmigs yul dang kun slong nges par du yod srid la yod kyang dgos/‘‘mi sum cur bsam pa sum cu’’zhes pa ltar bsam blo'i 'khor phyogs 'dra min — 9 —

khro bu/sna tshogs shig yod na'ang khyod kyis der bsam gzhig byed dgos pa las dang len byed dgos pa'i nges pa med/ rang nyid kyi bsam blo'i stong cha skong rgyu ni dmigs yul du 'dug pa las/ bsam blo brje res dang rig gnas bgro gleng gang gis mtshon pa'i rgyun ldan gyi lab gleng ngam rtsod pa las rgyal thub pa'i nges pa med la rgyal dgos don kyang med ki phan tshun sha 'khon dang sdang sems ci yang med bzhin bsam blo tsam ma mthun pas zhe sdang 'bar dgos don ni ci yang med mod/ 'on kyang bsam blo ma mthun na gzhan der dma' 'bebs dang 'phya dmod/ mthong chung gis sdig mdzub ker nas blun gras su g.yugs pa'i rang snang mthon po re ma nabs nas yod pa ni rtsod pa'i kun slong mi gtsang ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba ma yin nam// gzhan yang pha yul dang slob gling sogs mi de'i phyogs thams cad la nyes skyon nag pos bkab ste‘‘khyod tshos ci yang shes gyin mi 'dug’’ces rang nyid tshad mar 'dzin stangs la bsam na/ 'jig rten 'dir tshad ma'i skyes bu shin tu mi nyung ba'i tshod du snang / nga'i bsam par phan tshun gyi 'brel ba nam yang 'brel ba yin/'on kyang khyod bgrod pa'i lam de nga'i lam ni gtan nas ma yin/2gangs ljongs srol rgyun rig gnas rgyun 'dzin gyi srog shing du gyur ba'i — 10 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/grwa btsun rnams la'ang‘‘rang skyon ri 'dra bo’’bzhag nas gzhan skyon 'tshol ba'i 'du shes shig chags nas 'dug kho tsho ni bdag cag gi ston pa'i rgyud 'dzin pa ste‘‘sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bsgrub/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul ba’’dag yin pas 'jig rten 'khor ba dang gyes pa'am bral ba tag tag yin la/ nyon mongs dug gsum dang yongs su bkyed pa'i bla na med pa'i dge ba'i las bya ba la brtson mkhan dag yin dgos/ 'on kyang dus rabs nyer gcig gi nyi zer mkha' nas shar ba dang mnyam du lam lugs de yongs su 'gyur song ba'am bsgyur bzhag pa ni bdag la gsal cha chen po med na'ang / gnas lugs gsar ba zhig gi bgrod lam ded nas grwa btsun tsho 'jig rten pa dang 'dres la khad kyis yod kikha nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'chad kyin yod na'ang / don du rgyu dang 'byor ba/ kha rje dbang thang la dga' ba'i 'dod ham la bltas na 'jig rten pa zhig gi bsam blo dang a na ma na red/ da dung sde kha phyogs ka'i sa rtsod chu rtsod kyi gyod 'dum 'grig dang rgan rgon kha mang tsho'i bshad yams rgyag sa gang rung na 'dur rgyug byed bzhin pa'i gzugs brnyan ngur smug can dag gis tshul khrims brjed song ngam snyam pa'i the tshom re mtshams dang mtshams su skyes yong / gzhan yang nye 'brel khyim/ tshang sogs kyi 'khor — 11 —

khro bu/ba 'dzin stangs dang tha na skam lug btsong tshad la bzhag pa'i bkod pa/rang nyid kyi khong khro ma 'joms par dmar 'dzing byed tshul bcas kyi rnam pa mthong thengs rer grwa btsun tshos sdig pa brjed song ngam snyam pa'i dogs 'dri lci mo re drud nas yong gi khong tshos bshad rgyur‘‘slob ma tsho lta log pa red’’rlabs che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che khas len gyin mi 'dug zer/ngas bltas na khyod tsho lta log pa min na nga tsho ci la yin snyam/ khyod tshos lam lugs de khas blangs shing dam bcas bzhin du de dang rgyab 'gal gyi bya spyod mang du spel na don du log lta byas pa dang gcig mtshungs su gyur ba ma yin nam/ khyod kyis rang skyon chos lugs su 'gel ba las/ dngos su ngas bshad 'dod pa ni khyod kho na yin/ ma rungs gang zag gi skyon la mdzub mo ker ba las dam chos kyis gang zag la bzos pa'i nag nyes bgrang ni min/spyir 'jig rten gnas lugs dang rgyu 'bras/ zhi bde'i lam la snyegs pa'i dus rabs 'dir/ rang mgo nang du bkugs nas mno bsam zhib mo zhig thongs dang / rang nyid dang rgyang thag ring ba'i mang mang zhig lta ci/ rang gis khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i bya las kho na tsam yang 'grub kyin e 'dug

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/‘‘nga rgyal khong khro phungs 'dre yin/ / de dag 'joms na mkhas pa'i rtagasari’su bzhed pa'i legs bshad 'di ltar na/ rang re'i gangs can pa'i khrod du ri bong gi rwa yin par sems/ de ni‘‘mgo rum la chud kyang rwa rum la mi chud’’pa'i deng skabs kyi smyug thogs pa tshos dra thog tu spel ba'i ljags rtsom dang bsam blo na 'bar ba'i gzugs med kyi me lce de dang zhe sdang gis bslangs pa'i mdog med kyi khrag rgyun de'i bzhur stangs las gsal cha dod po yod/dngos su bshad na rang nyid ni rang la ches gsal cha yod pa de yin pa'i cha nas rang nyid la phan pa'i bsam blo zhib mo zhig gtong rgyu dang shes bya phran tsam re bsdu gsog ci thub byas na rang nyid kyi rgyan du 'gyur ba las gnod skyon chen po mi 'byung bar snyam/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog zhe sdang / khong khro/ rang rlom gyis klad pa rul nas 'dug pa tshor/ sems rgya rta rnga las phra ba'i ngang tshul shar yong ba'i mod la/ mi rigs kyi las don sha dang khrag gis gsab cing / la rgya'i lding khang na lhod yangs kyis gnam 'phang gcod pa'i rgod po tshos mig zung las khrag snag gi mchod pa bshams par ci zhig khag2008 3 13

khro bu/rigs rus kyis bslangs pa'i na zugarigs mi gtso rus mi gtso bslab pa rin po che gtso ba'i sangs rgyas chos 'u gas kyi dgongs don snyegs pa'i mi rigs 'dis/ da lta rigs gtso rus gtso bslab pa mi gtso ba'i lam lugs gsar ba zhig rnyed pa'i gnas tshul la dmigs na/ ‘‘mi ni rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i thon 'bras shig yin’’zhes par yang nga tshor the tshom mi skye'am/ chos lugs rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i btsan po'i gdung rgyud dam rang cag kha ba can gyi yul mi tshos bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rkang lam las rdog pa phyir mi 'jog pa'i snang tshul 'dis/ mi grangs sa ya drug gi gsar snyeg gi bgrod lam bkag cing / re ba'i me tog gi 'dab lo phyogs bzhir gtor song / snying la gtad pa'i dug mda' nag pos rmas phog pa'i sems pa dag rang sar 'gyel song /— 14 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/1rang yul kha ba can na/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs bzhin mang ba'i sprul sku'i rigs la 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu nor gyi dngos grub mtshams ma chad par stsol gyin yod/ kho tshos mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang mthun pa'i dam chos kyi rdzongs ba ga 'dra zhig gnang yod pa su spyola'ang skog tu ma gyur ba de red/ rang cag bod pa tshang gis rgyu ma btab na 'bras bu mi smin pa'i gnas lugs bden par 'dzin na'ang / tshegs ma rig par rgyu nor thob pa'i lugs srol zhig kyang lag len du bstar 'dug na/ kha gcig nang nas lce gnyis bud pa ma yin nam/ sprul sku rnams kyi pha ma dang ming sring / nye 'khor thams cad kyang khyad 'phags shig yin rabs kyis thob thang gsar ba 'i/ga ngang ngam shugs kyis ster 'jog la/ khong tshor yang sngar med pa'i rdzig mdog cig dal gyis chags yong / sprul sku ni rtogs pa lha dang mnyam zhing /spyod pa mi dang mthun pa zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / nye 'brel dag sngon gyi mi de tsho rang yin pa las/ sngon las brgal te gsar ba gsar rkyang zhig chags thub pa'i nges pa ni gtan nas med par snyam/ sprul sku rang nyid kyang spyir btang gi mi bu zhig dang mi mtshungs par rnam dpyod kyi rig pa — 15 —

khro bu/dang sbyang stobs kyi yon tan can zhig yin na/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i sgo 'phar phye zhing bya ba legs 'grub thub par phan thogs shig yong ba las/ rang nyid blun po lug 'dra ba zhig byas te dad ldan mang tshogs kyi gong du bzhugs pa'i thob thang zhig ji ltar len phod dam snyam/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i mi rigs 'dir nus pa dang 'jon thang / phan pa dang byams brtse/snying rje sogs gang yang mi dgos par sprul sku zhes pa'i ming thob mkhan zhig yin pa'i chog 'dug rigs 'di'i rgyu 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho mo bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel red/ dad ldan mang tshogs ni khong rigs kyi dpag bsam 'khri shing red 'dug2mi rigs rang gi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs kyi 'phel rgyas la do khur gnang mkhan gyi dpon po rnams kyis mi ser gyi las dbang la sems khur dang do dam nan mo byed dgos 'dug mod/ 'on kyang mthon pos mi rig sa/ dma' mos mi go sa na/ smre sngags kyi 'o dod rdza gseng la khyab cing / sems sdug gi mig chu gtsang bor 'dres 'dug par su zhig gi zur lta tsam byas myong ngam/ dpon po ni‘‘nyams chung 'dabs nas de 16 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/skyor ni zhig dang btsan po gnya' nas gnon ni zhig yul dang tsho bar bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar du 'jug mkhan de yin/’’ 'on kyang 'u cag gi nye 'gram gyi dpon po mang bo mang bo zhig gis thob thang dang dbang cha kho na bsam nas bya ba bsgrub kyin yod pa/ rang cag gi lag mthil tu bkod pa'i ri mo bzhin shin tu mthong sla mo red/ rang gi phor ba'i ched du mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang de'i yar rgyas la kha nas brgya brgya stong stong bshad kyin yod/ de'ang ridapal 'byor dang chab srid sogs kyi phyogs nas lhag tu gzab nan gyi tshul gnang nas 'chad kyin yod/ dngos su kho tsho'i mig ni rang nyid kyi bde sdug la lta ba'i mig cig las/ bkres skom dang 'khyag ltogs kyis mnar ba'i spyi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar lta byed kyi mig yin par mi 'dug bsam blo de'ang sger gcod kyi bsam blo kho nar 'dus pas dkyil yangs pa'i bsam blo zhig gtan nas ma red snyam/ khong tsho'i bu phrug rnams slob grwa ga ge mo nas chang 'thung yag dang rdung res rgyag yag sgor mo brlags yag re byas te lo 'gor thabs kyis mthar phyin 'dzin yig rdzus ma re'am nyos ma re blangs nas rang yul du phyi rdzig rdzig dang khog stong stong gi 'byor dus/ ma mtha' yang a pha'i las khungs su len rgyu sha stag red/ las khungs phal cher rgyal khab kyi las khungs ma yin par rang sger gyi khyim gzhis yin pa bzhin las bzo ba tshang — 17 —

khro bu/ma rang gi nye 'brel tag tag yin 'dug2phyi smin nang smin gyi kha g.yang bsgrog la dga' ba'i nga'i pha gzhis kha ba can 'dir shin tu grang ngar rgod pas bla sprul rnams dang dpon po tsho'i sems 'khyags kyis 'khengs song bar la thang med ki de min na mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi don du/ 'bangs mi'i bde skyid kyi ched du sems cung tsam re mi 'gul ba'i dpe mi srid pa 'dra/ mang tshogs kyis sen mgo khrag dang sen rting snag byas pa'i 'bras bu spru 'a/ sku gang rung la yi da ches kyis gang nas byin na/ rang nyid kyi dkakrā tshegs myong ba'i 'bras bu gzhan lag tu bzhag pa ma yin nam/ 'o na rang nyid ji lta ra 'tsho/ don du dkon mchos/ la phul ba'i mchod pa yin nam/ mi sger la ster ba'ang gsal thag chod kyin mi 'dugadapre+on po sku brjid can tsho'ang de bzhin/ rang red/ khyod nyid mang tshogs kyi bde sdug la do khur byed ched du bzhag pa ma yin par/ nye 'brel tsho'i kha rgyab kyi ched du thob thang lhag ma zhig sprad pa dang mtshungs 'dug gal te las khungs su khyo/ da kyi nye du dang 'brel ba bzang bo can tag tag bzhag na khyod kyis ngo mi shes pa tshang ma gang du 'gro rgyu/ bya ba med song ba yin nam/— 18 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/'di ltar mngon za dang lkog za mnyam du gshib pa'i lam lugs 'di bdag gis ni rigs rus kyis bslangs pa'i nag nyes su bgrang bar dogs snang med/rang gis rang za ba'i spyod tshul 'dis rtag tu nga'i sems khungs su na zug brjid po re bskyal nas yong gin 'dug2007 11 19

khro bu/ rtsom sgrig pa chos yang snying ci zhig byed kyin yod/rtsom rig ni mi'i rigs kyi dga' skyo chags sdang gi gnas mal dron mo dang / spyi tshogs 'tsho bar phyir mig gi mda' mo 'phen sa'i dag gtsang gi me long zhig tu gyur 'dug pas/ gzhal med kyi rin thang ldan pa kun gyi mig mthong lag zin du gyur ba de red/lhag par nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di rtsom rig la mos shing rtsom rig la dungs pa'i bag chags shig gis smyug kha 'khyar 'khyor tsam 'gul shes pa nas rtsom rig gi gar stegs su 'bud rgyur ha cang dga'/rgyu rkyen de'i dbang gis da lta bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so na gad snyigs ba'i/na gang sar khyab pa ni dus deb dang tshags par red/de'ang rang gi dga' phyogs dang 'dun ma skyong mkhan gyi rtsom sgrig pa rnams — 20 ——

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/kyis mi yul la bzhag pa'i zas rin dang tshe srog la bkod pa'i dan rtags su 'dug kyang / byāsam blo'i 'gan 'khri las byung ba'i dri rtags mang bo zhig da dung bdag gi klad pa'i sbubs su 'gul dang 'gul bzhin 'duga'adir rtsom sgrig par dbang ba ni rang nyid kyis blangs pa'i rtsom rig gi gshin sa de yin yang / khyod kyis phyogs zhen gyis bsles pa'i zhwa mo gyon thengs rer/ bdag gis ni khyod rang dngos su ma mthong ba'i yar sngon nas khyod kyi mi gshis la sdig dmod byed kyin yod/ khyod la thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i tshul gyis gzhan pa'i brtsams chos la 'phri snon byed pa'i goms gshis ngan pa zhig lobs yod par ma zad/ gzhan gyi bsam blo la gshag bcos byed chog pa'i 'os min gyi thob thang zhig kyang rang gis rang la sprad 'dug da dung ri bong cal 'drogs kyi rnam thar bskyangs pa'am brtsams chos rol myong gi don dngos brgyud pa gang yin ni mi shes par/'di la go rgyu med ki sogs sdig dmod kyi mda' mo pha rol gyi brtsams chos la 'phangs 'phangs mthar/ don med ming gis chog pa'i lugs srol 'ig bzung nas/ rtsom pa po spyi tshogs su cung ming grags can zhig gam go myong thos myong zhig yin tshe/ rang gis brtsams chos las mtshon pa'i rtsom pa po'i sems 'dun da nga sgyu rtsal gyi yang snying til 'bru tsam yang mi rtogs bzhin du — 21 —

khro bu/deb la 'god pa dang / mi phal ba tshos rtsom yig legs po re bris nas bskur na'ang rtsom pa po cha med rgyus med cig yin tshe/ deb steng du mi 'god pa bcas gnas lugs kyis dben zhing skyug bro ba'i snang tshul 'di dag las/khyod ni rlung nang du bzhag pa'i me lce de'i rang tshugs su bdag gis snga mo nas 'bri bzhengs byas tshar song /ma gzhi rang nyid kyi sems nas rdol ba'i phugs 'dun rdog rdog de'i rtsa don snying la bcangs nas brtsams chos bdams bsgrigs byed pa'i dbang cha ni rtsom sgrig par cis kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang ngo so dang rgyu nor la 'brel ba'i khyod kyi rtsom rig gi tshad shing des mi sems sgul bar byed pa'i brtsams chos kyi brjod snying dang de mtshon thabs su bkol ba'i sgyu rtsal la bzod glags med pa'i brnyas bcos btang song ba ma yin nam/ de bas/ rtsom rig brtsams chos shig la rol myong byed skabs/ rtsom pa pos sgyu rtsal gyis bzhengs pa'i mtshon thabs dang yang snying du babs pa'i mtshon bya gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig brten gyis rtsom pa po'i sems khong la shar ba'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi rnam nga/ gsal ba'i mod la/ klos/ pa por sems kyi longs spyod cig dang bsam gzhigs kyi dri ba zhig 'don rgyu ni rtsom rig sgyu col gyi nus pa yin la/ rtsom pa po'i dmigs yul yin zhes brjod kyang chog de ltar na/— 22 —

— mtshanasmagagis bdas pa'i nga cho/brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i yang snying dang sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs sogs phyogs gang mang nas gdeng 'jog byas na 'grig pa las rang snang gang shar gyis bzhag na mi legs par snyam/gang ltar/ dus deb dang tshags par gang rung zhig gnyer ba'i dgos pa ni gsar skyes rtsom pa po mang bo zhig gi rtsom 'bri'i nus pa mthor 'degs su gtong rgyur skul 'ded byed pa dang mi bu mang bo zhig gi sems khong na rngam gyis 'phyur ba'i bsam blo gsar ba dang go thos myong gsum gyi tshor 'du lhug ger brjod pa'i sems gzhas kyi ngar kha nas/ nga tshor thun mong la dbang ba'i sems kyi lam bu phra mo zhig ci nus kyis gsar btod byed pa'i re 'dun gyi rmi lam ring mo snying du rum rgyu dang / rang gi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i lhag bsam gyi pad dkar rus su 'dzugs rgyu de los yin bsam gi sgor rdog 'ga' shas kyis rogs ram byas pa tshor mi rigs dang rig gnas la dungs zhen zab pa sogs kha yag ngo bstod kyi tshig nyog mang bo re bris shing de'i skye rabs 'khrungs stangs bshad de 'dra par re sbyar ba sogasu ṅka—trepar ngos kyi stong cha ma bzhag pa tsam las/ klog pa por mtshon na don med nyog gtam du gyur ba kho na'o/ /— 23 ——

khro bu/lhag par du sger gnyer dus deb dang tshags par sogs su gzhan la mthe bong yar ston gyis bslangs nas rtsom yig 'ga' re bsdu sgrig byas pa dag gi dpe rin gnam la shor 'dug pa bcas la zhib tu bsam na/ klog pa por 'dang ma brgyab pa'i rang skyon lhang la bud 'dugare 'dun dang phugs bsam gyi ri mo'i skya ris rgyang du bris kyang / ham sems dang stong bshad nas mgo bo 'khor te/ rtsom rig gi bla srog bor ba'i rtsom sgrig pa 'di dag gis yang snying ci zhig byed kyin yod/2007 12 15

ca mtshanasmagagisabadasapa'ingatsho/ ci skya chad sngo sdug gi dus su/ngas 'di ltar bsam gyin yod/srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rdzong mthug sa'i dgon sde'i ma lag dang rig gnas gsar ba'i myu gu 'bus brozhin pa'i slob grwa'i khor yug gang rung na/skya chad sngo sdug gi 'tsho bar shugs ring nar nar 'byin gyin 'dug 'das song lo rgyus kyi glegs bam sems nas ral zhing / 'byung 'gyur rig gsar gyi mdzes ma'i gom sgra thos dus/ nga tsho smug long khrod 'khyam pa'i 'brong bre lo de'i kha phyogs dang a na ma na red/grang zhing 'khyags pa'i dgun zla de'i pha rol na kho tshor ljang ldem ldem gyi g.yu yi mtsho mo'i dbyar gzhung zhig yod par re bas bsgug yod/ re sgug ni rngon pa stong gi mig mdun na rgyu ba'i ri spyang de'i las dbang yin par 'dod — 25 —

khro bu/la brtson len ni mig lam du snang ba'i bya dngos de'i bdag po ru sgom pas/re ba de'i ched du skyabs 'jug dang gsol 'debs kyis pha rol la re bcol rkyang rkyang byed pa las/ thob bya de'i slad du rang nyid kyis dka' sdug gi rngul chu btang na bzang bar snyam/sbra nag po'i mthu 'og nas lte khrag gi rlangs pa 'phyur zhing lci 'dam gyi 'tsho ba nas lang tsho'i gom sgra yal ba'i 'brog phrug tshor dngos gnas ngan khag dkri sa med la/ zhing tshigs na 'jor dang lcags khem thogs pa'i zhing pa pho mo rgan gzhon yang de dang gcig mtshungs yin/ 'dir kha ba'i las dbang la mdun skyod kyi gom kha sgyur mkhan ni/ shes rig yon tan gyis kun nas phyug cing go thos myong gsum gyi mdzod du gyur ba'i rang cag gangs can bod kyi shes yon pa dag yin dgos mod/ 'on kyang bdag sems na gangs 'khyags bzhin 'khengs pa'i bod pa tshang / dmigs yul ci yang med par nges med du 'khyams pa'i ston mjug gi shing lo bzhin gang sar khur gyin 'dugaspyi tshogs 'dir mkho ba ni 'jon mi dag yin pa las ma yin yin mdog dang mi shes shes mdog gis stong bshad rgyag mkhan dag gtan nas min/bdag gis da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi 'phel phyogs dang mthun pa'i nges don gyi — 26 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/mkhas pa zhig rang re'i gangs can pa'i ljongs 'dir khyon nas mi 'dug ces kha tshod bcad de smras na/ mi rigs rang gi mkhas ming 'dzin pa tshos mgrin pa dkyogs nas 'dug rgyu ni sha stag red/ 'on kyang mi rigs 'di'i mdun lam dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas de kho tsho'i khyim gzhis dang longs spyod la mtshungs rtags rgyag pa'i mkhas ming 'dzin pa tsho/ nga tsho'i bod spyi tshogs 'dir yod las yod go mi chod/ med las med go mi chod/ kho tshos ma 'ongs mdun lam dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la rang snang gang shar gyis stong lab re rgyag pa tsam las sne khrid dang mdzub ston/ dpung 'dren gyi nus pa bton pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma red/kho tshos mang bo mang bo zhig rtogs yod pa'i tshul gyis rang gi bu rgyud dag kyang mi rigs gzhan zhig tu gsab kyin yod/ rang gi byis pa tsho chung dus nas mi rigs rang gi yul srol goms gshis 'dzoms pa'i khor yug las rgyang du bskrad de/ rang skad rang yig gi ro tsam yang mi bro ba'i yul gru rer bskyal te/ gzhan gyi skad dang yi ger sbyangs pa'i mthun rkyen skrun gyin yod/'di ni rang cag bod kyi rong 'brog mang tshogs kyi mig dper rung ba'i mkhas ming 'dzin pa tsho dang dpon po tshos mi rigs 'dir bcangs pa'i brtse sems red/ kho tsho'i rigs las chad pa'i ra min lug min gyi byis pa de tsho'i sems — — 27 —

khro bu/su rang nyid ni sngon thon gyi bsam blo pa zhig tu rlom ste bod ces pa'i rjes lus kyi mi rigs shig gi rus las mched par 'argyad sems bzod glags med pa re skye bzhin yod pa'ang srid mod/ 'on kyang khyod kyis rang nyid kyi rtsa lam na rgyu ba'i zungs khrag 'di'i rin dod yal bar dor nas gzhan rjes su rnga ma g.yus tshul de mthong dus/ nga la khyod kyi 'gyod sems las lhag pa'i ldab 'gyur gyi na zug cig sems su lhung gi de dang de mtshungs kyi skya chad sngo sdug gi rmi lam ring mo dag gi 'gos nad rma 'bri rdza gsum gyis mdo dbus khams gsum gyi yul gru so sor 'khyer gyin 'dug de las ldog na/ gangs ljongs ma ma'i pang khug na krong nger 'gying ba'i gangs phrug rnal ma tshor nyin gung du babs pa'i rmi lam tsam las ma/ 'das/ rang re'i mkhas ming 'dzin pa tsho'i brtsams chos dang skad cha gang rung du/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu ni rang gi 'os 'gan yin tshul dang mi rigs 'di'i las dbang kho tsho'i lag mthil du blangs 'dug pa lta bu'i skad cha sbomyo5 po re bshad 'dug kyang / rang gi bu rgyud la mi rigs gzhan kyi skad dang yi ge kho na sbyang du bcug ste/ rang si rika gnas lag len ma byas na/ kha bshad chu yi lbu ba ru gyur song ba ma yin nam/ da dung rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas ni rgya che zhing gting zab pa rgya — 28 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho /mtsho'i 'jings ltar dpog dka' ba zhig yin pas/ 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi bang mdzod du spobs pa'i mgo bo mtho ru btegs chog chog yin rabs lab/'di 'dra'i rin po che zhig la rang nyid kyis mthong chen dang gtsigs 'dzin ma byas na/ nam zhig 'di nyid gzhan nor du gyur dus rang gi rig gnas yin par nga tshos ra sprod ci ltar byed ces bshad bzhin yod/ 'di ltar sems gso dang bstod tshig la rdzogs rgyu med kyang don gyis ci yang mi 'khyongs pa'i rang cag gi mi rigs 'di da dung rkang lam phra mo de'i steng na bong bur zhon te sos dal gyis bgrod kyin 'duganga'i bas ma par nga tshor dgos pa ni gser rdog rdog de ma yin par/gser de 'tshol ba'i thabs shes yin/ thog mar macikhas ming 'dzin pa 'di tshos rang nyid nas 'go rtsom rgyu dang / de rjes grwa ba dang slob ma sogs shes yon pa'i sde so so nas rang nyid btso sbyang gang legs byas te/ gzhi nas rang nyid kyi bu phrug dang grogs po tshor bsam blo'i khor yug yag po zhig bskrun rgyu byung na/ rang nyid mi rigs 'di'i rgyud 'dzin pa ngo ma zhig yin pa'i don sgo dang mi rigs yar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong ba'i ma mtha'i cha rkyen tsam 'grub song bar 'dod/ — 29 —

khro bu/'dra mnyam dang bden chigami zhig gnya' gnon dang btsan 'dzul gyi klong nas 'tsho mi 'dod pa kun la gcig mthun yin pa bzhin/ 'u cag gangs can bod kyi bud med tshos kyang 'dra mnyam gyi kha g.ya nga sa khyab rdo khyab kyis sgrog gin 'duganye lam bud med cig gis nga la 'di ltar lab song‘‘khyod tsho skyes pa tshos nges par du nga tsho la mthong chen dang brtsi ljorijog byed dgos/ nga tsho med na khyod tshos don bya gcig kyang 'grub mi srid’’ces gdong dmar nag tu gyur/ngas rtag tu rong 'brog sa khul gyi bud med tsho'i bde sdug la sems /khur dang skyo sems shor myong / nyes med sdug la sbyar ba'i khrel med tsho'i las la sdang sems ni de bas kyang skye myong // 'on kyang / ma yin yin khul dang mi shes shes khul/ mi nus nus khul/ ma rig rig mdog gis bud med kyi las — 30 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/dbang dang thob thang / 'dra mnyam/ sogs mang mang gleng bzhin pa tshor yid ches de 'dra skye rgyu ma byung /kho tsho'i mi rigs gzhan zhig gi rig gnas shes song ba'am gnas lugs rtogs song ba bzhin khong khro lhag ma zhig dang zhe sdang rmas ma zhig gi nang rdzong khyer nas pho mo 'dra mnyam dang bud med kyi khe dbang sogs ma/nga bo zhig gleng gin 'dugabazhud so nga ba'i pha mes yang mes kyi lo rgyus la phyir rtog byed myong ngam/shar 'dug pa'i rang nus rdog rdog la tshad 'jal byed e myong / tha na rang blo rum du nyar nas bsam gzhigs zhib mo zhig byas e yo/da/ 'gran ya rang dang 'tsham pa'i gshib bsdur ngo ma zhig gang la byed ki yod/ gnas lugs dang drang bden/ rgyu mtshan dang tshad thig med pa'i 'gran rtsod cig ji ltar byed rgyu yin/bsam bzhin du gzhan la 'gran slong ba'am/ rang gzhan thams cad sdug la sbyar ba'i bsam ngan gyi sbyor ba zhig spel bsam pa ni yin ga la srid snyam/ de ltar na/ gnas lugs dang drang bden gyis sha gseng rus rkang nas mched pa'i snying gtam shod la/ dka' tshegs 'bad 'bungs kyis bstsal ba'i rang nus ngom dang / de la grub 'bras dang rgyal kha yod la/ la — 31 —

khro bu/rgya dang 'dra mnyam yang ngang gis grub/rgyal khab gzhan zhig dang mi rigs gzhan zhig gis ci zhig byed kyin yod pa rang la 'tsham min gyi dpyod shes byed dgos pa las/ gzhan kho nar lad zlos byas na rang la bla srog dang sger tshugs med song ba ma yin nam/dngos su bshad na nga rgyal dang zhe sdang / phrag dog dang khong khro/ hol rgyug sogs kyis mtshon pa'i khyod tsho'i tshur len ni gzhan gyi rig gnas gangagi snying stobs dang nying bcud ma yin snyam/ gnas lugs dang drang bden/ nus pa la gzhi bcol ba'i rig gnas gson po zhig gi mnga' thang na/ gnyid du ma shor ba'i mi bu mang bos lag len gyi bden par bdar gyin yod/ro skogs brjid po zhig gi gzugs ris la 'khyud pa'i bod pa tshang gi bud med tsho'i sdug bsngal la ngu zhum yang nas yang du byas myong la/ skabs rer dga' skyo 'dres ma'i dgod sgra re'ang ngas mi sgrog thu med byung /'di ltar/ yo/da tshad kyi yod tshad kyis 'dra mnyam gyi lam bu brgyud nas bde skyid kyi lam chen snyegs 'dod byung / thob srid pa'i thabs lam gsar ba zhig gi 'od thigs nas thob 'dod pa thams cad 'tshol dgos/gnas lugs kyis 'tshol dgos / drang bden gyis 'tshol dgos/ nus pa yis 'tshol dgos/ — 32 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/de ring gi mi khyim/chol kha gsum du 'dus pa'i bod pa tshang gi mi khyim 'di/ ches grang ba'i mtho sgang du gzhi bcas nas da lta'i bar/ mdog gzugs gang yang med pa'i srin po zhig gis snying khrag gi drod rlabs ma yal bar 'jib nas bsdad/ rngam mthug pa'i rmi lam nas dal gyis sangs pa'i rnam dpyod pa 'ga' shas kyi spyan lam du/ snying khrag dmar bo phon gyis 'phyo thengs rer/'jigs skrag dang snying rje 'dres ma'i smre sngags ngan ngon re rgyun du bton na'ang / spyang ki'i rna bar chos bshad las ma byung /1nga tsho mi rigs shig gi mdun skyod kyi lam la rdog pa 'jog mkhan yin pa las/ mi rigs 'di'i ngo mtshar gyi ltad mor rgyang lta byed mkhan min/yang gcig bshad na mi rigs 'di'i 'khrab ston pa byed rgyu las ltad mo ba byed — 33 —

khro bu/par mi spro ba'i mi bu snying stobs can dang dpyod shes pa dag gis mig mthong lag zin tu gyur ba'i skyon la mdzub mo gyer nas rnag thog khab gtsag byed bzhin yod/2‘‘rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems’’pa dag gis/ dus kyi 'gyur ldog la 'grogs pa'i bsam blo pa tshor ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis nyes rdung yang nas yang du gtong gi 'dug kho tsho'i bsam par rang cag gi nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs lta ci tha na der zhugs tshad bla sprul dang grwa btsun thams cad la thun min gyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs yod shag gi yid ches shig sha gting rus gseng la khyab 'dug pa ma zad/ khong tshor dmigs gsal khyad par can mang po sems nas byin yod/ 2phyogs gang la'ang ma lhung ba'i dbu ma ba tshos/ sems su bsam 'char ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa re spungs nas/ phyogs so sor yar lta mar lta mang du byas kyang / ngag nas mi smra zhing yig thog tu mi phab par/— 31 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rang sems su smin zhing rang sems su rul du 'jug gin yod/4nye sngon dus deb dang tshags par/ dra tshigs sogs gang mang du rang lta mchog 'dzin mkhan dang / bsam blo gu dog pa/ mi rigs kyi mdun lam la mno bsam mi gtong mkhan/ ri bong cal 'drogs kyi rjes su 'gro ba/dungs zhen dang phyogs ris sogs kyis bslus pa'i mi bu mang po zhig zhe sdang dang nga rgyal/ phrag dog sogs kyi rta la bcibs nas khrag rnag gi mchod pa sems nang du bshams pa'i dmar 'dzing byed kyin pa kun gyis shes gsal red/ gzhan yang spro tshogs dang ston mo/ tshogs 'du sogs dang / tha na grogs po 'ga' re mnyam du 'dzoms pa bcas kyi bya 'gul sna tshogs su'ang /‘‘khyod kyi pha yul nga yi pha yul/ yang na khyod kyi slob grwa nga yi slob grwa’’zhes zhe sdang dang dungs zhen zhig gis 'chad pa las/ gnas lugs kyi ngos nas brdar sha gcod kyin mi 'dug rang gis bsam blo yongs su 'grig pa'i rang snang rgya yan ma zhig dang rang gis khas len na thams cad kyis bkur dgos pa'i sems gshis mkhregs po dag g.yag rwa sgye nang du bcug pa dang mtshungs par 'dug

khro bu/5 'u cag gis sa khul so so'i la rgya bzung nas phan tshun la mgo mi sgur ba'i rang gshis 'di mes po gong ma rim byon gyis grub mtha' brtsad nas khrag gi 'khor lo bskor ba la mig dper bltas pa yin na thang mod/ 'on kyang gzhan gyis thabs brgya jus stong gis bslu brid byed bzhin pa 'u cag gis tshor gyin mi 'dug kha dpe la‘‘kha ro la 'khor nas zug rgyu bskyur nas/ /kha thang la 'khor nas zug gin 'dug’’ces pa las ma 'das/ mkhas pa che ge mo zhig gi gsung bshad dang gsung rtsom gang la myong rol byed skabs/ gnas lu gas yod med dang rang nyid la 'tsham min/ bden pas ngos len mi byed par// yul phyogs gang nas yin pa dang de su'i rjes 'brangs yin pa sogs don med kyi bya las mang po zhig rtsad gcod byed kyin 'dug shes bya ni rdul gyi zegs ma bzhin chung bsdu nyung bsdu byed pa las/ thengs gcig la rdog rdog chen po zhig thob mi srid/ de bzhin phyogs ris dang dungs 'e/na ring du spangs nas blang dor gyi blo mig ches cher bgrad de chol kha gsum gyi khyim gzhis 'dir bsam blo btang na shin tu legs par snyam/ nga tsho gnyid ma sad kyis 'di ltar mdun du skyod na/ gangs ri nyi mas zhi nyen dang sbra nag rlung gis khur nyen shin tu che bar 'dug— 36 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/mi jus ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i dar cha/rang nyid 'tsho gzhes kyi pha sa gor mo 'di'i pha rol ma mthong bar khron pa'i sbal ba yi rang rnam bskyangs/ mi lo stong phrag gi lo rgyus/ bstod glu dang lha mchod rkyang rkyang gis bris pa'i kha ba can/ yig drug bzlas brjod kyi dbyangs rtas skyabs bcol dang re zhu sbrum bzhin/ yod tshad gnam la rag las nges snyam pa'i sgyu 'phrul de'i bslu brid kyis/ bod mi tshos lha la bkur nas rang nyid bor/ mi'i 'tsho gnas byed stangs dang ldog par grub pa'i gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi rig gnas gang snying bor bdams/ mi rigs 'dis gna' nas da lta'i bar/ 'jig rten ni 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid can zhig dang / 'gro ba mi'i rig gnas kyang 'gyur ba'i ngo bo can yin zhes pa'i gnas lugs 'di dang / 'jig rten na tshad ma'i bstan bcos med la/tshad ma'i skyes bu yang med ces pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i skad cha 'di ma tshor — 39 —

sgren po/bas/ kho tshos rang nyid dad mos bya yul gyi ston pa kho na ni gnas lugs mthar thug dang / bden pa mthar thug la sgom/ gna' bo'i shes rmongs kyi grog rong la rgol mkhan zhig dang / shes yon rgan po tsho'i bsam blo'i bka' rgya las 'da' 'dod pa'i gsar gtod can tshor/ lo rgyus steng nag nyes kyi zhwa mo chen po re bskon yod na'ang / bsam blo'i dar cha dgung du 'phyar myong ba'i kho tsho/ lo rgyus kyi dkyog mtshams re na dar cha yi tshul gyis nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i sems khong na lhab lhub kyis g.yo bzhin 'dugazhogs dung /spyi lo nyis stong gnyis lor/ tag tag lo de red/ lo der〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉ces pa'i dpe cha 'dis ches thog mar dogs slong dang mi bu zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di gnyis khyer nas/ ri bo gangs can pa'i sgal tshigs brdungs te/ lo rgyus kyi bgrod lam ga'an zhig la spar 'ju byed rgyur spobs pas chas yong / de ni yun ring zhig la grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i bod kyi shes yon pa'i sde la rbab chu gsar ba zhig gi ru 'dren pa sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyi bsam blo'i thon rdzas red/ de ni mi rigs zhes ja kha chang kha nas ma gleng bar lag len gyi nye sa nas sad pa'i 'bras bu red/ 〈dpyod — 40 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/shes rgyang 'bod〉ces pa'i dpe cha chung chung des bod yul khri skor bcu gsum yom yom du 'dar bar byas byung / de ni da gzod bsam blo yi stobs shugs red/ bsam blo yi byed nus red/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉mi yul du btsas pa des/ dus yun ring bor bod mi'i 'du shes kyi gting rim na gab cing nyar ba'i mang po mang po zhig la tsha 'dri byas/ de nas bzung bod mi tshos rang gi klad pa bkol nas srol rgyun rig gnas la phyir rtog dang dogs slong byed pa'i 'go brtsams mthar/ bod kyi shes yon pa'i sde ru bsam blo gsar rnying gnyis brjod byar byas pa'i rig gnas dgag bzhag gi tsha rlabs shig ngang ngam shugs kyis mched byung / deng rabs rig gnas kyis gsal 'debs dang phyir rtog bya thabs bral ba'i bod kyi rig gnas dgag bzhag gi khor yug nas/ zhogs dung zhes pa'i mi bu 'di gleng gzhi gtso bo zhig tu gyur ba dang dus mnyam du/ bod mi so sos zhogs dung la gdeng 'jog yang byed bzhin 'dug la las zhogs dung zhes pa'i mi 'di lta log pa zhig la las kho smyon pa zhig gam gsang myul ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyin yod mod/ de ni skrag dgos pa zhig ma red/ lta log pa dang smyon pa/ gsang myul ba zhes nga4'i zhwa mo 'di thog ma nas bod kyi shes yon pa'i sde ru thon myong med pa zhig min/ mkhas dbang dge chos 'dzam gling la 'khyams myul byas rjes/ phyir — 41 —

sgrenapo/ da bod la yong dus khong gi dgongs pa dang sngar yod bod spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo'i bar gyi 'gal ba dang / don grub rgyal gyis〈sprul sku〉brtsams rjes kyi 'gal 'du bcas kyi dbang gis/ gong gi rnam pa 'di gnyis la yang lta log pa dang / smyon pa zhes pa'i ming de thogs yo da/ bod mi tshor spyi khyab rang bzhin gyi gnad don zhig yod pa ni/ rang sa rang yul gyi mir mthong chen mi byed par/ phyi mi la mthong chen byed pa'i srol ngan zhig gna' nas da lta'i bar du gnas/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / jo bo rje a ti sha/ lha sa'i jo bo/ de dang des mtshon pa'i dpe mang po zhig gis bod mi'i gshis la/ mtshon thub/ bod mi'i cal 'drogs kyi gshis ka dang / rtsing rags kyi cha/rang tshugs med pa'i mi gzhi mthong 'ong / mi zhig gi mi tshe hri'/ bo'i 'phel rgyas ni mi de 'tsho sdod bya sa'i khor yug dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ khor yug ni mi bu gang nyid kyis rang rtsal ngom sa'i stegs bu yin pas na/ mi dang 'tsho sdod bya sa'i khor yug gi bar na gcig la gcig rten/ gcig gis gcig la shugs rkyen gtong bzhin yod/ 'gro ba mi'i shes rig 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus khrod/ mi bu de'i bsam blo dang gang nyid 'tshar longs byung sa'i khor yug gi mi'i bsam blo'i go rtogs gnyis 'cham mthun byung min gyi dbang gis/ skyes chen grangs med kyi rnam dpyod dang lhag bas ma gtsang ma thal — 42 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho dong du 'phangs myong la/ tha na skyes chen 'di tsho lnga lam du brdzangs myong ba'i lo rgyus kyi skyo gar yang mang du mchis/bod mi la shas kyis zhogs dung gis srol rgyun rig gnas mi dgos zer go gi nang sgos su nang bstan chos lugs mi dgos zer go gi zhes ma nyes kha g.yog byed mi yang yod mod/ ngas ni skad cha 'di rigs bshad mkhan tshor khyod kyis〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉la e bltas/ bltas dang na ha go gi e 'dug da dung dungs zhen dang phyogs su ma chad par zhib lta zhig byos dang zhes lan stabs bde re btab pa yin/ ngas〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉bklags pa dang 'brel nas zhogs dung gleng na/ khos sro la rgyun rig gnas mi mkho tshul bshad med ki lhag par nang bstan chos lugs rtsa ba nas mi dgos pa'i bzhed pa yang bzung med ki 'dod/spyir da lta'i rig gnas dgag bzhag 'di/ nang don gnyis kyi khongs su bsdus chog ste/ gcig ni srol rgyun rig gnas 'di'i rtsa ba'i ngo bo'am bden dngos rang bzhin gyi cha dang / gnyis ni srol rgyun rig gnas 'di'i don snying ngam dge phan('tsho gnas)gyi cha red/ ngas bltas na zhogs dung gis nang bsta na chos lugs kyi ngo bo ni rlabs chen zhig dang dwangs gtsang zhig yin pa khas blangs yod/ khos bod kyi rig gnas bar snang nas bsdad de/— 43 —

sgren po/mi'i 'tsho gnas dang bar thag gis bcad yod pa'i ngos thad nas/ 〈〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉brtsams grub byas par 'dod/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉rtsom pa'i dgos pa yang ngas bltas na kho rang 'tsho gnas kyi ngos thad nas 'greng ste/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyis da lta'i bod mi'i 'tsho gnas dgos mkho skong thub kyin med pa'i gnad 'di bzung nas bris 'dug/ mi ni rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu yin na// mi rigs shig — 'phel rgyas 'gro min ni mi bu rang mtshan pa re rer rag las yod la/ mdor bsdus na mi rigs shig rjes lus kyi mun dong na 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i gnad 'di nas/ nga tshos rang gi rig gnas 'di la deng rabs rig gnas kyis phyir rtog bya rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur yod pa rtogs dgos/ rig gnas/ de rang nyid 'tsho ba'i lag cha ru yang ma nyan na/ de lta bu'i rig gnas ni bla srog med pa'i bem ro las ci/ spyir na brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byas par skad cha bshad pa'i dbang cha med mod/ nga rang zhogs dung zhes pa'i mi bu 'di'i steng na yid smon 'chor sa zhig yod pa ni/ snga ma'i bod kyi srol rgyun mkhas pa dag dang mi mtshungs par/ dran 'char gsong bor brjod nus pa'i snying stobs de red/ zhogs dung gi lta ba 'di lta bu bod kyi shes yon pa tshor ma skyes ni e red/ srol rgyun mkhas chen tshos ma mkhyen ni — 44 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/tsho /me red/ ngas bsam na kho tshor yang skyes yod srid/ rgyu mtshan kho tsho yang 'tsho ba 'di/'i 'og gi mi yin pas yin/ 'o na bod kyi nang bstan smra ba tshos ci'i phyir khog tu mid pa yin nam zer na/ ngas ni srol rgyun gyi mkhas chen tshos rang nyid kyi phor ba shor bar skrag nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs bzung bar 'dod/ zhogs dung gis ci'i phyir‘‘blun po rngapage rngo/na tan kha ru 'byin/ /mkhas pas yon tan khog tu sbed’’ces pa'i legs bshad khrod kyi blun po'i lam 'di bdams pa red/ de yang khos rang nyid kyi 'tsho gnas phal bar klo bzhag ste/ kho dang 'u tsho the ba'i tshogs pa zhig gi bde sdug la/ sems pa glan pa'i stabs kyis red/ gal te 'jig rten 'dir mu ge byung nas mi rnams ltos/sa skom gyis mnar na yang / rlabs chen gyi bsam blo pas da dung yang 'gro ba mi'i mthar thug gi bden pa la mno bsam gtong nges zhes pa bzhin/zhogre/sa dung gis srol rgyun gyi lcags ris kun nas bsdams pa'i khor yug 'di nas/ dge chos dang rang grol gyis mtshon pa'i ya nga ba'i skyo gar shes bzhin du ci'i phyir kha rog se/ra ma bsdad pa yin nam/ gang ltar〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉kyis mi gzhi dang rang tshugs yod pa'i mi rabs gsar ba zhig byung rgyur rgyang 'bod bya bzhin yod la/ zhogs dung zhes pa'i mi 'dis dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i ri kha ba can gyi bsam blo'i dar cha de yar sgreng byung /— 45 —

sgren po/bdud lha rgyal/bod rtsom gsar ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi lam bu de'i steng na brjid kyis khyogs pa ni bdud lha rgyal red/bdud lha rgyal zhes pa'i mi 'di da lta'i bod spyi tshogs kyi gru ga so so dang /khyad par du nga tsho'i rtsom stegs steng na gleng gzhi gtso bo zhig tu gyur 'dugang tsho bod kyi kha dper/ mir skyes pa la ming zhig dang / 'chi ba la don 'ig zhes pa bzhin/ mi zhig gi ming de spyi tshogs kyi khongs mi so sos do snang zo li ra 'ib/ tu gyur yod dus/ mi de spyir btang ba 'ig min pa nga tshos shes rkas (ri / red/ nub phyogs kyi gre/na/ma sa'i mtshams nas khyed kyi zla ba 'tsher/bdag yid kyi skar tshom de'ang ngang gis mog por gyur zhes pa'i mtshon don ba'in/ mi rigs kyi nyen tshabs rang bzhin la thabs shes shig 'tshol bar brel ba'i khos/ bsam gre/zhig gi mgo bo khrag la bsgres te/ sang nyin gyi ston ljongs de'i ched du/ kheng rkyang gi/ gzugs kyis dpa' bo'i phyag rgya bskrun thub pa'i yid ches kyis/ rang nyid kyi kher snyesmum nge'i steng na nam nga/nga spo bas pa'i mgo bo dgye dgye byas te/ mdun phyogs su chas bzhin 'dug〈〈snyan ngag gsar rnying gnyis kyi thog ma'i gshib bsdur〉dang〈〈bod rtsom gsar — 46 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ba'i brtsams chos bdams bkod dang de dag gi bshad pa〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos 'di gnyis kyis/ snyan tshig dang tshig rgyan kho na'i bdag nyid kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag redi la dogs slong byas byung / 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel ba'i lo rgyus steng thog dang por srol rgyun snyan ngag 'di'i dge skyon gyi cha la gdeng 'jog byed phod pa'i mi red/ bdud lha rgyal gyis mi lo mang bor tshig rgyan rkyang rkyang snyan ngag tu rlom zhing / snyan ngag ces pa rna bar snyan zhing yid du 'ongs pa'i ngag gi sbyo ra ba tsam ma gtogs nges shes ma rnyed pa'i lo rgyus de mjug sgril bar byas/ rang grol gyi8〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉yi/sa ma/tshon pa'i rang mos snyan ngag dang / lha rgyal tshe ring gi〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉gnyes kyis mtshon pa'i tshigs bcad snyan ngag bcas kyi spyi ming la bod rtsom gsar ba zhes btags/ bod rtsom gsar ba byung ba ni bod mi 'i snyan ngag tu 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun snyan ngag gam tshig rgyan de snyan ngag tu gyur ba'i go rim dang / snyan ngagre/ gi kha gtod yul de phyi don rkyang ba nas nang sems kyi yid 'gyur la phyogs pa'am/ 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi rjes su 'brangs par byas pa'i go rim zhig red/ dus yun ring bo ma 'gor ba'i bod rtsom gsar ba 'di/ pha ma bra'/ ba'i byis pa bzhin kha phyogs med par bgrod lam gang zhig bsnyeg par mgo 'thom pa'i skabs su/ bdung/ lha rgyal zhes pa'i mi — 47 —

sgren po/'di tho rengs skar chen gyi tshul gyis phyogs ston 'khor lo'i tshul gyis nga tsho'i rtsom stegs su mngon byung / 'di ni rang nyid kyi las dbang rang gi lag mthil na yod par rlom pa'i bod mi zhig gi rin thang red/ kho bo nga tsho'i rtsom 'byung lo rgyus kyi dkyog mtshams na rdo ring bzhin 'greng 'dug de bas ngas bdud lha rgyal la bod rtsom gsar ba'i rin thang la yang lci 'jal mkhan zhes bshad ni yin/mang mang zhig gis bdud lha rgyal la rtsom rig dpyad brjod kho na yi ngos thad nas gdeng 'jog bya bzhin 'dug spyir nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma tsho'i bsam blo'i stobs shugs de yang / kho'i〈bod rtsom gsar ba'i brtsams chos bdams bkod dang de dag gi bshad pa〉zhes pa ljodi slob phri/ da byas pa las byung bar 'dod ki dpe cha 'dis mi lo nyi shu rtsa grangs la nye ba'i bod rtsom gsar ba (radi'i rin thang sngog 'don gyi stong cha bskangs par ma zad/ khos 'debs bzhin pa'i mi jus ring lugs kyi bsarma/ blo'i sa bon yang / 〈〈bod rtsom gsar ba〉zhes pa'i khrid gzhi'i rgyun dang 'grogs te/nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi bsam blo'i gshin sa 'di'i steng na myu gu ljoribus ba'en 'dug khos kher tshugs kyi mi gzhi mnga' ba'i mi re re yar slong bar 'bad kyin 'dug nub byang mi rigs slob chen la bsam blo rang dbang — 48 ge

maston spag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/dang / smra brjod rang dbang gi khor yug cig chags yod pa de'i rkyen gcig ni/ slob che na 'di'i khrid stegs kyi steng na/ bdud lha rgyal yod pas red/rlabs chen gyi dge rgan gyis slob khrid gcig byas na yang / de'i mjug 'bras ni slob ma so sor bsam gzhig gi dri rtags chen po re ster nges pa de red/ dngos gnas bdud lha rgyal gyi slob khrid ni de 'dra red/ dge rgan ni 'gro ba mi'i rnam shes kyi btso sbyangs pa yin par ma zad/ slob ma'i khams dang mos pa/ rang dbang bcas la brtsi mthong bya shes mkhan zhig yin dgos mod/ da lta'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo'i khrid stegs steng na byang tshad der slebs pa'i dge rgan ga tshod yod/ bdud lha rgyal ni da lta'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i dge rgan phal/ mo che dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba zhig red/ nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma brgya cha'i brgya yis mgrin gcig tu bdud lha rgyal la bstod pa'i mthe bong sgreng bzhin 'dug zur 'di nas nga tshos bdud lha rgyal gyi kher tshugs kyi bsam blo dang / thun min gyi mi gshis rnyed thub/bdud lha rgyal ni srol rgyun rig gnas ya mtshan yin rabs lab pa'i dge rgan klad rnying ba'i tsho cikhag dang —gtan nas mi 'dra la/ nang bstan chos lugs tshan rig dang mthun thabs smra ba'i dbu ma ba'am(dbus lam na gnas pa)yang ma yin/ kho rang mtha' gcig tu 'tsho gnas dang lo rgyus 'phel phyogs kyi — 49 —

sgren po/ngos thad nas 'greng ste/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dge skyon gleng mkhan dang /mi jus ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i rgyal mtshan mtho ru sgreng mkhan/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bsam blo gsar ba yi dar cha 'phyar mkhan red/gang ltar bdud lha rgyal zhes pa'i mi 'di gleng thengs rer/ ngas bod mi re re rang ngos nas yar langs dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin rtogs kings dge rgan ngo ma zhig gi bsam blo las byung ba'i stobs shugs de tshor gi〈shar dung ni〉nyen kha ni mi sger dang mi rigs/ rgyal khab gang dang gang la yāng dus min du 'phrad srid pa zhig red/ yin na'ang gal che ba ni nyen kha'i mdun du bsam sbyor gtong stangs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis khyod la shi gson gyi lam yang mi 'dra ba 'byung nges zhes pa'i skad cha 'dis thog drangs te/ da lta'i skya zad sngo sdub/ gi 'tsho gnas 'og mi rigs shig gi mdun lam dang las dbang ni mi rang nyid kyi steng du 'bab dgos pa'i gnas lugs kyi dar cha thogaṅge shing /mi bu'i rtsis thang thob par brtson len byed pa'i bsam blo khyu gcig 'phag 'tshag gis dogs slong dang / dgag sgrub lte bar bzung nas/ yod tshad la bskyar du tshad 'jal dgos pa kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur bar shi 'tham ro — 50 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/'tham byed bzhin pa'i sgal tshigs can gyi mi rabs gsar ba zhig 'tshar longs 'byung gin 'dug kho tsho ni〈shar dung ri〉ste/ dngos yod dang 'tsho gnas la gzhol ba'i dus deb 'dis gso skyong byas pa'i mi sna red/ kho tsho ni rang nyid kyi brtsams chos la gzhog gtub dang gshags bcos byas mi chog ces bka' lung bsgrags mkhan gyi rang mtho'i bsam blo yod mkhan tag tag red/ 〈shar dung ris〉'di ltar kher tshugs kyi rang gshis dang kher tshugs kyi bsam blo'i lam bu bdams pa nas/ 〈shar dung ri〉song sa bsdad sa na/spyi tshogs 'di lhing 'jags min pa zhig tu bzo bzhin 'dugade yang gtso bo dus deb 'di la deng rabs slob chen pa'i khyad chos te/slob chen pa ni spyi tshogs kyi sne khrid pa yin par nges shes rnyed yod pas red/(〈〈shar dung ri〉zhes pa'i dus deb 'di ni slob chen slob ma 'gas ma dngul bsdu sgrig gis phul ba zhig yin pa'i ngos thad nas bshad pa yin)de bas nges〈shar dung ri〉'di nyid rgya'i lnga bzhi'i dus skabs kyi〈na gzhon gsar ba'i〉rin thang dang mtshung rtags brgyab ni yin/〈shar dung ri〉ni khangs skya bzhin nyil gyin pa'i bod kyi gzhung sger dus deb dngagatan nas mi 'dra ba zhig red/ de yang gtso bo〈shar dung ri〉mi'i steng du babs yod pas yin/ 'jig rten pas ma gtogs mi rigs skyob mi — 51 —

— rjeskyezud21/thub pa'i gnad shes yod pas yin/ spyir da lta'i dus 'dir ser gzugs 'dzin pa mang shas kyis mi rigs 'di'i gnad don bshad khul byed kyin yod na'ang / ngas ni ser gzugs 'dzin pa tshor khyod tshos snyan ngag 'bri mi shes la/ spyi tshogs rig pa yang gleng mi shes/ 'tsho gnas de bas kyang gleng mi shes/ rgyu mtshan khyod tsho'i las ka 'di ma red/ ma yin bzhin du dang len bya rgyu yin zer na/ khyod tshos bro 'khrab rgyu yin zhes bshad pa dang 'dra/yang gcig bshad na khyod tshor spyi tshogs rig pa'i skor gyi shes bya med pas so/nye char ngur smrig pa'i sde nas thon pa'i dus deb〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉zhes pa zhig phud 'dug la/ de yang gtso bo ched du slob chen pa'i rang dbang gi smra brjod dang rang dbang gi bsam blo'i gshin sa〈〈shar dung ri〉la kha gtad kyis phud pa zhig red/ rig gnas dgag bzhag gi ngos thad nas brjod na/me dang chu 'phrad pa lta bu'i rig gnas dgag ba'ag gi rnam pa ni mkho nges mod/ kun/ slong ma dag pa dang / phyogs zhen dang 'then 'khyer rkyang ba'i dbang du gyur na/ rig gnas dgag bzhag spro sa'i dkyel yangs kyi khor yug 'di dmod bor sa zhig dang / smyon pa'i lab brdol rgyag sa/ kha rtsod dang mtshang 'bru byed sa zhig tu mi 'gyur nges pa ci/ dper na nye lam bar snang na sgyu 'phrul gyi pho brang bzhengs par brel ba'i skyabs chen gyis da lta'i bod — 52 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tso/kyi bsam blo ba zhogs dung dang rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa chen mo dge rgan bdud lha rgyal gnyis la mtshang 'bru byas yod pa lta bu/ spyir gnas lugs kyi ngos thad nas bden pa brdar na de ni legs pa'i gnas shig tu 'dod mod/ci 'di ltar dor zhi dang ldong yon tan/ skyabs chen gsum ga'i byed phyogs ltar kha mtshang ngo mtshang brus na/ nga tshos rig gnas dgag bzhag spel ba'i rnam pa ni/ lo lnga drug tsam gyi byis pa snabs lug gnyis kyis kha rtsod byed bzhin pa'i bzo lta las ci yang med/ 'dir gleng byar gyur ba zhig ni〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉zhes pa'i dus deb de red/ 〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉gis mtshon pa'i dus deb re 'ga' yis sems khur lhag ma byed kyin 'dug rgyu mtshan/ khyod tshos chos lugs dang spyi tshogs rig pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba gsal bo zhig ma rtogs pas lan pa red snyam/spyir chos lugs zhes pa mdor bsdus na mi'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig gam sems khams kyi dgos mkho zhig yin pas/ der lo rgyus kyi rkyen nam spyi tshogs khor yu ga gi 'gyur ba dang bstun nas rim 'gyur bya rgyu ni spyi tshogs kyis chos lugs la bton pa'i re ba red/ de'i dbang gis nga tsho'i chos lugs 'di la'ang gtor bshig gam gsar gtod dang basmur bcos gtong rgyu ni mig mthong lag zin gyi kha sang de ring gi spyi tshogs 'dis ra sprod — 53 —

sgren po/byas 'dug/ khyod tshos srol rgyun rig gnas kyi srog shing thub bstan rig gnas nyid bden pa mthar thug tu bzung ste/ gzhan gyi lta tshul phra mo tsam yang dgag nas de nyid bsrung bar sha thang du 'bad kyang / shes rig gtor bshig gi las 'gul 'di dang / srol rgyun rig gnas la dgag bzhag spro ba'i tshul 'di/ nyi shar spar mos 'gog 'dod kyi dpe bzhin khyod tshos bkag kyang mi khog rgyu mtshan 'di yang lo rgyus 'phel phyogs kyi chos nyid kyis gtan 'khel byas yod pas yin/ 〈rtsod pa'i rlabag phreng〉'di'i ldog phyogs nas bltas na/ nga tshos〈shar dung ri〉yi rin thang shes kispyi lo nyis stong drug lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga la/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ri 'gyod bshags dang rgyang phud/nyi ma dang bar thag nye sa'i sa sgang 'di'i ches mtho sa na/ 'gro drug sems can ma ru sgom pa'i byams snying rje yi bdag nyid du gyur ba'i mi rigs shig mi lo stong phrag gi lo rgyus skrun zhor 'tsho gzhes gnang bzhin yod cing /mi rigs de'i ming la bod zer/ mi rigs 'di'i sems kyi khong gseng na 'gro mi gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad nor zhig yod pa ni‘‘dad pa dang dag snang’’red/ khyad nor de'i stobs nus kyis mi rabs mang por bod pa tshang /kho tsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas te/ bod brgyud nang bstan rgya cher spel mkhan gyi chos byed mi sna tsho'i bran g.yog bya dgos byung / don gyi gnad 'di ni rig gnas dang bran g.yog gi gnad don red la/ lha chos dang mi chos kyi gnad don red/ dad pa dang gnas lugs kyi bar thag red/ — 55 —

sgren po/nga tshor 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyis ra sprod byas yod pa ni/ mi rigs 'di chos lugs rig gnas kyi mkha' dbugs stug po de'i khor yug gi 'og nas lag chags pa yin pas/ bod mi re re'i 'du shes kyi gting rim na‘‘sprul sku’’zhes pa'i rngam brjid kyi tha snyad gcig lcags la btsa' chags pa bzhin kho tsho'i klad pa'i nang du mi lo stong phrag mang por nyar tshags byas dang byed bzhin 'dug der ma zad tha snyad 'di la‘‘mngon mkhyen’’dang‘‘rtogs pasna’zhes pa'i khyad chos chen po re btags pa nas/ bod mi sa ya drug si/ las dbang dang nyams rgud ni khong rnam pa'i kha nang gi tshig gcig gis kyang sgyur nus kyin yod na/ mi'i rang dbang dang thob thang la rdog brdzis btang ba'i bsam blo sger gcod kyi bya spyod spel mkhan 'di dag nga tshos snang med du 'jog rung ngam/ nub gling gi mtshan nyid rig pa ba phi la tho yis bran khol de bran khol yin don ni/ kho'i bya spyod de nyid rang gi bsam blo'i tshab ma yin par gzhan gyi bsam blo'i tshab yin pas so zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gnas lugs kyi mdun nas nga tsho 'gro ba mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yen dgos/ gnas lu gas la mgo mi sgur mkhan yod mi srid mod/ rang re'i mi rigs 'di de lta bu zhig e red/ sprul sku tsho'i mdum/ na nga tsho'i gnas lugs dang / smra brjod/ rang dbang ni ji 'dra'i nyam chung zhig red ang / gna' nas da —— 56 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho lta'i bar mdzub mos gang bstan shar/ /bla mas ci gsungs chos bzhin song bas/ bod kyi yul 'dir kher tshugs kyi bsam blo mnga' ba'i mi ngo ma zhig byung dkon po red/ mi ni 'jig rten la kha lo sgyur mkhan gyi byed po yin pa'i cha nas 'gro ba mi'i yongs khyab kyi rin thang la dang dod bya rgyu phar zhogader 'bur 'joms dang bkag sdom gyi sbyor ba mtha' gcig tu byas pas/bod mi'i gshis ka de rang tshugs mi thub pa/ sgyid lug la goms pa/ rang nyid kyi myong bar gzhi mi bcol ba/ rang ngos nas 'greng tshugs kyi nus pa med pa/ yod tshad gzhan la skyabs su re ba'i mjug 'bras 'di thon pa red/sprul sku tsho ni 'gro ba mi la lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i rno 'big can gyi nus pa dag zlum zlum mam rtul bo ru gtong ba'i byed po 'ba' zhig tu kho bos 'dod/sprul sku la shas kyis bod spyi tshogs la byas rjes bla med ba'ag yod ni red/yin na yang / ngas byas rjes 'jog mkhan de tsho mi ru ngos 'dzin byed kyin yod pa las/ bod mi'i snang ngo yi srong btsan sgam po lta bu'i mgo gnyis can gyi mi khyad mtshar zhig la ngos 'dzin byas ni min/ ngas de tsho mi 'jon nus can nam mi rlabs chen du go ni yin/ ngas de tsho mi zhes pa'i 'jig rten gyi byed por go ni yin/ ngas 'gro ba mi'i mig shes spyad de kho tshor bltas ni yin/ gser sa na yod na/ 'od nam mkhar 'phro ba'i dpe bzhin/ mi — 57 —

sgren po/'jon thang can zhig yin tshe/ sprul sku ru mnga' ma gsol na yang / spyi tshogs la bton pa'i nus pa gcig 'dra red/ 'dis nga tshor ci zhig gsal 'grel byed kyin yod dam/ 'dis bod mi tshos 'gro ba mi'i nus par mthong chen mi byed pa'i cha zhig dang / mi zhes pa'i 'jig rten gyi byed po 'di la nges shes yang dag cig 'drongs med pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 'di ni bod mi tshos dad pa dag snang sgom yul gyi 'phags pa'i skyes chen tsho yin nam/nga tsho bod kyi kha dper/ mkhas pa snga ma bzang / bstan bcos phyi ma bzang / zhes pa ltar bod kyi sprul sku'i lam lugs 'di yang thog mar yon tan tshad gzhi byas pa'i rmang ga'i'i steng byung ba yin la/ mthar 'di nyid 'phel rgyas sam dang len gyi go rim khrod du go 'dzol byung bas/ da lta'i grub zin gyi rig gnas ma lag cig bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod nas rtsa ba brtan por gnas thub byung ba red / mang tshogs kyi nga' rtsol thon 'bras la longs su spyod par gom sa pa'i mi dmangs kyi khur bo sprudi lta bu byung ba red/ spru la sku tsho ni nam yang mang tshogs kyi ma gor la ga pa 'jog mkhan dang / longs su spyod mkhan yin la/ sprul sku tsho phud pa'i bod mi phal spo dag ni kho tshor phyag 'tshal mkhan/ 'og nas mgo sgur sgur dang sgyid pa ltem/ lhom byed mkhan/sprul sku tsho'i gzhi 'khor ba skrun byed kyi rgyu nor gsog mkhan red/ mi bu'i — 58 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/rtsis thang gi thog nas bshad na/ nga tshor mi gshis kyi rtsis thang 'thob thub kyin med ki yig rmongs pa'i sde phar zhog sprul sku tsho'i sngun nas shes yon can ni lta log pa dang bstan dgra yin ni red/ 'di tsho'i sngun nas shes yon can dag gi sbyor ba thams cad glen rtags yin ni red/ rang re'i shes yo na can la sprul sku tsho'i mdun na bden kha med/ brtsi 'jog med/ 'di ltar song na nga tshor mi gshis kyi rtsis thang de thob sa 'gro ki e yod ki rtsis thang med sa nas bran gshis ma gtogs bden don 'thob ni ma red/ 'gro ba mir bdag gir yod pa'i rang nus la mi brten par yod tshad sprul skur skyabs bcol ba ni bran gshis ma yin nam/ pha mas gnangs pa'i mgo bo mthon po sprul sku'i rkang 'og 'a ga 'og tu 'jog pa ni bran gshis kyi cha ma yin nam/mi bu'i tsis thang ni rang nyid kyi bla srog las kyang gal chen yin ni red/rtsis thang med sa nas rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam/ kher tshugs/ rang nus zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di dag gleng thabs yod mi srid/dpyod shes kyi mig shel thogs te bod kyi sprul sku'i lam lugs la dpyad na/ ‘‘sprul sku’’zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i go don ngo ma ni dge rgan nam slob dpon chen mo rnams la yang srid btsal ba'i mi de la zer zhing / 'di nyid blun dad che ba'i bod pa tshang gis sdug sa na yod pa thod la blangs te/ sprul — 59 —

rjeskyecad21/ da wasku 'di tshor spyi tshogs kyi go gnas nges can sprad pa red/ 'di lta bu'i snang tshul byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni bod la lha chos rig gnas dang mi chos rig gnas gnyis la dbye mtshams gsal bo zhig med pa'i rkyen yin shas che/chos pa'i rig gnas dang khyim pa'i rig gnas kyi dbye ba ma khor ba'i dbang gis da lta'i gnas bab 'di lta bu byung ba cis ma yin/ sprul sku zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i bdag po ngo ma'am sprul sku gang yin yang sprul sku de'i sku phreng dang po de ni yon tan gyi cha nas 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin pa rtogs 'ong / mgo stag dang rnga ma sbrul gyi dpe bzhin yang sprul phyi ma dag rim bzhin bas ma blo yi thad nas rul sungs dang yon tan gyi cha nas nyams zhan du phyin te/ da lta ci yang mi shes pa'i byis pa chung chung zhig gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por bzhag nas de la phyag 'tsha'/ ba'i tshad la slebs 'dug byis pa chung chung 'ig gi blo yis bod mi byings kyi bsam blo'i tshab byed thub na khyod tshos soms dang / 'di ni rang nyid la yid ches med pa'i glen/ rtags kha tsha bo zhig red ang / 'de ni ga'an la ‘glu/ga pa bsring bar goms pa'i mi rigs shig gi rang gye/zugs ma red ang /da lta zhib 'dang re brgyab na sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyi gsung de legs pa'i gnas su 'khums snyam/ khong gis 'di ltar brjod yod de/— 60 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/gal te mi zhig gis nga la bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas gang yin zhes dris na/ ngas lan du bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas ni sprul rdo sku'i yang srid 'tshol ba'i lam lugs red ces brjod nges zhes pa ni ci 'dra'i byu spyi bsdoms rang bzhin gyi skad cha zhig red ang / sgal tshugs med pa'am yang na rang tshugs med pa'i bod mi tshos/ nam zhig gi tshe rang ngo rang gis zin nas / ṣ+pel sku tsho'i 'orge nas yar langs te/ sprul sku 'di tsho rgyang phud du gtong ba'i tshad la slebs thub bam/ tshad thig der slebs na gzhi nas bod pa tshang gi go rtogs sad pa'i rtags su bzhag chog snyam/nga tshos bzhur zin pa'i lo rgyus la phyi mig cig bltas na/ lo rgyus kyis nga tshor gsal ston byas yod pa ni sprul sku'i lam lugs 'dis bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas gang so so'i thad la shugs rkyen nges can zhig btang yod pa de red/ chab srid kyi thad nas gleng na/ sa phag rin sa/tsang sogs phan tshun bar gyi dmag 'khrug dang grub mtha'i bar gyi 'gal ba de mdor bsdus na chab srid kyi gnad don ga la ma yin/ kho tshos kha chos lugs kyi grub mtha' la g.yar ba ma gtogs dmigs yul chab srid ma yin zhes su zhig gis brjod nus sam/ lhag par bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi nyams rgud de'ang srid kyi stegs bu'i steng du chos byed mi sna bsres pa — 61 —

sgren po/las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin la/ chos byed mi sna rim bzhin chab srid kyi gar stegs steng du bud pa des bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs nyams rgud du 'gro rgyur sa bon btab yod pas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yi mda' mo gcig gis bod sil bur gtor ba'i mjug 'bras byung ba red 'dod/ chos byed mi sna chab srid kyi gar stegs su bud pa'i dbang gis/ rang re'i yul 'dir sprul sku tsho'i 'dod mos dang mthun pa'i srid don skyong thabs khyad par ba de/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs bzos pa red/ lam lugs de ni sprul sku kho tsho rang nyid kyi khe dbang srung phyir du bkol ba'i thabs lam zhig dang / dbang sgyu ra byed thabs shig kyang red/ de bas yang sprul ngos 'dzin lam lugs 'di ni bla sprul dang chos byed mi sna tsho'i khe dbang sra brtan du gtong ba'i lag char gyur/ bran sgyur gyi lag cha ngo mar gyur ba red/ lam lugs 'di byung rjes nga tsho rgud pa nas rgud pa'i phyogs su chas song ba red/ chos dang srid gnyis ni me dang chu'i rang ba'in la sa ma/ 'das/ srid kyi byed nus ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyi khe phan la srung skyob byed rgyu de red la/ de yang mdor bsdus na 'jig rten skyong thabs sa ma spyi tshogs la kha lo byed pa'i 'phrul 'khor lta bu red/ chos ni 'di snang gi 'jig rten bde ba dor nas thar ba don du gnyer ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs spang bya dang tshe phyi ma nyid blang bya — 62 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/yin pas/ 'di gnyis mthun 'jug bya thabs med/ de bas chos lugs pa rnam dag cig gis srid sgrub mi nus la/ de bzhin du srid don pa ngo ma zhig gis kyang chos gnyer mi nus/ dper na/ gal te mi zhig khrims 'gal gyis srog khrims khur dgos tshe/ srid don ltar na srog khrims gcod ni red/rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing / rgyal bo'i bka' la lan gcig zer ni red/ chos pas de la srog khrims gcod ni ma red/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad ces bshad yod ni red/ 'u cag gi chos srid zung 'brel ltar na gnad don 'di thag gis gcod sa mi 'gro kachos byed mi sna chab srid kyi bdag por gyur ba dang chabs cigadapal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi khyab khongs gzhan pa'i thad la yang the gtogs bya srid pa blos dpag na shes nus/ dpal 'byor gyi cha nas cung zad gleng na/ bod pa tshang gi khyim tshang ga ge mo zhig la kha bza' rgyu dang rgyab gon pa med kyang / sprul sku rnam pa la 'bul ba ster rgyu'i thad nas rang nyid la med na'ang mi gzhan sa nas bskyis te 'bul gyin yod/ yid phangs pa zhig la kho tsho'i dka' sdug dang rngul chu yis bskrun pa'i rgyu nor dag 'bul yul gyi sprul sku de dag rang nyid kyi 'khor ba dang mnga' thang de'i ched du 'dod yon gyi mig zung ches cher bgrad bzhin mchis/ rgyun par kho tsho'i kha nang na — 63 —

da bye/sbud21/ da wa ma ṇi 'don 'don byed bzhin pa'i sbyor ba mtha' dag mar gyur sems can gyi don 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'i bsam blo rlabs chen gang / dus skabs de lta bu zhig la rang don kho na ru gyur 'dug 'di 'dra'i bsam blo dang lag len do mi mnyam pa'i sbyor ba 'di lta bu nga tsho bod pa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu ma yin nam/ mang tshogs kyi sha dang khrag 'thung ba'i sprul sku 'di tsho/ nga tsho bod spyi tshogs kyi khur bo yin min la dpyod dang / zur 'di nas kyang nga tshos sprul sku dag gis bod spyi tshogs la bzhag pa'i byas rjes rtogs nus/ ngas 'dang mang po brgyab mthar/ nga tsho bod pa tshang gis rgyu 'bras rnam bzhag gi cha shas tsam yang shes kyin med bi r+sha ma/ rgyu mtshan ni rgyu med na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba don dngos yin yang / bod kyis rgyu med na'ang 'bras bu yod par yid ches bya bzhin 'dug deng dus kyi sprul sku tsho byis pa chung chung yin dus nas kyang‘‘dad ldan’’mang tshogs kyi sems pa bcol sa'i rten phur lta bu byed bzhin yod/sprul sku de'ang mi yin pa'i ngos thad nas nga tshos der gdeng 'jog byas na/kho da dung ci yang mi shes pa'i byis pa snabaru/ lug dag dang gcig mtshungs red/mi rigs gzhan gyis mi rtogs pa'i ha cang lkog gyur gyi yon tan 'di lta bu mang po yod pa'i dbang gis rgyu 'bras go ldog gi rnam bzhag 'di lta bu byung ba — 64 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/red/ bod kyi sprul sku tshos mi lo mang bor bu lon ldan pa'i ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu zos zos pa'i mjug 'bras su/ khong rnam pa'i sku'i phung bo je brjid dang je tsho red la/ gzhi 'khor ba yang je che nas je rgyas red/ 'jig rten steng du ngal rtsol la ma brten par thob pa'i zas dkar yol gang yang za rgyu med ces pa'i gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi spyi 'gros de khong rnam pa'i steng du bskor na ha cang legs po 'dug tshod red snyam ki dwangs shing gtsang ba'i nang bstan gyi chu rgyun rnyog par bzo mkhan gyi byed po ste/ sprul sku dag gis khong tshos dkar yol dang dgos dbang de'i ched du/ kho tsho'i khams dang mos pa bzhin rang nyid kyi blos dpog tshod kyis rig gnas 'di la 'grel ba sna tshogs dang sbyor ba sna mang byas nas/ da lta chos lugs kyi nang snying ngo ma dang bar thag dpag tshad du ma'i bar gyis bcad yod na'ang / da dung sprul sku mang shas kyis nang bstan gyi phyi gos gyon te gang zhig mkhas mdog gis blun dad che ba'i bod pa tshang gi mgo gcog gin yod/ gnad don de'i dbang gis lha chos kyi nang du mi chos kyang bsres na chog pa'i ra min lug min gyi lam lugs 'di chags pa red/ lam lugs 'di chags pa nas chos pas chos mi 'khyongs la/ khyim pa bas mi don mi 'khyongs pa'i ngan 'bras byung ba red/— 65 —

sgren po/'di ltar mi lo mang por sprul sku tshos rang nyid ma gtogs ma bsam pas kho tshos kho tsho gso skyong gnang mkhan gyi pha ma lta bu'i mang tshogs tsho'i bsam blo'i 'khor rgya la bkag sdom byas par ma zad/ lag zung mang bor gzugs med kyi lcags sgrog dam por brgyab ste/ lha chos rig gnas kyi khor yug las brgal du bcug med pa 'di ni sprul sku tshos rig gnas kyi ngos thad nas bod mi sa ya drug la bran khol byas pa'i phyag rjes bla med yin la/ kho tshos nga yi bod pa tshang la 'gyod bshags bya dgos pa'i mngon sum gyi cha zhig kyang red/yang sprul 'tshol ba'i srol 'di ni so so'i grub mtha'i khe phan dang chab srid kyi ched du yin pa 'dis yang sprul gyi lam lugs 'di ni bod mi sa rang bzo byas pa'i rig gnas kyi snang tshul zhig yin pa shes nus/ sprul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin lam lugs 'di chab srid kyi dgos mkho ltar bod mis rang bzo byas na/ da lta'i lo rgyus 'phel phyogs kyi ngos thad nas/ mi bu'i rtsis thang gi ngos nas/ 'tsho gnas kyi ngos thad nas lam lugs 'di rgyang phud du gtong dgos/ lam lugs thams cad bzo mkhan yang mi yin la/ bshig mkhan yang mi yin pas/ lam lugs 'di gtor mkhan yang nga tsho yin na 'grig 'di ltar sprul sku tshor bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gyi dbang cha thob pa dang dus mnyam du kho tsho ni bod kyi thams cad la kha lo sgyur ba'i rje — 66 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bo'am rgyal bo/ mnga' bdag lta bur gyur yod pa red/ sprul sku zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i go don dang 'di la tshad thig cig ma bzhag tshe/ sems nas snying rje dang sto nga nyid sgom skad kyis lag len gyi ngos thad nas rang nyid kyi phor ba kho nar gzhol mkhan gyi mi 'ig gis rnam shes khri 'bum se gol gcig gis mtho ris su bde la 'god thub na 'di ni ji lta bu zhig red/ mi yul gyi bla na mtho ba'i mdzad pa dang yon tan mtha' dag kho tsho la lhan skyes kyis mnga' grub pa'am dbang 'byor yod pas na/ khong rnam pa'i gzi brjid kyis mkhas pa yin yang lkugs par btang chog la/ glen pa yin yang lha ru bzhengs chog kho tshos srid gsum gyi gnas lugs ma lus rtsam pa bzhin brdzi nus/ la/ rten 'das kyi bya bzhag thams cad ri mo ru phab kyang thub/sprul sku'i yang srid 'tshol ba'i rig gnas snang tshul 'di gangs ljongs kho na nas rtsa ba tshugs shing rtse mo rnam par rgyas te/ da lta phan khe med pa'i 'bras bu yang ches cher smin bzhin 'dug de bas snang tshul 'di ni bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas red ces brjod na chog chog red/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kyi snang tshul te sprul sku'i yang srid 'tshol ba'i rnam pa 'di la sngon gyi char rang re'i bod kyi mkhas chen tshos dogs slong mang po byas yod mod/ nye rabs kyi cha nas gleng na/ don grub rgyal gyi〈sprul sku〉— 67 ge

sgren po/zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung des sprul sku rdzun ma zhig gi snang brnyan nga tsho klog pa po'i mthong lam du gzugs can bzhin bkram nas/ sprul sku zhes pa'i ming 'di'i bdag po tshor rang re'i rig gnas khor yug gi zhing sa 'dir dogs slong gi sa bon thog ma gtor byung / skabs 'di'i dogs slong bya yul gtso bo ni sprul sku zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi bdag po kho na yin pa las/ de las khyab rgya che ba'i nga tsho sgang ba bod kyi sar sngar nas chags zin pa'am yang na grub zin gyi sprul sku'i rig gnas kyi ma lag de ma yin/'di ltar gong gi bsam blo 'di'i rgyun ma chad par dus yun ring bo ma phyin pa'i mthar/ sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyi〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉mi yul du btsas pa des/ de snga〈sprul sku'i〉skabs btab zin pa'i myu gu de la skyes stobs kyi dpal yon byin te/ sprul skur dogs slong byed pa'i rig gnas khor yug de'i zhing sa sngar las rgya bskyed du btang / skabs 'di'i dogs slong bya ba'i gnad de yang‘‘sprul sku’’zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi bdag po de kho na ma yin par/ de las ring du brgal te grub zin pa'i sprul sku'i rig gnas kyi ma lag de'i steng du babs yod par rtsis chog〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉mi yul la bltams pa dang mnyam du/ ‘‘sprul sku’’brjod snying du byas pa'i lta stangs sne gnyis rang ba'in gyi 'gal 'du zhig — 68 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tso/shugs kyis 'phyur ba'i mjug 'bras su/ mi bu drug gi bdag nyid du gyur ba'i〈bdag dpe tshogs〉kyis de snga btab nas rgyas zin pa'i dogs slong gi sa bon de la 'bras bu smin du bcug byung / dus skabs 'di ni nga tsho bod pa tshos bsam blo'i ngos thad nas sprul sku'i lam lugs 'dir skyel ma byas zin par ngos bzung chogamador na sprul sku'i go sa 'gran bsdur gyis 'phrog res byed pa'i da lta'i dus skabs kyi snang tshul 'di las nga tshor gdams pa ni sprul sku zhes pa chos lugs kyi thon dngos shig red mod/ de la g.yo sgyu khram gsum sogs kyi dri mas sbags yod pa zhor du rtogs 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa bya shes mkhan zhig yin tshe/ sprul sku'i lam lugs 'di da lta'i bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi steng nas rgyang phud du gtong dgos par ma zad/da dung sprul sku kho tsho'i bsam blo yi ngos thad nas/ bod spyi tshogs la 'gyod bshags bya rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don zhig tu gyur 'dug go/spyi lo2007lo'i zla4pa'i tshes5la bris/

sgren po/ lo rgyus ma shes pa'i nag nyes/gcigalo rgyus ni spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ga ge mo zhig la gtogs pa las/spyi tshogs de dang dus rabs de las kha bral te brjod na/ de ni yang dag pa'i sdom tshig 'god stangs zhig ma red/ nga tshos mi che ge mo zhig la gdeng 'jog bya dgos tshe/ mi gang nyid 'tshar longs byung sa'i spyi tshogs de dang khor yu ga de la sbyar nas mi bu de'i rin thang la gdeng 'jog byas na 'os pa ma gtogs/ 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyi mi sna de dag la da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi rgyang mthong las bltas na/ de ni nor 'khrul sha stag red/ nga tsho bod mi re re'i snang ngor srong btsan sgam po zer dus tshang ma'i mgo bo mtho ru 'degs nges shing / khri srong lde'u btsan zer dus nga rgyal du rlom bzhin yod/ bod — 70 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/chen po'i dus skabs su byung ba'i btsan po 'di gnyis la mtshon na/ ngo ma nga rgyal dang ngom so byas chog chog gi mi bu rlabs chen red/ yin na yang / nga tshos nam yang gong gi lo rgyus mi sna 'di gnyis/ bod mi'i thun mong gi snying stobs shig tu go na 'grig pa las/ srong btsan sgam po spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul yin zhes pa lta bu'i lha sgrung zhig tu 'dod na mi 'grig lo rgyus kyis mi'i 'jig rten gyi bden pa 'chad kyin yod/ lo rgyus ni lo rgyus rang yin pa las/ dungs zhen dang 'then 'khyer gyi sems pa bsres gang thub byas chog pa'i bdag nyid cig min/ rkyen de'i dbang gis/ nga tshos da dung yang chos lugs rig gnas kyi mig shel spyad de/ lo rgyus kyi mi sna 'di gnyis por gdeng 'jog bya rgyu yin zhe na/ kha ba can da dung yang gdod ma'i gdod ma zhig gi 'jig rten yin pa las/ de ring gi mi chos rig pa 'di bshad sa yod kyi ma red/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang khri srong lde'u btsan gnyis la di lta bu'i bla med gdeng 'jog byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes bod mi re re'i sems la 'dri rtags shig 'phen pa'i dbang du btang na/ 'dir 'dod thog la yodze+eba'i a lan ster mkhan ni ha cang dkon po yin tshod gda'/rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ bod mi tshos rgyal bo 'di gnyis kyi mdzad rjes bgrang shes pa tsam las/ dmag rta'i rmig sgra yis e sha ya'i brang khog stobs — 71 —

sgren po/kyis brdungs myong ba'i spobs pa de dang / btsan po'i blo gros kyis mkha' dbyings kyi rgyu skar 'tshos myong ba'i rnam dpyod de'i rgyab na mang po mang po zhig yod nges par bsam blo gtong mi shes/ bod snga rabs pa dag gis brtsams pa'i lo rgyus yig cha gang la bltas na yang / rgyal rabs so so'i dus skabs de'i srid phyogs dang 'brel yod kyi gnad don mang po zhig bskyur te/ gnad don dngos la rkang mi 'dzugs par/ de las ldog ste/ rgyal bo 'di'i ring la lha khang 'di dang 'di bzhengs/ nang ba'i chos gzhung gan dang gan sgyur zhes pa lta bu'i nang chos dar ba'i lo rgyus dang cha 'dra ba zhig bris yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang nang sgos su lo rgyus kyi glegs bam las mi rnyed rgyu ha cang dka'/ de bas/ ngas 'di ru bod snga rabs lo rgyus smra ba tshos lo rgyus 'chad mi shes ki zhes brjod na ha cang thal che ba'i skyon du 'gro mod/ 'di yang lo rgyus ma shes pa'i nag nyes su bgrang chog bod snga rabs lo rgyus smra ba tsho'i brtsams chos las mi mthong dkon pa'i zur 'di nas/ nga tshos bod snga rabs mkhas pa tsho'i mi gzhi la gdeng 'jog byas chog ste/ kho tsho ni rang nyid kyi myong ba dang klad pa la gzhi mi bcol ba'i lung 'dzin ring lugs smra ba tag tag red/ kho tsho ni rang nyid kyi snying stobs rang nyid kyis 'chad pa'i spobs — 72 —
