mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/pa med mkhan gyi mi ngo srung mkhan skyeng rkyang red/ gang ltar nga tshos lo rgyus steng byung ba'i mi bu rlabs chen de dag gi spobs par rjes su yi rangs dang /kho tsho gsal bor ston byed kyi me long ste/ dus skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong dag da lta'i rang nyid kyi stobs shugs su bsgyur rgyu ni lo rgyus bslab pa'i dge ba yin la/ lo rgyus kyis nga tshor 'chad 'dod pa yang de red/gnyis/da lta'i bod kyi rtsom stegs steng du 'khyug tsam bltas na/ spyi khyab rang bzhin gyi gnad don 'di lta bu zhig mthong thub ki de ni slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum gyi snyan ngag 'bri ba bo yin na yang 'dra/ spyi tshogs steng gi snyan ngag 'bri ba bo gang yin rung tshang ma'i brtsams chos kyi ngos so so nas/ nga tsho klog pa por byin pa ni/ skyo sdug gis mnar ba'i smre ngag cig dang / ngu 'bod kyis bltams pa'i 'o dod cig red/ 'on kyang / phangs sems kyi dbugs ring gtong dgos sa zhig ni/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos dang bsam blo de ‘sta bu 'byung sa'i khungs gnyis gzhi mthun min pa de red/ nga tsho khong tsho'i na zug gis bkang ba'i brtsams chos de dag dang kha bral nas rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i nye sar bcar te/ na zug 'byung sa'i khungs dris na/ snyan — 73 —

sgren po/ngag pa phal mo cher rgyu mtshan yang dag cig 'dren rgyu med pas/ ngas ni khong tsho la na zug med kyang na zug yod mdog ston pa'i tsho khag ces 'bod kyin yod/ spyir da lta'i ri kha ba can gyi gnas bab ngo ma shes mkhan zhig yin rkyen/ na zug gi gdung 'bod dang skyo sdug gi mig chu ni med sa mi 'gro mod/na zug gis bkang ba'i snyan ngag 'bri zhor na zug 'byung rkyen mi shes pa'i snyan ngag rdzun ma yi thon rdzas skrun mkhan byung rkyen yang / ngas ni lo rgyus ma shes pa'i nag nyes kyis byas par 'dod/ lhag don bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ma shes pa'i nag nyes red 'dod/ mes po'i zungs khrag gis btod pa'i lo rgyus kyi lam bur bsam ga'ig gis bskyod myong mkhan zhig dang / nye rabs 'o rgyus steng byung ba'i pham nyes dang / gnya' gnon/ btsan 'dzul/ me mda'i bo'u kha nas shor ba'i ya nga ba'i dmar gsod chen po de'i skyo gar gyi mig chu snying gi bar gseng na bskyil yod mkhan gyi snyan ngag pa zhig yin phyin/kho tsho'i brtsams chos de yang na zug rkyang rkyang gis bris yod pa smros med yin/gsum/bdag gi bsam gzhig gtong stangs 'dis rgyun par nga la na zug gtong gi 'dug bdag gi smra brjod 'di yang rang dbang na mi 'dug de — 74 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ni lo rgyus kyis nga la phangs sems dang yid chad ma gtogs gang yang ma bzhag pas yin/ de ni bdag dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba zhig yin pas yin/ spyir slob grwa chen mo ba ni mi rigs dang rgyal khab gang la mtshon nas brjod na yang / kho tsho ni re smon gyi nyi gzhon shar phyogs nas bsu mkhan gyi byed po yin la/ 'o rgyus kyis bstsal ba'i 'gan khur 'degs par bzod pa'i gdung 'degs kyi ka ba yin mod/ kha nang la phyogs te grags med 'gul med kyi g.yang gzar la lhung nyen che ba'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba tshor bltas na/ bsam gzhig gi mgo bo 'di mi theg bzhin du smyug kha mi sgyur rang sgyur du gyur song /lo rgyus kyi gom stabs mdun du bsgyur nas dus rabs nyer gcig par thon yod na yang / bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba tshos da dung yang grog mor gyur zin gyi gna' bo'i bgrod lam de'i steng du 'tshang kha shig shig gi las la brel ba'in 'dug kho tsho da dung yang ting 'dzin gyi sgom la zhugs zin pa'i srol rgyun gyi bstan bcos de tshor phyag 'tshal nas nyi ma gtong bzhin 'duga'adi ltar yin pa la yang rgyu mtshan med pa ma yin te/ gcig byas na bod kyi yul 'dir mi'i rig pa 'chad sa'i slob grwa nub byang mi rigs slob chen ma gtogs med pas yin/ gnyis na slob grwa chen mo ba'i khrid stegs kyi steng na — 75 —

sgren po/mi chos rig gnas sbyong bar yar skul byed thub mkhan/ dge rgan bdud lha rgyal lta bu ha cang dkon pas yin/ slob grwa chen mo ba ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba'i thabs la 'bad mkhan gyi rigs ma yin la/ ri bong rwa yod med rtsod mkhan ni de bas kyang min/ slob grwa chen mo ba ni/ rang nyid kyi 'tsho gnas la gzhol mkhan dang mi rigs kyi nyen tshabs rang bzhin la mno bsam gtong mkhan yin/ mi'i 'tsho ba dang nye bar mkho ba'i rig gnas slob rgyu ni deng rabs slob chen pa tsho'i 'os 'gan yin la/ slob chen pa'i dan rtags kyang red/ spyir na bod kyi slob chen pa tsho ni/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ brda 'phrin/ tshong las / dmag don/ 'dzugs skrun bcas rig tshan khag mang po zhig gi byed po yin na 'grig mod/ bod kyi slob chen pa tsho slob mthar phyin rjes phyir spyi tshogs steng du zhugs na ston pa'i na bza' gyon med pa ma gtogs da dung yang dgon sde khag gi grwa ba'i bsam blo dang cha 'dra bo 'dug 'di lta bu'i ngan 'bras 'byung rkyen ni bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba'i slob gso'i sgrig gzhir rag las yod de/ bslab deb dang slob khrid byed stangs tshang ma dgon sde'i slob gso dang mtshungs pa'i dbang gis red/ deng skabs bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba'i khor yug na gnad don 'di lta bu — 76 bhe

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/zhig 'byung gin yod de/ rang rigs kyi bde sdug gleng mkhan gyi mi bu dag ni slob ma phal mo che bas de dag glen pa zhig dang / lta log pa zhig yang na 'phya dmod byed sa'i gnas shig tu gyur yod/ 'di ni bdag lta bur mtshon na ches bzod mi thub pa'i snang tshul zhig red/ rgyu mtshan/ mi rigs kyi bde sdug de khyod rang gtogs pa'i khyod kyi gnyen nye du tsho'i bde sdug yin pas/'angi tsho yi bde sdug nga tsho slob chen pa tshos mi gleng na/ su zhig gis gleng dgos/ 'o na zhing tshigs na 'jor dang lcags khem thogs shing nor lug gi sug rjes na 'dur ba'i bod kyi yig rmongs pa 'di tshos gleng dgos pa e red/khyod tshos soms dang / bdag gi slob chen pa tsho/ bod kyi slob chen pa tshor na zug med la 'gan khur ni de bas kyang med/ de bas/ kho tsho nyi ma dmar bo'i bran sgyur gyi slob gso'i 'og na rang nyid 'bor gyin 'dug 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab khag dang lhag par rgya nag la mtshon nas bshad na/ krung go'i nye rabs lo rgyus kyi dbu slob chen pa tsho'i khrag dang spobs sems kyis brtsams mod/ rang rigs kyi slob chen pa tsho de las ldog ste/ rang rigs kyi lo rgyus skrun rgyu phar zhog lo rgyus la 'gan yang khur gyin mi 'dug gong gi gnad don 'di dag 'byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam zhe na/ de ni bod kyi slob chen pa tshos rang rigs kyi lo rgyus ma shes pa dang / lhag don — 77 —

sgren po/bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ma shes pa'i dbang gis yin rgyu red/ kho tsho'i bsam par rig gnas gsar brje dang nga brgyad kyi god chag 'di gnyis ltogs skom gyi lo zla tsam la ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod mod/ (drang mor brjod na/)lo rgyus dngos de lta bu zhig e red/ bod kyi shes yon pa'i mi rabs gcig tshar bcad pa'i lo rgyus kyi skyo gar 'di lta bu ma shes pa'i dbang gis/ kho tshor rang nyid kyi pha gzhis stong bar btang ba'i na zug cig dang lo rgyus la 'gan khur ba'i 'du shes shig gang nas skyes dgos/ skyes sa mi 'gro gispyi lo2007lo'i zla12pa'i tshes1la/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho rang nyid kyi che srog la btang ba'i nyen brda thog ma/—da warang nyid kyi bla srog 'tshol ba'i go rim ste/ kher sdug ma'i lo zla/gcig ngas nam rgyun rang gis rang la gu yangs gtong mi srid/thog ma nas btab zin pa'i phugs 'dun gyi me tog de'am yang na rang sems kyi mdzes pa de'i slad du/ ngas nam yang kher sdug gi 'tsho ba skyur bo 'di skom gdung gis mnar ba'i sems kyis ldag dgos pa'i gdam gses 'di snga mo nas bya dgos byung / 'tsho ba skyur bo 'di/ mi gshis kyi 'khyog gzugs phyi'i bya spyod kyi steng du mngon par bkra ba'i phyi mdzes nang stong gi‘‘deng rabs slob chen pa’’'chal bo tsho'i mnga' thang min pa ngas shes yod la/pha skad kyi bgo skal shor nas rang nyid kyi skyes khungs 'bor gyin pa'i‘‘slob chen gyi sgrol ma tsho'i’’'dzum mdangs bslu byed min pa'ang ngas rtogs yod/— 79 —

sgren po/yin na'ang / bsam blo gtong stangs shig gis/ rang sems la bya ra byed thengs shig gis/ nga'i mig lam du rgyun par pha yul gcig pu nas mthong thub pa'i rnag khrag dang ser gas bkang ba'i skam rid kyi lag zung mang po nyam chung gis 'char 'ong ba'i mod la/ re bzhag gi mig zung ches cher bgrad nas/ re sgug gi lag pa thod la bcings pa'i zhing grong gi pha ma tsho'i sems ljongs kyang snying gis klog thub/ yid phangs pa zhig la pha ma de tsho'i re sgug bya yul gyi slob chen pa de tsho ni/ dmigs yul dang kha phyogs med par m+mug klong na mgo g.yom 'khor zhing / longs spyod rkyang rkyang bsnyeg par goms yod/ kho tsho'i ya ma brla'i spyod stangs dang rang nyid bor zin gyi zhe mer ba'i me gshis des / nga la spyang ki zhes pa'i srog chags/ gzhan zhig yid 'aci 'char du bcug byung / rang nyid kyi pha ma'i sha gseng gi zungs khrag 'jib mkhan te/spyang ki yi 'tsho ba rol stangs gzhan zhigangs 'di ltar lag zung snying khar ba'/ga nas rang sems la byi dor bya thengs re rer/ ngas 'di ltar dran pa nang du bkugs nas skya zad sngo sdug gi zhing grong ba'i 'tsho bar phyi mig 'phen thengs re rer/ nga'i snang ngor re sgug gi ston ljongs de'i rgya khyo/ na dog nas dog tu 'gro bzhin pa'i 'jigs nyams shig ster mod/ sbrid sman 'thung ba'i mi bu de dag da dung yang khor yug — 80 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/kharidi'i rims nad kyi khong gseng las thar thub kyin med pas/ ngas rang nyid nas rkang btsugs te/ ngas rang nyid la nyen brda thog ma btang ba yin/nyen brda ste/ rang gis rang la gu yangs btang ba mang drags na/ shugs ring dang yid chad rkyang rkyang gi sdug gyong rag pa'i nyen brda de/gnyis/ ngas nam rgyun rang nyid kyi bla sro ga la ngo log bya mi srid/rang nyid gang nas chas te/ mthar gang zhig tu log rtsis yod/khyod rang su zhig yin/ ci zhig 'thob 'dod kyis mig zung rgyang du bsrings na/ de tsam mi sdu ga pa'i gdong la mya ngan 'khor 'ongs/thog ma'i ngu ngag gi dbyangs rtas mi yul bsus dus nas bzung / nga ni rang nyid kyi rkang ba gnyis la brten nas rgyang du chas dgos pa'i 'grul bzhud pa zhig mi yul gyi ches dwangs gtsang gi sem sa pa zhig rum la bcug nas nga 'di ltar rang nyid 'tshol ba'i lam kha der snyegalam kha na ma yum gyi brtse ba'i mig chus bdag gi sems pa brlan yo da la/lam 'gram na snying sdug ma'i sems gzhas kyis nga la dran shing btsugs yod/rang lam snyeg tshul ni chu bo chen po zhig brgal ba dang mtshungs la/sems kyi dbyar ljongs shig la log pa dang yang 'dra/ nga lam la chas dus — 81 —

sgren po/nas da lta'i bar nga la gang yang yod ma myong mod/ yin na'ang ches spro 'os pa zhig ni rang nyid la rang nyid kyi bla srog lhag yod pas/ rang nyid mi yul 'dir rngam rngam gyis song chog rang nyid la rang nyid kyi lang tsho'i spobs sems de mnga' bas/ 'ardig rten gyi bdag po 'gro ba mi yin par yid rton byed bzhin yod/bla srogas+dzatshe srog/drang bden/ bla srog khyod rang mi ru 'greng byed kyi sgal tshigs yin/ bla srog khyod rang mi yul 'grim byed kyi spyan zung red/ khyod 'jig rten zhig gi lam 'gro ba/song song ba'i mtha' mar thon rgyu zhig dang / slebs nas thob rgyu zhig yod par ngas nam yang yid ches byed bzhin yod/nga rang 'od dang mun pa gnyis las 'od snang la phyogs yod/ phyi bshol dang mdun skyod gnyis las mdun du skyod rgyur phyogs yod/ bdag ni mi lo mang por 'phrog zin pa'i bla srog gi rol mo der/ dbyangs rta gsar ba zhig gis dkrol rgyur sta gon gyi ngal ba lhur len mkhan de yin/ bdag la dbang chog chog gi nga'i rus ming dang / nga'i gdam gses/ nga'i smra brjod/ gdod ma nas bla srog dang gzhi grub tu gnas pa'i mi'i rtsis thang 'di dag 'greng tshugs kyi bsam blo thun min gyi sger gshis/ 'di — 82 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/dang de mtshungs kyi mang bo zhig ni ngas dkrol rgyur rem pa'i bla srog gi rol mo'i dbyangs rta gsar ba yin/ bdag ni khyod rang dam por bcings byed kyi lcags thag de'i a long / dum bur gtor ba'i sa sgang gi mi rabs gsar ba de'i gras yin pa las/ khyod kyi sger gcod dang ldan pa'i bsam blo'i ring lugs la mgo sgur mkhan gyi gras gtan nas min/ de bas/ bdag la ni spyan zung dang 'dra ba'i bla srog mkho/ bla srog 'tshol ba'i go rim ni/ khyod kyis rang nyid kyi nang sems la rtog 'jug byed pa'i brgyud rim zhig yin la/rang nyid kyi bsam blor btso sbyangs byed pa'i thabs lam zhig kyang red/ bla srog la ngo log mi byed pa'i rigs ni/ rang bkur gyi bsam blo mnga' mkhan dag yin/ lo rgyus la phyir rtog bya shes mkhan dag red/ srol rgyun gyi rin thang lta ba ma lus mgo rting slog par spobs sems yod mkhan dag red/ bla srog mi ru yar 'greng byed kyi sgal tshigs red ang /spyi lo2007lo'i zla1pa'i tshes3la/

sgren po/ nang ma spro skyid khang nas khyod kyi ngo gdong mthong tshul/btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug nas bzung mi chos rig gnas kyi sa bon bor brlag btang zin pa'i sa sgang gi mi rigs 'dis/ btsan po'i dus mjug nas sngo dwangs dwangs kyi nam mkha' 'di dang nem ljang ljang gi spang ljongs der khen nas/ sos dal dang bag phebs kyi ngang gnyid la rol/dus rabs nyer gcig ni drag chas shig dang 'dra bar/ bsam blo'i me skyogs kyis bod sngar yod kha rub(ts+tshagleṣ+ṭha)spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi gtor bas/gzhi nas mi lo mang bor rang nyid bor zin pa'i sa sgang gi mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas kyang / mi rigs rang bzhin nas 'dzam gling rang bzhin du kha — 8tsho1 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/phyogs 'go tshugs pa red/ 'di ni mi rigs rang ngos nas kha phyogs pa ma yin par dus rabs nyer gcig gi 'dzam gling bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyis brdab gsig byas pas/ mi byed thu med kyi btsan gyis dang len byas pa'i rnam pa zhig red/ 'di ltar gra sgrig med pa'am yang na rmang gzhi med pa'i gnas tshul 'og thu bhod rig gnas 'dzam gling rang bzhin du kha phyogs tshul der cal 'drogs kyi cha zhig dang / tsing rags ldan pa'i phyi tshul gyi ngos shig ngang ngam shugs kyis grub yod/ ngas 'di ru brjod 'dod pa ni 'dzam gling rang bzhin la kha phyogs pa'i bod kyi rig gnas 'dir/ mi rigs gzhan gyis phyi tshul kho na nas 'di'i rin thang la gdeng 'jog bya bzhin yod pa'i snang tshul de ther 'don bya bsam pa yin/ de yang dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/ deng dus grong khyer so so na khyab kyin pa'i nang ma spro skyid khang dang / de'i nang na yod pa'i bod kyi thang ka dang rol mo/ zhabs bro sogs lta bu red/de las thog mar thang ka'i sgyu rtsal gyi thad du nga tshos smyug kha btsugs na/dpe mtshon rang bzhin can zhig yod pa ni reb gong red/ reb gong gser mo ljongs dang sgyu rtsa' gyi pha sa'i cho lo bzhes mkhan gyi kho bo/ da lta bgres po zhig gi ngo mdangs las nga tshor ci yang ston gyin mi 'dug ci'i phyir zhe na/— 85 —

sgren po/sgyu rtsal gyi pha sa zhes pa'i‘‘sgyu rtsal’’gyi tha snyad 'di la yang go ba lon mkhan ha cang nyung nyung yin pas/ kho tsho'i snang ngor grub pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi pha sa zhes pa'i‘‘sgyu rtsal’’de thang ka 'bri bzhengs kho nar go 'dug de ltar yin na bod kyi sna mang sgyu rtsal zhes pa yang snying nga tshose gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/ thang ka 'bri bzhengs tsam po ba reb gong gi sgyu rtsal yin na/ 'dzam gling la ngom so byas chog pa'i thu bhod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal de gang du 'tshol dgos/ btsan po'i rig gnas snying stobs kyis rkang zin zhing / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi zhing sa gshin por 'bod pa'i reb gong ya/ da lta khyod rang mes po dge chos kyi ming byang rum bzhin gna' bo'i snyan grags kyi mtho tshad kyis bsdad de/ khyod kyi gson shugs nyams kyin 'dug 'phar rtsa rul gyin 'dug 'di ni bdag gi mi lo nyi shu'i ma yum ste/ reb gong gser mo ljongs kyis nga la gzas nas bzhag pa'i na zug yin la/ khyod tshor byin pa'i bsam gzhigs kyi dri rtags skyur bo zhig kyang yin 'os/ 'di ltar reb gong nang bzhin/nga tshos thu bhod rig gnas kyi phyi tshul kho na gnyer ba yin na/ deng skabs 'dzam gling can du 'gyur ba'i sna mang rig gnas kyi dpal yon khrod/gzhan gyis thu bhod rig gnas la bzung ba'i lta stangs phyi tshul tsam po de lhag don phyi tshul tsam la 'gyur nyen che/ de ltar yin na thu bhod rig gnas kyi — 86 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/rus rkang de su zhig gis 'don spel bya dgos/ bdag gi phugs bsam na gson pa'i gzhon nu ya/ 'di ni nga tsho mi rabs 'di'i phrag steng la lhung ba'i g.yol med kyi 'gan khur e red/ nang ma khang /nang ma khang zhes pa'i ming 'di dus nam zhig la nga tsho'i lo rgyus su mngon min ni gtso bo min mod/ nang ma khang zhes pa'i ming 'di'i don la nga tshos nges par du rang rgyus lon dgos snyam/ nang ma khang ni btsan po'i dus skabs kyi bod kyi rgyal bo dag spro gseng la rol sa'i gzhis kar go dgos/'dir ched dmigs kyis‘‘nang ma’’zhes sbyor don ni rgyal bo de pho brang nang nas bzhugs mkhan yin pa'i ngos thad nas brnan tshig 'di lta bu sbyar bar 'dod/de ltar yin na/ nang ma spro skyid khang de da lta 'chal spyod pa khag cig gi smyon pa'i lab brdol rgyag sa'i bste gnas su gyur yod na/ bdag gi mes po'i snying stobs kyi dar cha de da lta gang du yib song / bdag gi sems kyis yun ring nyar ba'i nang ma spro skyid khang de 'di ltar 'khos zhan du gyur song ba e red/ gang ltar nang ma spro skyid khang de nga tsho rang nyid yar slong byed kyi snying stobs shig la go na ha cang 'grig tshod red/— 87 —

sgren po/bod kyi rol mo/bod kyi rol cho/ las deng gzhas kyi skor gleng tsam gyis mang mang zhig gi yid la glu ba yar tung dang 'phyongs zhol sgrol ma sogs rgya mi'i skad rigs g.yar te len pa'i glu ba dag 'char nges shing / glu ba khong tsho'i skad kyi gdangs char sim pa'i dbyangs rta de yis nga tshor rang gi 'tsho ba dngos ma de'i khams ster nus par ma zad/ bod kyi deng gzhas 'dzam gling rang bzhin can la khyab spel dang mtshams sbyor gyi cha nas ngo ma glu ba 'di tshor lag rjes mi dman pa yod mod/ 'on kyang zur ngos gzhan zhig nas khong tsho la bltas na/nga tshos skyon gyi phung bo zhig kyang zhor la mthong 'ong / de ni skad rigs nyam chag chen pos kun nas mnar ba'i rang gi gnas bab dang sbyar na/ khong tsho'i bsam spyod de nyid ni rma thog tu khab gtsags pa ma yin nam/ da lta'i bod kyi gnas bab dngos la mkho ba ni nga tshor 'di dang 'di yod ces rang gi rig gnas phyi la mtshams sbyor bya rgyu de gtso bo ma yin/ 'dzam gling gtso rgyugs rig gnas gang nang 'dren byas nas/ des rang nyid kyi mi 'dang sar kha gsab byas rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur ba'i don zhig red/ dus yun ring bo ma 'gor ba'i bod kyi deng gzhas 'di'i song zin pa'i bgrod lam —— 88 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/las kyang nga tshor bsam gzhig gi bar stong chen po re ster nges/ bod kyi deng rabs rol mo'i rnam pa mi legs/ pa 'di sgyur ba'i thad nas/ nga tsho kun pos bstod bsngags kyi mthe bong sgreng chog chog cig yod pa ni mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs red/ lo ngo bzhi lnga'i ring gi bod yul du bskyod pa zhes pa'i rig rtsal spro tshogs chen po des/ gzhi nas pha skad kyi nyam chag 'dir kha gsab bya dang byed mus su yod pa 'di red/ 'di ltar bod rang sa nas rol mo 'di nyid 'phel rgyaṭaṭa su phyin na bod kyi deng gzhas 'dis spyi khyab rang bzhin gyi sgo nas rgya che'i bod rigs mi mang la bsam blo'i 'tsho bcud gya nom pa zhig ster nges/ nga tshos nam yin na yang rang nyid kyi gnas bab ngo ma shes rtogs bya rgyu shin tu nas gal che ste/ rang rigs la mtshon na yig rmongs pa'i mi grangs kyis phon che ba bzung yod/ gang ltar bdag gi gom kha nang ma spro skyid khang la sgyur thengs re rer/ skya zad sngo sdug gi gnas bab las log pa'i deng gzhas de dag gi brjod snying dang / skad rigs g.yar ma las grub pa'i glu tshig des/ nga la ma 'ongs pa zhes pa'i mya ngam thang chen po zhig ston gyin pa'i blo pham dang 'jigs snang ster gizhar byung bod kyi glu ba'am gzhas pa/

sgren po/dus rgyun brnyan 'phrin dang glog klad kyi brnyan ris las 'char thub pa ni sgyu rtsal gyi blo sbyong sngon du ma btang zhing skad gdangs gang mthor 'gran pa'i nga tsho sgang ba bod kyi glu ba dag gi bzo lta red/ kwa ye/ bod kyi glu ba/khyod rang ha cang mtho ba'i gar stegs kyi yang steng du bud de/ ltad mo ba khri 'bum gyi dga' 'bod khrod khengs nyams kyis glu gzhas gtong dus/ khyod kyi sems khong na mi rigs shig gi phugs 'dun e yod/ khyod kyi sems khong na yar klung nas chas pa'i mes po dpung rjen tsho'i spobs sems e yo da/khyod rang gar stegs dang mnyam sdod kyi skad cig ma der khyod la 'gan 'khri'i khur bo zhig yod nges par khyod kyis 'dang brgyab e myong / khyod kyis bsam shes na khyod ni gangs kyi rol dbyangs zhes pa'i mnyam sgrog rol mo de'i bla srog go la'i rtse mo nas gseng mthor gyer ba'i sa mtho'i glu ba yin/ nam rgyun gzab 'chor shom chen re spras nas glu ba yin mdog ston pa'i bod kyi glu ba/khyod kyi glu tshig gi gseb nas dgun gzhung na lus pa'i tsho khag cig gi nyam nga mthong mi thub la/ khyod kyi nang sems kyi 'jig rten nas bye thang na skom gdung gis gzir ba'i rigs rgyud cig gi 'o dod yang thos mi thub/ de lta yin yang chog ste/ khyod ni mi gzhan gyi sems 'dun gzhan la 'chad mkhan gyi mgrin pa kho na yin pas/ khyod ni gzhas tshig dang gzhas dbyangs gzhan — 90 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/la slong ba'i bod kyi glu ba red/ glu gzhas ni dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'dun pa lhog lhog tu 'phyur bar byed pa'i rol dbyangs kyi bdag nyid cig yin pa las/ snang ba skyid pa gcig dang gnyis lta bu'i spro snang ring lugs kho na'i bdag nyid cig gtan nas yin tshod ma red/ de dang cha 'dra bar/ glu ba gar stegs dang lhan gnas kyi dus der ma gzhi nas smyu rtsal brtsams chos shig yin pa las/ glu brgya gdangs gcig can gyi bskyar klog 'phrul chas(zo/r+sālo)ma red/bod kyi glu ba tsho/ a gsar thal che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ kher hreng gi mtshan nub ring mo bskyal bar glu gzhas shig gi skyo rogs mkho na yang /sems kyi 'dun pa mtshon zhing dungs zhen gyis kun nas brlan pa'i gzhas tshig cig la gsan thub rgyu ni rus sbal gyi spu red/ bod kyi glu ba tsho'i khrod na/rang re'i rol mo'i ma 'ongs par rkang btsugs nas gsar gtod kyi spobs pa mnga' ba'i gzhas pa ci tsam yod/ bod kyi rol mo 'di'i bzang cha dang zhan char nges shes 'drongs te 'byung 'gyur gyi gnas bab la bsam blo gtong shes mkhan ga tsam mchis gom pa spo nus pa nas bro 'khrab pa dang / skad cha bshad thub pa nas glu len thub ces pa'i gdeng 'jog byed stangs 'di don la gnas pa zhig e — 91 —

red/ sngar srol ltar da dung yang don la gnas so zhes bshad na/ ngas ni/khyod la 'di ltar mi brjod ka med yin te/ khyod kyis sgyu rtsal brtsams chos la dma' 'bebs byed kyin 'dug ces zer nges/spyi lo2007lo'i zla10pa'i tshes1la/

khri sprasgaspo /ma 5tshuslu5mi /'dra5pas padapa/5spyis khyozhi rtswal5 t+t+waṃ snyog5phusgi//pardza/snyardza srid5 smro/da/ rdza /9skru5zhitshon5 na5de5ni5 khri ha5cang5smyun 5ldanayazhisdi yin/ spra /tsophapho rardzaphaspon ‘ sdirardza5gis/ 'khyordzas na chog5gi t+pāci 'dren byed/

rang la bka' drin che ba'i gna' myi skor zhig bskyar dpan brgyab pa'i〈khab〉kyi nyams len ni/ nga rang lam la chas pa'i byis dus kyi gom pa dang po yin la/〈mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho〉rang gi da lta ba dang lag len gyi nye sar bcar ba ni/ po gsar snang ba'i sna mgo nas chas pa'i bdag gi gom pa gnyis pa yin/bden pa mthar thug tses pa'i rwa co lta bu'i skad cha zad po dag gis stobs kyis 'bar ba'i bdag gi shes rab la dmar 'jing byed srid na/ ngas de la/ khrod kyis pha la pha'i da lta ba dang bu la bu'i da lta ba yod pa'i gnas lugs e shes zhes 'dri 'dang yin/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bdag gi snying stobs kyis bod yul skyod pa'i le'u/gcig hūṃng bsam khrod kyi 'phag 'tshag‘‘gang zag yin na 'tshang rgya rung yin pas khyab’’ces lung tshig snyan mo zhig la blo sems khen pa nas rang nyid la thob 'os pa'i mnga' thang dang dus tshod dag stong bsam ring mo zhig gi 'gyur khugs kyi bar na 'bor gyin yod/bod pa tsho/ bsam blo zhib mo zhig thongs dang / da lta nga tshos rang nyid dang thag nye ba'i 'tsho ba legs po zhig 'khyong gi med na/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhes pa'i tha snyad de gang zhig la 'dogs dgos pa 'u tshos shes rgyu e red/‘‘chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin’’zer/ 'o na rtswa chu kham gang dang zhing sa mtho gang gi ched du rang gi nang myi yin yang dmar gsod byed thub pa'i dus der chos la dad pa'i myi rigs 'di'i rgyud kyi snying rje zhes pa gang du bud song ba red/mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du ma ṇi bton nas dus tshod skyel ba'i — 95 —

'dren byed/bod pa tsho ya/ mar gyur sems can gyi don du mar gyur sems can shan pa'i lag tu sprad nas lha rten mchod gsum dang sprul sku'i 'dug khang sogs bzhengs na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhes pa 'thob nges ni e red/ ‘‘bod la bsod nams che bas chos dar yod’’zer/ bod la de 'dra'i bsod nams yod na/ da lta'i skya chad sngo sdug gi bod myi'i gnas bab 'di gang nas byung ba red/ ‘‘bod la chos dad yod’’rabs zer/ bod la chos dad yod na bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther du bkod pa'i dmar bo khrag gi gtam rgyud 'di dag gang nas byung ba red/ chos la dad na snying rje dgos/ snying rje yod na zhi bde yang yod na 'grig gi red/ ngas 'dir bshad 'dod pa ni/ bod myis nang chos la bzung ba'i 'du shes de 'du shes ltar snang ba zhig red/bod myis nang chos la slo ba pa'i dmigs yul de stong bsam gyi dmigs yul zhig red/ bod myi rigs la chos dad che zhes pa de yang skyag rdzun zhig red/rgyu mtshan mi la ras pa lta bu gcig la sa ma byung ba 'di dang / 'khrug rtsod mang 'ing mthun sgril med pa/ da dung rig gnas gsar brje lta bu'i gnad 'gag gi skabs su slebs na dad pa'i sgal tshigs ma lhod pa'i bod mi du tsam yod pa kun gyis shes ni red/ de'i phyir chos ni bod myi tsho sdug la thug dus kyi sems pa khen sa tsam las bod myi tshos chos rnal ma zhig 'grub kyi med ki — 96 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/zer rgyu de yin/ ‘‘dad pa med’’ces drang mo drang gtam du brjod na‘6lta log ltas ngan’’zhes 'ur 'ur gyis sgrogs mod/ don gyis nang ba'i chos gzhung nas bstan pa'i lhad med pa'i dad pa can gyi bod myi dkon po red/ nang bstan rig gnas zhes pa rig gnas yang dag cig yin pa nga la mtshon na khas mi len thabs med dang / khas len na'ang 'dod ki rgyu mtshan rang gis de la thos gzhigs nyung tsam byed myong ba'i brgyud rim khrod rang gis mi nus pa tsam las snying bo med pa zhig red gtan nas ma bsam thal/ 'on kyang mi nus pa'i bya ba 'i/ga la u tshugs kyis 'tham nas myi tshe brlags pa las/ myi'i spyi tshogs su zhugs nas rang nyid dang thag nye ba'i las ka re gnyer na legs po red/ bod myi tsho myi'i khyim gzhis nas bsdad de dgra bcom pa'i rmi lam skyid po re rmis nas bsdad yod pas/ ngas 'di la‘‘stong bsam khrod kyi 'phag 'tshag’’ces brjod pa yin/ bod pa tshos don mi shes pa'i nang bstan la nyams nyes btang nas dad pa yod rabs bshad de nyi ma skyel thabs dang thang ma skem thabs byed ki 'dug bod pa tshos nang bstan rig gnas kyi phyi shun tsam las mthong gi med na yang / grub 'bras thob ma myong ba'i stong bsam 'di'i ched du mi rigs kyi srid 'byor rig gsum bya ba'i 'gan khur mang bo zhig la do snang ma byas pas tshad 'di la lhung ba red/ chos lugs — 97 —

'dren byed/rig gnas kyis nang rkyen byas nas 'jig rten khyim pa ba'i tshad 'di la lhung dus/ nga tshos chos legs po zhig 'khyongs yod na de yang chog gi 'on kyang da lta'i dus su chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang yang 'khyongs med pa mthong na nga tshos yang bskyar sngon chad kyi lam la snyeg pa ni glen rtags tshad med cig yin pa shes par gyis shig bod pa tsho/ ngas nam yang tshad med pa'i glen rtags 'di las khyed cag sad par bsgug yod/ sad par snying nas bsgug yod/ bsgug nas yun ring 'gor yod/gnyis/ rang don rang gis 'khrongs na chogang tsho'i skor zhig rang don legs po zhig 'grub ki med sa na gzhan don la the gtogs byed par ha cang dga' bo 'dug dper na nga tsho'i bod kyi sprul grwa skor zhig khyim pa'i bya bar the gtogs byed par dga' ba dang / khyim pa mang bo yang sprul grwa'i las don la sems khral byed rgyur de bas kyang dga'/ngas nye lam 'di ltar bsam gi yod/ 'jig rten khyim pa ba zhig la mtshon na dpyod shes sngon du song ste/ chung sa nas khyim tshang dang rang gi gnyen nye/che sa nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab sogs 'phel rgyas kyi don du rang nyid gzhan las 'phags par 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang yod tshad rang la 'thob par — 98 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bsam pa'i rang snang / rang phyogs gces par 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi 'du shes bcas ni yod 'os pa zhig red/ dmigs rgyang ring sa zhig dang nang bstan rig gnas kyi bsam blo lta bu'i ngos nas 'dang brgyab na de dag spangs bya zhig yin na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang 'gran rtsod kyi dus rabs 'di lta bu'i khrod kyi khyim pa ba zhig la mtshon na de 'dra'i bkag rgya'i khrod de nas cis kyang sgrol dgos/ gal te de ltar ma gro'akyi tshe nga tsho'i mgo bo 'di nam yang yar 'gyogs thub kyi ma red/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs la 'phel rgyas dal ba ni nga tsho'i myi la nus pa med pas red/ myi la nus pa med don ni ched las sna gcig la 'bad brtson byed ma thub pas red/ dper na sprul grwa tsho khyim pa'i nang du bsres nas chos ma 'grub/ khyim pa tsho chos pa'i gras su bsres nas 'jig rten 'khor ba ma 'khyongs pa 'di lta bu red/ myi zhig gi nus pa de ched las sna gcig gi steng du bkod na da gzod ched las kyi myi sna nus pa can zhig 'khyongs kyi red/ de ltar ma byas na/ dper na slob ma myong ba med cing / mthar ded na ci yang mi shes pa'i nga dang nga lta bu'i bod kyi slob chen pa tsho lta bu red/ de'i phyir sprul grwa yin na chog khyimaji pa ba yin yang rung /thams cad kyis rang don rang gis 'khyongs na chog nas 'dug de ltar min par deng skabs sprul grwa skor mang bos rang gi ched las phal bar bzhag — 99 —

'dren byed/nas khyim pa ba'i khrod nas khom gi mi 'jug pa'i bya ba sna tshogs re btsal te/chos yin rabs kyi nyog gtam mang bos khyim pa ba tsho'i sems khams kyang 'thom sbrid du btang 'dug khyim pa ba tsho chos la ji ltar dad kyang / chos don rdul phran tsam yang ma mthong bas kho tshos rang nyid kyi spyi tshogs 'di yang chos mi 'grub sa 'jig rten mi 'khyongs pa zhig tu btang ba red/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba de khyim pa ba'i chos nyid red la/ 'khor ba snying bo med par lta ba ni chos lugs kyi dgongs don red/ khyim pa ba zhig gis chung ma dang bu phrug gi nye sa nas 'khor bar snying bo med rabs bshad nas nyi ma skyel ba ni chos kyi gras su mi 'gro la/ khyim pa ba'i gnas tshul dang yang mi mthun no/ /de bzhin du khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i sprul grwa de tshos kyang cho/ rtsis lung gsum dang grong chog gi las la gzhol gzhol nas phyug thog la bud rjes dgon pa nas chung ma med pa'i khyim gzhis chen po re bskrun cing / bu phrug med pa'i 'khor ba'i klong rim na mgo bo 'thom nas 'dugaspyir na dgon pa zhes pa ni 'khor ba'i zang zing dang thag ring ba'i gnas dben pa zhig yin na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang da lta'i bod kyi sprul grwa phal mo ches bu rgyud med pa'i 'khor ba'i longs spyod chen po zhig dgon pa'i gling na rol gyin 'dug ngas 'di la‘‘rgyud med 'khor ba’’zhes/ su 'bod kyin yod/— 100 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/spyir na bod la nga rgyal byed chog pa'i rig gnas shig yod pa ni nang bstan rig gnas red/ rig gnas 'dis 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi gras su yang go sa mi dman pa zhig bzung 'dug ces brjod na thal mi che mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i myi rigs la mtshon na rig gnas de mthun rkyen du 'gro ba las gegs rkyen du song ba shugs che bas tshad 'dir lhu nga ba red/ nye lam chos lugs phyogs zhen pa mang bo zhig gis chos lugs rig gnas rang ngos kyi dge mtshan mang bo bsdod nas mgo bo mtho mtho byed kyin 'dug kho tshos chos lugs rig gnas rang ngos kyi khyad chos tsam brjod pa las de'i 'dzad spyod mkhan bod myi tshor bsam gzhigs byas med par ma zad/ chos lugs rig gnas 'bab sa'i yul te bod myi sger gyi 'gro 'dug spyod gsum ya nga ba mang bo zhig mthong gi med pa'am sbed de brjod kyin 'dug don dngos su nga tsho bod myi re re'i chos/ lugs la bzung ba'i 'du shes de nang bstan rig gnas kyi rtsa ba'i gnad la gtan nas phog thub kyi med ki rgyu mtshan kho tsho'i brgya cha'i brgyad cu yan chad kyi bsam blo'i ngos na nang bstan rig gnas zhes pa phyag 'tshal sa zhig dang skor ba rgyag sa zhig tu chags 'dug go/ de'i phyir kho tshor chos dad yod ces pa de gna' nas brgyud yong ba'i yul srol goms gshis lta bu zhig yin pa las/ don gyis bltas na nang bstan rig gnas dang bod kyi khyim pa — 101 —

'dren byed/ba'i bar thag ha cang ring gi nga tshos 'di ltar don dngos la bltas te skad cha drang mo zhig bshad na 'grig pa las/ rang nyid chos lugs pa zhig yin pa'i cha dang / chos lugs la dga' zhen che ba tsam gyis don dngos bskyur nas lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mang bos rang phyogs dkar 'don byed pa la snying bo ma mchis so/ /chos lugs la dga' zhing chos lugs 'khyongs ni zhig la mtshon na khyim pa'i las don mtha' dag ring du dor nas chos legs por sgrub na snying bo 'dug de min chos don gsal bor ma shes shing / chos legs po mi 'khyongs pa'i nga dang nga lta bu dag gis dgon sde zhig nas mdzes ma dang 'khor ba'i longs spyod la 'gram chu lkog myid byas te bsdad cing / de 'dra'i bu rgyud med pa'i 'khor ba zhig la 'khor te sdom khrims kyi na zug myangs nas phyi tshul rdzun ma zhig gis gzhan la mgo skor btang nas nyi ma gtong ba las/bu rgyud yod pa'i 'khor ba zhig nyams su myangs nas rang gi rang gzugs drang mor bstan na 'grig gi bsam/ bu rgyud gson du bcug ma bcug pa'i khyad par tsam las shākya thub pa'i mthong lam nas de gnyis 'khor ba yin pa 'dra 'dra yin la/ snying bo med pa ya nga 'dra 'dra yin nges so/ /myi su zhig yin rung rang nyid kyi zhen phyogs dang 'tshams pa'i dmigs yul re yod dgos/dmigs yul de ni chos kyi bya ba yin na yang chog 'jig rten gyi bya yin — 102 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/na'ang rung / gang ltar rang gi las ka de'i phyir du 'bad brtson lhod med cig bgyis nas don zhig 'khyongs na de las lhag pa mi 'dug go/ de min bod kyi sprul grwa skor zhig khyim pa ba'i don la the gtogs byed par dga' zhing /khyim pa 'ga' re dgon sde dang grwa ba'i bya bar the gtogs byed rgyur ha cang dga' bo 'dug pa dag ni gong gsal ltar red/ yang dper na khyim pa ba zhig gis‘‘bdag la dad pa med’’ces brjod na de ni ha cang rgyun ldan zhig red mod/ 'on kyang sprul grwa rang sar 'dug mi bzod pa mang bo zhig gis de la lta log ltas ngan zhes 'ur rgyag gin 'dug kho tsho'i rjes su ma 'brang na lta ba log pas khyab pa med la ltas ngan yin pa'i nges pa de bas kyang med do/ /yang dper na dgon pa nas 'dug 'dod ma byung ba'i myi bu zhig skya sar babs na de la khyim pa ba mang bos ngan smras byed pa'i lugs srol zhig chags 'dugabatsun gzugs 'chal bo zhig dang drang bden skyong ba'i khyim pa ba gnyis phan tshun bsdur na kho tsho'i mig lam du don gang yang mi 'khyongs pa'i btsun gzugs 'chal bo de legs par bsam pa kho thag yin/ 'di'i ngos thad nas kho tshos phar chos lugs la bzung ba'i 'du shes mthong thub la/ 'du shes de 'dra chags pas chos lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dis tshur kho tshor nus stobs ci 'dra zhig bstsal yod pa yang shugs nas rtogs yong ngo / /mdor na — 103 —

'dren byed/khyim pa ba tshos chos don mi shes bzhin du rang don dor ba de bod khams yongs kyi gnad don las gnad don tshabs chen zhig red ces pa dang / da lta kha tsha dgos gtug tu mkho ba ni bod myi zhig la mtshon na‘‘rang don rang gis 'khyongs’’dgos pa de yin par 'dod do/ /rang nyid kyi phrag tu babs pa'i 'os 'gan de legs par 'khyongs song na gakhyo/na gyis ci zhig byed par bkag 'gog dang the gtogs byed don rtsa ba nas med do/ /gsum/ lta log pa/ngas bod yul na lha ba dang mo ba'i 'u/nga bstan ma gtogs drang gtam bshad sa med pa sngon nas shes yod/ drang mo drang rkyang gis sems pa gcer bur phud pa'i dam pa sngon ma dag gis pham kha ci zhig myangs pa'i lo rgyus dag kyang go yod/ yin na'ang ngas rang nyid la yod 'os pa'i lta tshul gsar ba 'ga' re snying nas brjod de bskyar zlos dang ther zug gi 'tsho ba'i gad snyigs klong na lhod lhod kyis gnyid du yur ba'i bod pa tshang gi sad rtogs la bsgug yod/ bdag la re ba yod/ bdag la snying stobs yod/ bdag la pham kha yod/ ngas 'di dag tham sa cad rang gi las 'gan rdu brtsis yod/ngas 'di dag thams cad ha cang rgyun ldan du bzung yod/ lus bod nas — 104 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho skyes dus sems bod la mi 'khor rang 'khor red/ sems bod la 'khor dus na skya chad sngo sdug gi bod mi'i 'tsho stangs 'di'i thad la sems gtam drang mo re mi bshad rang bshad red/ drang bshad byas pa thal drags na bod myi bgres po tsho'i mig nang gi lta log ltas ngan du 'gyur 'gro ba 'u tsho bod la mtshon na ha cang rgyun 'byams su chags 'dug kha cig gis lta log pa zhes pa ha cang tshabs chen zhig tu 'dod kyin 'dug yin na'ang bod kyi spyi tshogs snang tshul la bltas te brjod na lta log pa ni gsar gtod pa dang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs red/ lta log pa ni rang sems gcer bur phud pa'i drang gtam bshad mkhan de tsho red/ da dung bod kyi chos srid gnyis las srid phyogs kyi bya bar do khur byed pa'i 'jon myi de dag la yang lta log pa zhes brjod kyin 'dug mdor na kho tsho'i lta ba ni chos lugs kyi gdong 'bag rdzus ma zhig gyon nas gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi gcin skyag yang 'thung bskyar 'thung byed rgyu de red/ gal te rtogs sad pa su zhig de las 'gongs na de la nang bstan rig gnas kyis mtshon pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas gang legs re spyad de‘‘lta log ltas ngan’’zhes pa'i ku co sgrog la dga' mod/don dngos su kho tshos rang nyid kyi bsam spyod la phyi shun rdzus ma zhig bskon pa tsam las/ mthar thug gi lta ba log min de bsdur na 'dra 'dra red/ bod — 105 —

'dren byed/ nyi phal mo ches‘‘lta ba log song’’zhes pa ha cang than ltas shig tu brtsi mod/'on kyang nga la mtshon na‘‘lta ba log song’’zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dis‘‘gnyid las sad byung’’zhes pa lta bu'i spro snang dang gson shugs gsar ba zhig bskyal yong /rgyu mtshan bod la mtshon na lta log pa zhes pa ni rnying zhen dang bag 'khum gyi rgya las thar ba zhig dang / yang na bslu brid kyi rdzu bag phud pa'i drang bden gyi slong mo ba dag la brjod pa mang ba las/ rang nyid kyi ston pa spangs nas ston pa gzhan zhig gi lta bar log pa lta bu ma yin pas so/ /yang gcig bshad na rang nyid 'tsho sdod byed sa'i khor yug gi rkyen dang slob gso'i rkyen/ myi bu rang steng nas chags pa'i bsam gzhig gi rkyen bcas kyis myi re rer thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba re yod na 'grig pa las/ bod myi yin tshad tshang ma nang chos kho nar dad zhen dgos pa dang / gal te dad zhen med tshe lta log pa zhes ngan dmod byed pa'i srol 'di ni bod myi'i lo rgyus thog gi ches ya nga ba'i bya spyod cig red/ nga la mtshon na ches bzod par dka' ba ni/ bod khams nas sger tshugs kyi klad pa bkol spyod byas tshe lta ba log pa zhes kun gyis rig sa med pa 'di red/ yin na'ang nga la 'di las lhag pa'i lam gang yang gdam rgyu med/— 106 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bzhi/ nub byang dang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob chen/slob chen 'di gnyis ni rgyal nang la mtshon nas bltas na bod yig slob chen cung legs shos gnyis red/ slob chen 'di gnyis kyi dge rgan gyis slob gso gtong phyogs mi 'dra ba'am slob ma rang gis slob gso dang len byed stangs mi 'dra bas/ phyogs gnyis kyi slob ma phal che bar ldog phyogs kyi lta tshul thun mong ma yin pa re chags 'dug dper na mtsho sngon mi rigs slob chen lta bur mtshon na srol rgyun rig gnas te lhag par du chos lugs rig gnas kyi phyogs su lhung ba shugs che la/ nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma skor zhig gi lta tshul de kho tsho las ldog ste srol rgyun gyi bag chags rnying ba dor nas rig gnas gsar ba'i phyogs su lhung ba cung shugs che/ 'di ni slob chen 'di gnyis kyi 'gal 'du yin la thun min gyi khyad chos kyang red/ da dung lha sa'i pang khugs na dbyin yig gi tha snyad 'ga'i gseng du 'thim bzhin pa'i bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo dang / ming byang stong ba zhig khur nas pe cin gyi mkha' dbugs khrod du nub bzhin pa'i krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ ‘‘byar grag rgyu dang byi long la 'bur rgyu med pa'i’’lhing 'jags kyi lho nub mi rigs slob chen lta bur bsdur na gong gi slob chen 'di gnyis ni— 107 —

'dren byed/‘‘bod’’ces pa'i tha snyad 'di'i bro ba ma yal ba'i gnas shig dang / ‘‘'gan 'khri'i 'du shes’’kyi sgal tshigs yod pa'i khor yug gnyid la ma shor ba gnyis kyang red/ (ngas 'dir brjod pa ni shes brtson gyi las kar dam gyis 'tham pa'i slob grogs de dag yin pa las/ slob chen gyi ming byang tsam khur ba'i rnga ma med pa'i spyang ltogs tsho 'di'i gras su mi 'du'o)phal cher ldog bsdur du grub pa'i slob chen 'di gnyis kyi lta ba'i thad nas nga tsho'i bod kyi shes yon pa mang bo zhig gi ngo gdong la yang bskyar zhib lta zhig byas na 'grig po 'dug dper na slob grwa 'di gnyis kyi slob ma mang phyogs shig la bsam blo gtong phyogs rigs mi mthun pa re yod pa der shi 'tham ro 'tham byas nas rang nyid kyi bsam blo'i ngos gcig pur lta ba las/ kho tshos gzhan gyi lta ba'i ngos nas shes yon tshur len gyi bsam blo'i sgo glegs la lcags zwa chen po re brgyab 'dug 'di ni gdod ma nas da lta'i bar du bod kyi shes yon pa dag la byung ba'i 'gos nad rigs shig red/ yang 'dir nub byang mi rigs slob chen lta bur mtshon nas bshad na/ spyir btang rig gnas gsar ba'i mkha' dbugs stug cing / mi gzhi'i rtsis thang la gdeng 'jog cung mtho ba'i drin gyis slob ma tshor bsam blo'i cha nas rang dbang gi khor yug cig chags yod/ rnying dgag gsar gleng gi rig gnas khor yug 'di na slob ma phal che bas‘‘chos ni — 108 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/choṭashrī rang sa nas 'jig rten khyim pa ba'i khrod du mi mdza'/ 'jig rten ni 'jig rten rang sa nas chos kyi gras su mi mthun pa'i’’chos srid tha dad kyi rig gnas snying stobs shig mthor 'degs byas te/ sad dka' ba'i rang sde'i mi rigs 'dir dogs slong gi dar cha yang yang bsgrengs myong / sku zhabs zhogs dung so gas myi bu drug po dang spyi tshogs khrod bod kyi nye rabs rig gnas gsar ba gleng mkhan tshor mtshon na slob grwa 'di ni kho tsho'i bsam gzhigs kyi sa bon 'debs sa'i gshin sa dang yid ches kyi snye ma 'khrungs pa'i ston ljongs gcig pu yin/ de yang〈〈shar dung ri〉dang〈〈lang tsho'i gom 'gros〉lta bu'i rang dbang gi smra brjod la myi don gyi skyid sdug gleng sa'i dus deb dang tshags par yod 'a// lhag par du slob grwa 'di na dge rgan bdud lha rgyal zhes pa'i myi jus bsam blo'i sne khrid pa zhig yod pas slob ma mang phyogs shig gis‘‘myi’’zhes pa'i go don la bsam gzhigs gsar bas bskyar du go ba gzhan zhig blangs nas/ myi la myi'i 'tsho ba mkho ba'i re snyeg gi 'bod skad gsar ba re btang myong / 'di ltar myi jus lte bar smras nas gsar brje byed stangs ni bod la mtshon na khri srong lde btsan nas da lta'i bar du bod nang khul nas byung ma thub pas/ bod myi bgres po tshos 'di la lta log pa zhes pa'i mtshang mying nas mgo bzung ste rim bzhin je btsog je sdug tu btang nas da lta thabs zad — 109 —

'dren byed/ de gsang nyul ba zhes 'bod kyin 'dug lhag par du khyim pa ba'i khrod du btsan gyis 'tshang bzhin pa'i sprul grwa skor zhig gis rang nyid thub bstan rig gnas kyi bden pa'i rgyab tu sbas te bod kyi gsar skyes myi jus smra ba'am myi jus ring lugs pa'i dpung khag 'di la 'bur 'joms mang bo btang myong /de las ldog pa'i mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling la mtshon na srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rdzong mthug cing / nang bstan rig gnas la rtsis thang che bas chos lugs ni myi chos dang chos lugs ni tshan rig yin par smra zhing / lhag par du bod kyi spyi tshogs 'di chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam du song na legs par smra ba'i ngage slob shin tu mang / de'i phyir gzhi rim bod myi'i spyi tshogs dang dgon sde so so na slob gling 'di la ma the bong bsgreng mkhan mang du mchis la/ 'dis gna' srol gyi gseng na gnyid du yur ba'i 'u tshang gi da lta'i gnas bab mtshon no/ / 'di ltar tha dad du gyur ba'i phyogs lhung 'di la bltas te ngas bod kyi slob chen pa tshor sger tshugs kyi bsam blo med ki zhes bshad ni yin/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ nub byang nas myi jus kyi phyogs su hol rgyug byed cing / mtsho sngon nas thub bstan rig gnas kyi 'og tu mgo bo dud pa'i snang tshul 'di phal cher gcig gyur red/ (grags 'gul med pa'i slob chen pa lhag ma tsho 'di'i gras su mi the)'o na mtsho sngon naso ci'i phyir rnying dgag gsar gleng byed — 110 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/pa'i myi bu ma skyes pa redalha nub byang na ci'i phyir chos srid zung 'brel smra ba'i skyes bu med song ba redalha tshul 'di la bltas na da gzod bod kyi slob chen pa tsho khor yug dang nege rgan gang rung zhig gi dbang bsgyur tsam la brten nas 'dug pa las/ sger tshugs kyi bsam blo'i dar cha bsgrengs mkhan med pa shes thub ki lhag par du bod kyi shes yon pa gzhan dag gtso byas pa'i slob chen 'di gnyis kyi gling na 'gying ba'i shes yon pa tshor rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi chu tshad ha cang ha cang dma' gi dper na rgyal btsugs dus gnang gi skabs shig la de ga'i grogs po 'ga'i bskul ngor nga rang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling du kha brda zhig byed du song ni yin/ thog mar ngas rang nyid mtshams sbyor byas te nga nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma zhig yin rabs bshad pa nas de ga'i slob grogs skor zhig gis‘‘bdud lha rgyal gyi bdud phrugasangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo/ zhogs dung gi rgyug khyi/ lta log pa ltas ngan ’’zhes nga la bsam blo'i bden pa las sdig dmod mang ba'i bgro gleng thengs shig byas myong / de bzhin du nub byang mi rigs slob chen na yang kho tshor‘‘mtsho sngon mi rigs slob glingad wadage lugs pa'i dgon sde lhag ma’’zhes sogs bshad tshul mang bo 'dug go/ 200ṭ+wāṃ 1 1nyin lung drug grong khyer nas bris/— 111 —

'dren byed/dgra bo gcer bur phud pa'i mdo dang po/nye ba'i lo 'di dag gi ring la bod kyi sprul grwa skor zhig gi kha las rlung rta rgya nang na dar bzhin 'dug kho tshos mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang dam pa gong ma dag gi mtshan snyan btsong nas rang gi sgor khug je mthug nas je mthug tu gtong si/ yod la/ nyin dkar grwa chas dang bla chas gtsang ma re gyon nas bod skad tshig gcig kyang mi go ba'i rgya phyug rmongs dad mkhan dag la lung rtogs gnyis kyi khongs su mi gtogs pa'i chos 'khor gang 'dod du bskor zhing / mtshan mo'i dus su yo na bdag phyug po tsho'i 'bul ba rim du bcug ste chang khang sgo byang dmar po can nga/ga na bud med dang a rag mnyam du 'thung bzhin skyug bro ba'i mdzad pa gnang gin 'dug kho bo dag ni su yin zhe na/rang gi lha sde dang dgon sde nas bstan pa ma dar zhing da lta rgya grong na 'gro don — 112 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/mdzad bzhin pa'i sprul grwa‘‘sngon thon pa’’de dag red/ klog pa po lags/ngas 'dir ched du kho tsho gcer bur phud nas bdag la glo snying nye ba'i mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi bla btsong bar dgra sha rgya mtsho'i chu thigs tsam zhig len na 'dod ki yod/sa smad 'tshong ma'i myos bum dang g.ya' chu'i dri ma byugs pa'i zag bcas kyi lus po spyir btang ba zhig kha dog yid du 'ong ba'i bla chas sam grwa chas shig gis legs par btum ste/ ha cang yin mdog gis byang chub sems dpa' lta bu'i mig zung btsum nas yon bdag phyug po tsho'i sgor khug gi kha na dbang lung rdzun ma mang bo gnang gi yod tshul de don dngos red/ 2 nga ni bod pa yin/ nga ni bod kyi sprul sku'am yang na grwa ba yin/ nga ni bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dag byang du chub pa'i bsam blo ba'am dge bshes shig yin rabs bshad nas bod kyi gnas tshul la cha rgyus gsal bo med pa'i rgya rgan phyug bdag tsho'i yid kyi dang ba 'gug ci thub byed cing / don gyis kho tshos bod kyi rig gnas zhes pa'i mgo rnga gang yin pa yang shes kyi med pa don dngos red/— 113 —

'dren byed/ bu kho tshos rang gi lha sde dang dgon sde bskyur nas rgya grong zhig tu thon dus chos pa rdzun ma zhig gam yang na tshong ba rdzun ma zhig tu brdzus te sgor mo kho na bsam gyin yod/ rtog bzos chos 'khor bskor ba'am/ rdzun bzo byas pa'i dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang stag gi sder mo btsong ba sogs kyis rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang thon rdzas kyi snang brnyan gad snyigs su 'dor bzhin pa de ni ci 'dra'i bzod thabs bral ba'i don dngos zhig red ang /2 kho tshos rang nyid la gsang ba'i yum chen rol ba'i lha mchog gang zhig gi mying byang btags te 'a nga tsho dar la babs pa'i rgya mo gang yag tsho 'dems nas 'di mkha' 'gro ma zhig gi sprul ba red zer bzhin rang gi gsang yum du 'os tshul gyis dbang bskur gyin mchis/ don dngos su gsang bde 'jigs gsum lta bu'i lha mchog de dag gi mtshan byang khur nas 'khrig spyod kho na bsam gyin redugabhu kho tshos nyin dkar dge 'dun pa'i gzugs ras gyon nas chos 'don pa dang chos 'khor skor ba sogs kyis sgor rdog 'ga' lag tu 'byor ci thub — 114 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/byed/ mtshan mo gzan sham bskyur nas smad 'tshong ma dang lbu rag gi ro bcud kyis bzi nas rang nyid su zhig yin pa'ang shes ki mi 'dug skad/ kho tsho 'di ltar rgya khog cig nas rgya mo smad 'tshong ma tsho'i brla sha dang nu ma'i bar nas 'phag 'phag ste phyir rang sar thon dus sha mdangs je dkar du song zhing grwa chas kyang gtsang ma zhig gyon yod/ da dung la ga tu kha par dang par chas spus legs re thogs nas ha cang yin mdog gis pha yul gyi yul mi tsho'i mig lam nas rdzig nyams 'jigs su rung ba re ston nges so/ /ṣ+ṭa kho tshor dwangs gtsang gi sdom pa med la nges gtan gyi chung ma yang med/kho tshor bstan pa skyong gi bsam pa med la 'khor ba skyong gi nus pa yang med/kho tshos grwa chas gyon nas tshul khrim/sa srung mi thub la grwa chas phud na rang kha yang gso mi thub/ kho tshos ston pa'i mnabs bza' rtsed chas byas pa'i nyes dmigs mi bsam la mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren byas pa'i ngo tsha yang mi bsam/ smras pa ngas 'di ltar mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi dgra bo ngo ma 'ga' gcer bur phud nas khyed cag klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar dmar rjen du bstan na/khyed cag la yang sad rtogs gsar ba re yod par zhu/ nye ba'i bgrang bya 'di — 115 —

'dren byed/dag gi ring la lha chos rmongs dga' ba skor mang bos‘‘lta log pa’’zhes pa'i dmod tshig gi mtshon cha btang nas bod myi'i spyi tshogs khrod kyi rtogs sad pa skad cha drang mo bshad mkhan skor zhig gzhom gzhig gtong gi 'dug gal te kho tshos lha rten mchod gsum rdul du brlag cing lha khang mchod khang me ru bsregs pa lta bu'i dbang du btang rung / de ni dogs slong tsamyo/ las lha chos rig gnas la gnod rgyu ci yang med/ da dung kho tsho'i sems gting na mi rigs kyi las don zhes pa'i lhag bsam gtsang ma zhig yod la/ lha chos dang 'brel ba med pa'am mi spyod pa dag gis lha chos rig gnas la ci yang mi nus so/ / bstan dgra ngo ma de lha chos 'dzad spyod pa'i dbus su 'gying nas yod/bstan dgra gtso bo de sprul grwa'i gzugs brnyan mang sa na bskung nas yod/mdor na bstan pa bshig pa'i nus shugs gtso bo lha chos 'dzad spyod pa rang nyid dang nye sa na yod par snyam pas 'di ltar smras pa lags so/ /2 0 07 6 2 2nyin lung drug grong khyer nas bris/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/'phya dmod rig gnas kyi 'ching sgrog gtor ba/dang po/ bkag sdom dang bag 'khum gyi snang tshul/'das zin pa'i lo rgyus kyis nga tshor bden dpang byed thub pa ni/bod la myi sger gyi bsam blo'i dar cha bsgrengs te kher tshugs thub pa'i myi bu rang gshis can dkon pa 'di red/ gal te gzhan zhig gis nga la gnad don 'di'i rgyu rkyen dris na/ ngas de la‘‘nga tsho bod la 'phya dmod rig gnas zhes pa'i thun min gyi rig gnas shig dar bas tshad 'di la lhung ba red’’zer 'dang yin/ spyir btang 'phya dmod rig gnas 'di la dge mtshan gtan nas med pa ma red mod/ 'u tsho bod la mtshon na 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi go don dang lag len khrod nas myi bu'i bsam gzhigs kyi sgal tshigs brdungs shing / mi bu'i kher tshugs kyi dar cha bcag bod mi'i 'phya dmod rig — 117 —

'dren byed/gnas kyis bod myi sa ya drug gi lhad med kyi myi gshis dang / sger tshugs kyi mgo bo sa la bsres nas bud song / 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi btsan 'dzul 'og nas blo rig rnam dpyod can gyi myi bu khri stong du ma'i mdun skyod kyi gom kha rdo la btegs shing / gsar gtod kyi snying stobs khrag la bsgres song /bod myi mang bor gcig gyur gyi dga' phyogs shig yod pa ni/ mdzub mo ker nas gzhan la 'phya dmod byed rgyu de red/ lhag par du gsar gtod dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sger gshis mthong na kho tsho gtan nas dga' mi srid/'phya dmod rig gnas kyi byed thabs spyad nas de dag rtsa med du gtong ci thub byed cing / 'phya dmod rig gnas ni bod kyi myi bu re re'i legs nyes 'jal byed kyi tshad thig red/ bod mi mang phyogs shig phar gzhan la 'phya dmod byed par shin tu dga' zhing / tshur gzhan gyis 'phya dmod byed par ha cang skrag bod myi tsho gna' nas lobs pa'i goms srol la ha cang dga'/ g.ya te myi bu su zhig de las 'da' 'gongs byas tshe kho tshos mtha' gcig tu 'phya dmod rig gnas kyis 'bur 'joms gtong srid/ spyir na bod la myi bu sger tshugs can dang / myi bu gsar brje ba/ myi bu sna 'dren pa/ myi bu bsam blo gsar ba can sogs ma byung ni ma red/ kho tsho tshang ma‘‘'phya dmod’’ces pa'i 'u tsho'i rig gnas 'dis rtsa med du btang song ba red/ ngas nam ge 118 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/yang bod kyi rig gnas gsar ba dang / 'phel rgyas gsar ba'i bkag rdo'i mtshan ga'i/ gtso bo la/ 'phya ba dang dmod pa'i bsdus tshig ste 'phya dmod rig gnas 'di bzhag ni yin/ sngon thon mi rigs dang 'u tsho'i mi rigs bar gyi mi 'dra sa gtso bo gang red ce na/ kho tshos thon rdzas gsar ba zhig dang / skad cha gsar ba zhig yang na thun min gyi sger tshugs gsar ba zhig byung na de la gdeng 'jog dang yid smon pyed ni red/ 'u cag bod pa tshang gis de 'dra'i gsar ba thun mong ma yin pa zhig byung na/ bud med tshos mchu tho(sgros)lag pas bskyor nas‘‘'phya’’dgod byed la/ skyes pa tshos gdong la sdigs mdzub ker nas sdig‘‘dmod’’byed srid/ de'i phyir bod kyi sngon byon mkhas dbang mang che bas‘‘sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod med’’ces pa'i khengs skyung gi tshig gcig yang 'don bskyar 'don byed par bltas na/ khong tshor yang 'phya dmod ces pa'i dpyod shes ma song ba'i rig gnas 'di'i gnya' gnon thebs 'dug khong tshos/ gser dang mtshungs pa'i khong cag gi rnam dpyod la bkag sdom byas yod srid/ 'di ltar bod pa tshang 'phya darngo da rig gnas kyi bran du khol bas/ bag 'khum dang rnying zhen che ba/rang gis rang la yid ches med pa/ sger tshugs dang gsar brje'i snying stobs med pa/ gzhan rten gyi bsam pa'i shugs che ba/ rang ngos nas — 119 —

'dren byed/yar mi 'greng bar lad zlos byed par dga' ba'i gshis rgyud ngan pa 'di 'dra zhig chags 'dug 'phya dmod rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i sgang ba bod yul nas/ lung shar tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras bton pa sdig gyong du brtsi la/'dzam gling na dkon pa'i be+eḍūr+ya'i bum pa rdo la brdabs pa snang med du 'jogabod pas bod par 'phya la/ bod pas bod par dmod/ bod pa tsho 'phya dmod rig gnas la dga' 'i/nga / bod pa tsho 'phya dmod rig gnas la skraga'aphya dmod rig gnas kyis bod pa tshor bag 'khum gyi go khrab dgu brtsegs shig bskon/ 'phya dmod rig gnas kyis bod pa tshang gi 'phel rgyas gsar ba'i rnam dpyod la bkag sdom rdzogs med cig byas yod/gnyis pa/ rgyang phud dang bcing grol gyi sgal tshigs/rang nyid kher tshugs su yar 'greng ba'i myi bu zhig la mtshon na 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi 'ching sgrog gtor thub dgos/ 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi bag chags rtsa med du btang na da gzod myi bu'i sger gshis dang / myi bu'i gsar brje'i snying stobs rang skyong byed thub// de'i phyir/ ngas rang nyid nas lag len dngos su zhugs ci thub byas te bod kyi 'phya dmod rig gnas rgyang phud du btang ba yin/ nga'i khor yug nas myi bu su yin yang ngo — 120 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/gnong dgos med/ rgyu mtshan/ ngas 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi bag chags ngan pa mtha' dag rgyang phud du btang tshar/ nga nam yang gzhan la 'phya dmod byed par mi dga'/ de'i phyir/ ngas gzhan gyi 'phya dmod la yang do snang byas ni min/ mi rabs nas mi rabs su/ 'u cag 'phya dmod rig gnas la skrag ste mgo bo 'gyogs ma thub/ 'u cag 'phya dmod rig gnas kyis bsdams te 'da' 'gongs byed ma nus/ 'u cag bod pa tshang na/'phya dmod rig gnas la mgo bo sgur ba'i mkhas pa sdar ma mang la/ 'phya dmod rig gnas la mkhas pa'i glen pa kha bde mang / 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi mdun sa nas/ drang don gleng ba'i myi bu dag ni rtsed chas rigs shig las ci yang min/ de'i phyir nga la 'phya dmod rig gnas rtsa ba nas mi dgos/ 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi khyab khongs nas/ sger gshis can gyi bsam blo ni nam yang glen rtags rigs shig tu btsi/ de'i phyir nga la 'phya dmod rig gnas rgyang phud du gtong ba'i 'dun pa drag tu skyes/ 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi khor yug na/ thams cad tshul 'chos kyis 'tsho zhing lhad med pa'i rang gshis can gcig kyang med/ nga'i a pha 'phya dmod rig gnas la dogs nas da rung lug rdzi byed ki yod/ nga'i a ma 'phya dmod rig gnas la skrag nas da rung lhas ra na mgo bo sgur sgur byas nas bsdad yod/— 121 —

'dren byed/mdor na nged tshang gis 'phya dmod rig gnas kyi gnya' gnod 'og na kun po dang mi 'dra ba'i 'tsho ba gzhan zhig rol thub ki med/ 'phya dmod rig gnas la rgyug che ba'i sgang ba bod yul nas bud med tshos 'dod chags kyi kha chu lkog mid byed pa las/ rang gi dga' ro gas la‘‘nga khyod la dga'’’yang zer ma phod/ 'phya dmod rig gnas yod sa nas myi'i rgyun ldan gyi snang tshul g.yag ('og rlung)cig 'phangs na de yang tshabs che ba'i nag nyes shigalared/nga la lhad med kyi rang gshis ldan pas/ nga la sger tshugs kyi myi gzhi dgos pas/ nga la gsar brje dang rang skyong mkho bas/ nga la rang gi bsam tshul dang rang gi dga' phyogs yod pas 'phya dmod rig gnas la lags so zer don rtsa ba nas med/2007 9 16nyin pe cin nas bris/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/gangs can par phul ba'i shes rab kyi dmar mchod/mdun skyod kyi gom sgra'i khrod du mang bo zhig 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod dus/ bdag gi snying nye ba'i gangs can pa mdun skyod kyi gom sgra re re'i khrod du rgud bzhin yod pa de sus kyang rtogs dka' ba'i gsang ba tshabs chen zhig red ang /'dzum zhal gyi bslu brid re re'i khrod du gangs can pa bzi bzhin 'dug la/ dus rabs kyi 'phel rim re re'i khrod du gangs can pa zad kyin 'dug pa'i skabs 'dir/ bdag gis shes rab kyi dmar mchod khrod nas gangs can pa'i chag 'jig gleng ba las ci yang mi nus kyang / 'on te rang nyid la dbang ba'i rang nyid thog mar gangs can pa legs shos shig tu sgyur rgyu de bdag gi ches thog ma'i las skal gyi gtso bo lags so/ /rang gi pha yul la shes rab kyi dmar mchod phul myong ba'i dam pa snga rol pa dag gis snying nye ba'i bu rabs tsha rgyud la bzhag pa'i me tog gi pho brang re re — 123 —

'drenabyed/ da yar rgyas dang mdun skyod ces pa'i tha snyad kyi rol dbyangs de'i khrod 'jig gin 'dug pas/ bdag gis rang nyid nas 'go brtsams pa'i〈shes rab kyi lag rtsal〉pa mang bo zhig skyed sring byas te〈〈ngos gnyis 'tshol ba'i〉bya 'gul de mtha' 'khyol ba zhig byed dgos/ 'di ni bdag gis gangs can par phul ba'i shes rab kyi dmar mchod las ches thog ma'i blos bslangs lags so/ /shes rab kyi dmar mchod btegs myong ba'i pha sa pha yul dang der 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i yul mi tsho snga mo nas gzhung lugs gang zhig gi dgongs don ltar‘‘rang nyid rang nyid kyi bran g.yog’’tu gyur tshar 'dug pas/ kho tshor rlabs che ba'i btsan po snga rol pa dag gi snying stobs dang mdzad rjes la phyir dran dang / ma 'ongs pa'i rang gi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi bde sdug dang mdun phyogs su bsam blo gtong ba'i khom longs gtan nas med ki de'i phyir bdag gi snying rlung stod du 'tshang ba'i〈〈bsam gzhigs ngos gnyis ma〉zhig gi gri rtse nas rang nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum dmar mchong byas shing / btsan 'dzul gyi rtsa don sil bar gtor nas rang nyid nyes can gyi gras su g.yugs/'di ni bdag gis gangs can par phul ba'i shes rab kyi dmar mchod las hol rgyug byed stangs shig lags so/ /— 124 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rong ba'i a phas lcags khem bzung nas zhing tshigs su bud song bas da dung phyir ma thon thal/ 'brog pa'i a phas nor lug ded nas ri sgang la bud song bas yang phyir ma thon thal/ khyim bdag ma tshos yur ma yur ba'in 'o ma bzho bzhin ha cang gnyom chung gi ngang na khom gi mi 'dug las byed pa tshos rang gi gces phrug dang lhan du bod skad kyang brjed so nga / da dung gzhi rim gyi byis pa mang bo zhig gis ma 'ongs ba'i ched du rang gi pha srol dang pha skad 'bor gyin yod la/ skyug bro ba'i gnas tshul de dag la bltas nas ma gsang drang mor bshad na/ bdag gi shes rab kyi dam ra mchod bzhes pa'i lha tshogs kha ba bzhin mtsho ngos su 'thim bzhi/na 'dug pas/ khrag 'dzar ba'i bdag gi shes rab de slar yang a thang chad pa'i brang khog tu lhung song /yin na'ang tshe srog gi mjug ma rdzogs bar dud wabadagagi shes rabad waro langasad wa gangs can pa lags so/ /'dzum bzhin pa'i zhal ras de ha cang skog gyur yin pas/ 'gul bzhin pa'i gangs ri de ha cang mngon gsal red/ de'i phyir bdag dang bdag lta bu'i shes rab kyi dmar mchod 'bul mkhan tsho skye thengs mang la 'chi thengs kyang mang rgyu red/2 0 07 9 2 5nyin ri bo'i rtse lnga nas bris/— 125 —

'dren byed/lha 'dre myi gsum gyi snyan ngag1 lha la dad pa'i bod kyi rgan rabs pa phal che bas ha cang dma' sa zhig nas pus mo sa la btsugs te bod skad kyis lha la kha brda byed kyin yod la/bod yig gis lha la snyan ngag 'bri bzhin mchis/ kho tshos bris pa'i snyan ngag de dag gis nga tsho dang bar thag ring ba'i mkha' dbyings shig nas nga tshor myi ma yin gyi dag zhing gzhan zhig la 'gro ba'i lag brda gtong gin 'dugayin na'ang / nga tshos chung ma dang khyim gzhi'i lan chags blos ma thongs pas sngar bzhin 'khor ba dang 'khor ba'i yang dma' sa na lus 'dug2 'dre la dga' ba'i deng rabs gsar brje ba skor zhig gis snga 'dang phyi 'dang ci yang mi rgyag par 'dre tshang nas thon pa'i dpe deb 'ga' lag tu — 126 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bzung nas snyan ngag gsar ba zhig 'bri bzhin yod tshul zer/ yin na'ang 'brel 'dris dang zhib tshags de 'dra med pa'i 'dre tshang nas yun ring la lus pa'i snyan ngag des/ nga tsho rang yul dron mo kha ba can nas kyang skyur gyi ma red 'dod ki gal te bod bod yul nas ma bskyur tshe bod myi yul na med pa'i dus rabs shig gi 'go rtsom pa'i nyen kha de yang nga tsho'i mgo thog tu lhung na thang ngo / /2 nga tsho'i myi dang bar thag ring ba'i lha'i snyan ngag nga tsho'i gnas bab dang bar thag ring ba'i 'dre'i snyan ngag 'di 'dra'i rang nyid la mi mdza' ba'i snyan ngag mang bo zhig bris shing 'bri bzhin pa'i myi tshogs kyi khrod du bdag gcig pu a thang chad song / a thang chad pa'i bdag lha 'dre 'thab pa'i g.yul sa der gtan nas 'gro mi 'dod la/ sngon chad song ba dag kyang rang nyid kyi da lta'i bsam blo 'di'i mdun sar 'gyod bshags byed rgyu yin/ nga rang bod yul gyi gzhi rim zhig tu bsdad nas myi'i snyan ngag rnal ma zhig 'bri e thub lta rgyu yin/2 kya06 12 25nyin lung drug grong khyer nas bris/— 127 —

'dren byed/‘‘me dang 'khyags rom’’gyi bar thag 'jal na/da wa'u tshang gi slob gso'i nag nyes dang de'i dogs slong /ka dus chod dus tshod kyis nga tshor ci zhig 'chad kyin 'dug gam/ ngas nam rgyun dus tshod kyi thag sgrar nyan dus snying rlung ldang tshad je mgyogs nas je mgyogs su 'phar/ dus tshod la rin thang med pa'i sgang ba bod yul nas/ zhogs dus nyi ma zhig shar ba ni kha sang gi nyi ma yin la/ srod dus nyi ma zhig nub pa ni sang nyin gyi nyi ma yin nges/ 'gro 'ong gi rnam 'gyur la brel sha dod po yod pa'i a ri ba tsho'i dpe deb kha shas nas ngas yang bskyar dus/ tshod kyi go don gzhan zhig la mno bsam btang /a ri ba tshos bya ba gang zhig yin rung snga sa nas 'go rtsom la/ sang — 128 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/nyin sang nyin zer nas phyi bshol byed pa'i lug4 srol med/ kho tshos de ring gi 'tsho stangs skyur ci thub dang sang nyin yang bskyar 'tsho ba gsar ba zhig la re snyeg byed/ a ri ba tshor‘ 'chi ba mi rtag pa’’zhes pa'i rig gnas med na'ang 'chi ba mi rtag pa shes pa las lhag pa'i dus tshod dam 'dzin gyi 'du shes rnon po zhig yod ki 'u tshang gis 'chi ba mi rtag pa yin/ rabs kyi kha ton skor zhig yang 'don bskyar 'don byas te nyi ma gtong ba las / dus tshod dam 'dzin gyi 'du shes zab mo zhig da rung rnyed med kidaper na a ri ba tshos gnyen sgrig ma byas gong nas ma 'ongs ma 'ongs pa'i rang gi byis nga/ dag shes yon slob gso'i khor yug cig tu skyel bar bsam blo gtong ni red/ skyes pa dang bud med gnyis kyi phyogs nas bza' zla 'tshol dus phyi'i skye sgo dang khyi/ ma tshang phyug min/ las gnas mtho dam/na sogs phal bar ba'ag ste/ lus sem sa bde thang yin min dang blo rig gsal min/ mi gshis drang min sogs bza' zla'i tshad gzhi gal chen zhig tu brtsi/ 'u tshang la mtshon na gnyen sgrig ma byas gong nas bu phrug gi mdun lam gleng rgyu phar zhog tha na mang phyogs shig gnyen sgrig byed tshul de yang glo bur stes dbang ba zhig tu 'khums so/ /a ri ba'i byis pa tsho a ma'i mngal du ma sbrum gong nas slob gso/'i gar — 129 —

'dren byed/stegs su thon yod la/ 'u tshang gi gces phrug tsho lo bdun brgyad tsam la son nas slob grwar skyel ba'i skabs su da gzod slob grwar song na slob sbyong yag po byed dgos tshul dang / slob sbyong yag po ma byas na dge rgan gyi gcar rdung byed tshul sogs ches thog ma'i slob gso'i 'go gsar du rtsom ni red/ a ri bas/ byis pa ni blo rig gsal zhing slob gso gtong sa'i yul bzang bo zhig tu brtsi la/ 'u tshang gis/ byis pa ni ci yang mi shes pa'i glen pa zhig tu 'dod pas/ byis pa bsam med tsho zer nas 'bod/a ri bas dus tshod kyi snga rol tu dus tshod bkod sgrig byed cing/ 'u tshang gis dus tshod kyi rjes su bkod pa dran nas le bda' byed nges so/ /kha khyim tshang a ri ba'i byis pa rang rkya 'pher ba zhig yin pas/ kho tsho'i skyid sdug dang las dbang rang nyid la dbang ba yin/ kho tshor chung dus nas rang nyid kyi dga' phyogs dang dmigs yul snyeg chog pa'i rang dbang yangs po zhig thob yod/ a ri ba'i khyim bdag tshos byis pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug byis pa rang nyid la sprad de/ byis pas ma shes sa dang ma rig sar phyogs ston lta bu'i tshul gyis slob gso gtong ba las pha ma'i dga' zhen rnying — 130 ge

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/bas mkhregs 'dzin byed srol med/ kho tsho'i pha ma mang che bas rang gi myong tshor dang lta tshul dri ba'i tshul gyis smras te byis pa'i klad pa'i nang du dogs pa slong ba las/ byis pa'i bsam gzhigs la bkag 'gog dang gnya' gnon byed mi srid/ 'u tshang gi pha ma bka' drin can rnams kyis rang gi lta gom/sa spyod gsum rnying ba dag tshad mar bzung nas bu phrug gi bsam gzhigs gsar bar 'bur 'joms gtong ci thub byed ni red/ kho tshos nyams myong dang goms srol la brten nas byis pa sha tsha ba las/ dus rabs dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab la lta mi shes/dper na nga tsho bod mi zhig yin na tshang mar chos dad ces pa'i bag chags shig gcig mthun du yod pa de pha ma'i pha ma nas brgyud yong ba'i goms srol tsam yin pa las/ myi bu rang gi ngos thad nas chos don go ste dad pa byed ni ha cang nyung / da dung gos kyi kha dog dmar ser gyon pa'i sprul grwa'i rigs la 'dang rgyag ci yang med par gnya' sgur sgur byas nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / yin yin thug thug tshang mar lha'am 'dre yi bsam pa 'dzin pa yod tshad gna' nas lobs pa'i goms srol tsam las/ myi bu rang gi klad pa bkol spyod byed pa'i bsam blo can zhig 'u tshang gi gzhis ka 'di nas ma 'khrungs so/ /— 131 —

'dren byed/a ri bas byis par bya ba gang la yang tshod lta dang lag len byed du 'jug rgyu de gces skyong byed srol zhig red/ dper na byis pa zhig khyim nang gi brnyan 'phrin dang glog klad sogs la thug na/ pha mas brtse 'dzum gyis de la mdzub ston dang rgyab skyor gnang bar bshad/ gal te 'u tshang gi byis pa 'ig rang gi khyim gyi brnyan 'phrin sogs la thug na pha mas slob gso ji ltar gtong rgyu red dam/ ‘‘ma thug ma byed/ mi rung / mi chog’’sogs dgag sgra mang bos gzhom gzhig gtong nges yin/ de'i phyir a ri'i byis pa tshos bya bar thug tshe mgo mi sgur bar lag pa 'gul shes/ 'u tshang gi byis pa tsho bya bar thug tshe ma go sgur sgur byas te gzugs med kyi lha la zhu ba byed rgyu las ci yang rngi/ nus so/ /a ri ba'i pha mas bu phrug la za ma 'tshol stangs bslabs nas gces la/'u tshang gi pha mas bu phrug la za ma byin te gces/ a ri ba'i bu phrug gi skyid sdug bu phrug rang nyid la sprad yod la/ 'u tshang gi bu phrug tsho'i skyid sdug pha mas bdag bzung byas yod/ a ri ba'i khyim tshang slob gso de rig gnas shig yin la/ 'u tshang gi khyim tshang slob gso de goms srol zhig yin/a ri ba'i byis pa tsho ni khyim gzhi gsar ba dang dus rabs gsar ba'i bdag po yin/ 'u tshang gi byis pa tshos pha ma zhing ba yin na zhing las byed ge 132 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/dgos la/ pha ma 'brog pa yin na 'brog las byed dgos/ kho tshos pha mas btab pa'i khyim gzhi de nas yang bskyar pha ma'i 'tsho stangs rnying ba zhig bskyar 'khrab byed pa las/ rang gi sha gseng rus gseng na nus pa gzhan zhig yod med la tshod lta tsam yang mi byed/ 'u tshang gi pha mar rang gi bu phrug la gces pa'i bsam pa rnam dag cig yod pa ngo ma red/ 'on kyang kho tshos rang gi dus rabs rnying ba'i bsam blo khyer 'ong nas/ mi rabs gsar bar slob gso byed stangs de ngo ma glen rtags shig red/ pha la pha'i dus rabs dang bsam tshul yod la/ bu la bu'i dus rabs dang bas ma tshul dgos/ de gnyis mthun po byung na 'phel rgyas med pa'i rtags shig red/ga slob grwa spyir btang slob gso ni mi'i 'tsho gnas dang spyi tshogs khrod med du mi rung zhing / slob gso yod pas myi rnams srog ldan gzhan las mtho rim srog chags kyi gras su 'greng ba red/ da lta'i 'u tshang gi gnas bab 'di la bltas na slob gso'i tshad mthon po myong mkhan ni grwa ba dang slob ma red/ lhag par spyi tshogs slob gso(khyim pa'i slob gso)myong mkhan ni slob ma red/ slob ma 'tshar longs byung sa gang yin zhe na/ gtso bo slob grwa ma gtogs 'gro sa chen — 133 —

'dren byed/po med pas/ slob grwa'i slob gso'i rgyu spus kyis spyi tshogs la dbang bsgyur byed thub na 'griga.a ri'i slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum gang yin yang slob gso'i don snying gtso bo spyi tshogs dang kha 'phrod cing / spyi tshogs dang slob grwa'i slob gso gnyis mnyam gnas kyis mdun du skyod kyin 'dug kho tsho'i slob grwa'i slob gso ni spyi tshogs rig pa'i don snying la gzhi bcol ba'i rig gnas shig yin pa las/ spyi tshogs khrod bkol spyod chung zhing spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba med pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ a ri bas bshad na/ slob grwa'i slob gso ni spyi tshogs la dbang bsgyur mkhan ang dang po yin rabs zer/ 'u tshang gi slob grwa'i slob gso ni skar ma drug cu len byed kyi rgyugs gzhi'i slob gso zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ spyi tshogs las gnas kyi dgos mkho dang kha thag ha cang ring /de la rang gi don dag ngo ma zhig mtshan gzhir ba'ag ste bshad na/ nye sngon nga rang rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring du dngos sbyong byed du song / de ni nga la mtshon na slob ma'i 'tsho bar gyes nas spyi tshogs bya bar 94ga len byas pa'i 'go ma yin/ skabs der spyi tshogs las gnas la nyams myong zab pa'i myi rgan kha cig gis nga la skad cha 'di 'dra zhig bshad myong / ‘‘khyod da rung slob ma yin pas ci yang shes ni ma red/ spyi tshogs la spyi tshogs rig pa dang / spyi tshogs — 134 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/lam srol thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod ni red/ de khyod tsho slob ma tshos shes ni ma red’’zer/gong gi skad cha de'i rkyen byas te ngas ci'i phyir slob mas spyi tshogs rig pa dang / spyi tshogs lam srol mi shes pa'i gnad don la bsam blo btang ni yin/spyir na slob ma nar son sa'i slob grwa ni spyi tshogs kyi gras su gtogs pa'i bye brag cig yin pa las/ spyi tshogs su mi gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig yin mi srid/ 'on kyang da lta'i nga tsho'i gnas bab la bltas na/ spyi tshogs dang slob grwa gnyis la bar khyad chen zhig byung yod pa mngon gsal red/'di'i gnad don gtso bo yang slob grwa'i slob gso'i ngos nas byung ba red/da lta'i 'u tshang gi slob grwa'i slob gso'i gnas bab ni‘‘lha sgrung’’lta bu zhig dang /yang na phugs bsam kho nas byas pa'i‘‘'char yan ring lugs kyi snyan ngag’’lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug slob ma mang shas kyi bsam par/ slob deb ni rgyugs shog ngos su 'bri rgyu zhig dang / slob sbyong ni skar ma drug cu'i grangs ka lon pa'i ched du byed rgyu zhig red 'dod de slob deb bam gzhung lugs kho nar bsam blo bcol te mgo bo 'khor nas 'duga.a ri bar bltas na slob grwa ni don dngos dang gnas bab sbyong sa zhig red/ 'u tshang gi slob grwa dag ni bstod smon dang gzhung lugs kyi khrims ra — 135 —

'dren byed/chen po zhig red/ de nas mthar phyin pa'i slob ma tsho'i khyad chos ni bya bar 'phrad na dpe deb kha phyes nas gzhung lugs kyi rnyog drar 'dang rgyag pa dang /dka' khag la thug tshe〈bstod smon phyogs bsgrigs〉klog 'don byas nas lha la gso la ba 'debs rgyu de red/ 'u tshang gi slob ma tsho dge rgan gyi kha nang nas ci 'bul la had nas 'dug pa las/ rang gi klad pa'i nang du ci zhig 'char min la kha ya mi byed/ rang nyid la ga'an dang mi 'dra ba'i mgo bo zhig yo/da pa gting nas brjed 'dug pa 'dra/ 'u tshang gi slob ma tsho gzhung lus/sa kyi khrims ra na yod/ kho tshos gzhung lugre/sa ni blor nges rgyu zhig dang gzhan la mkhas mdog ston byed cig tu go ba las/ de'i khrod kyi lag len ci yang mi shes/ 'u tshang gi slob ma tsho dge rgan gyi bran du khol yod/ kho tshos dge rgan lo lon tsho bskyar dpar byed pa las/ rang nyid kyi 'jon nus gsar ba zhig phyi ru 'don mi shes/ de 'dra'i slob grwa'i slob gso'i bran khol 'og nas nar son pa'i 'u tshang gi slob ma tshos stong bsam dang nga rgyal gyi gzhung lugs khur te sgor thon dus/ spyi tshogs nang gi rul sungs pa tsho'i lag 'og nas yang bskyar slob gso gsar ba zhig gi 'go rtsom dgos ni red / slob gso de'i kha 'og nas nar son tshar dus/ cislob grwa nas lobs pa'i mi gzhi dang /mdzes dpyod lta ba/ rig gnas snying stobs sogs thams cad po blo yid — 136 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/nas rtsa med du btang tshar ba red/ snang tshul 'dis kyang 'u tshang gi slob grwa'i slob gso'i nus pa spyi tshogs dang kha 'phrod med pa mtshon no/ /yang a ri'i dpe deb dang brda 'phrin las a ri bar bltas na/ kho tsho'i slob grwa'i slob gso ni spyi tshogs dang 'grogs shing 'tsham pa zhig red/rgyu mtshan/ kho tsho'i slob grwa'i slob gso'i dmigs 'ben gtad sa gtso bo spyi tshogs bya ba'i lag len gyi slob gso'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas byung ba yin pas/slob ma'i slob sbyong dang lag len gyi bar thag ha cang nye/ da dung kho tsho'i slob grwa'i slob gso ni dus rabs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang 'grogs nas bsgyur bcos byas te ma lag tshang ba zhig tu gyur yod pas/ spyi tshogs dang slob grwa'i slob gso gnyis las gtso bo slob grwa'i slob gso sngon du skyod thub yod/ 'u tshang la mtshon na spyi tshogs ji ltar 'phel rgyas su song yang / slob grwa'i slob gso sngar bzhin so na gnas pa 'di red/ dper na a pha'i skabs kyi〈jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba〉de bu'i skabs su 'ang da dung 'gyur med pa 'di 'dra red/ lhag par du krung go'i slob gso'i sgrig gzhi ha cang thabs sdug cig red/ slob ma'i dga' phyogs la mi ltos par tsis rig dngos lugs/ rdzas 'gyur/ sa khams/ chab srid/ ri mo/ rol dbyangs sogs slob mi dgos ni gcig kyang yod ni ma red/ mthar gtugs na slob — 137 —

'dren byed/ma tshos shes thag chod pa yang gcig kyang med pa 'di 'dra red/ slob chung dang slob 'bring / mtho 'bring bcas kyi skabs su slob grwa'i bkas bkod ltar slob gso myong dgos la/ tha na slob chen gyi skabs su yang ched las bslab gzhi'i pha rol na sbyang 'dod med bzhin du/ skar ma drug cu'i don du btsan gyis slob dgos pa'i bslab gzhi mang ni red/ slob ma'i dga' phyogs snang med du btang ba'i slob gso 'dis/ slob ma khri phrag mang bo'i shes rab la gzhom gzhig btang bas/ 'u tshang gi slob ma tshor slob sbyong ni mnar gcod dang / slob grwa ni khrims ra lta bu'i 'du shes shig chags 'dug go/nga spyi chogs spyi tshogs la slob gso'i bla srog yod pa ni myi'i spyi tshogs la thun min du yod pa'i sger khyad yin/ myi su yin yang skyes ma thag nas rang gi spyi tshogs khor yug dang kha 'bral med la/ rang nyid 'tsho sdod 'cha' sa'i spyi tshogs kyi slob gso'i shan shugs khrod myi gshis dang bsam blo'i bag chags kyi rmang gzhi chags ni red/ spyir btang slob gso myong mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ rang gi kha gtad du 'greng ba'i spyi tshogs de rang nyid kyi ches bla na med pa'i kha lo ba — 138 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/zhig tu brtsi chog 'tsho sdod 'cha' sa'i spyi tshogs kyis bton pa'i re ba nang bzhin rang nyid kyi 'jon nus la yang kha gsab byed dgos/ rang nyid nam yang spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho'i kha gtad du 'greng shes pa ni rang nyid spyi tshogs khrod kyi myi lhag ma zhig tu mi 'gyur ba'i thabs lam legs po zhig red/dper na a ri bar mtshon na spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur ni myi'i 'jon nus kyi 'phel 'gyur la kha phyogs ston byed kyi brda rtags shig red/ kho tsho'i slob gso dang slob gso myong mkhan gyis phar spyi tshogs la bstun pa shugs che la/spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur gyis bton pa'i re ba mtha' dag slob gso dang slob gso myong mkhan tshang mas sgrub dgos pa'i 'gan khur gal chen zhig tu brtsi/yin na'ang / 'u tshang la bltas na/ shes yon pa'i dpung sde nas bzung thams cad pos phar spyi tshogs la re ba chen po 'don pa las/ spyi tshogs kyis tshur rang nyid la re ba ci zhig 'don gi yod pa snang med du bzhag 'dug rgyu mtshan 'u tshang gi slob gso ba tsho'am shes yon pa phal cher gzhung lugs kyi khrims ra nas lag len dang spyi tshogs kyi nye sar thon gi med/ kho tshos nam rgyun sgam tshugs kyi mgrin pa gzengs su bstad de/ phar spyi tshogs la dma' ljoribeb dang mtshang 'byin byed pa las ci yang 'khyongs ki mi 'dug gal te spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang 'phel 'gyur gyi re ba dag dus ltar ma 'grub tshe/— 139 —

'dren byed/skabs de'i spyi tshogs ni rjes lus dang rul sungs kyi spyi tshogs shig tu 'gyur nges la// de bzhin du skabs de'i spyi tshogs slob gso yang slob gso ltar snang ba zhig tu 'gyur nges yin/a ri ba tshos bshad na/ kho tsho'i shes yon pa rnams spyi tshogs kyi sne khrid pa yin zer/ shes yon pa ni spyi tshogs kyi re bar ngang sgug byed kyin pa'i so ba lta bu yin zer/ shes yon pa ni spyi tshogs thog gi gnad don thog mar mthong mkhan yin zer/ shes yon pa tsho nam rgyun spyi tshogs kyi nye sa na yod zer/ 'on kyang 'u tshang la bltas na/ shes yon pa ni spyi tshogs kyi mtho sar sgam tshugs kyis 'gying ste/ nyam chung ba'i spyi tshogs la re ba chen po 'don mkhan zhig red/ shes yon pa ni pus mo sa la btsugs pa'i mi ser gyi gong nas 'khor ba snying bo med par smra mkhan zhig red/ shes yon pa ni bsam blo'i 'gal 'du brtsad de kha mying sna mying 'dogs mkhan zhig red/ mdor na 'u tshang gi shes yon pa tsho rang gi mi ser dang spyi tshogs la kha thag ha cang ring / lhag par du spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang don dngos kyi lag len la kha thag ha cang ring /ca dogs slong dang slar bsdu

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/spyir btang 'u tshang gi don dag gleng ba la a ri khyer nas yong dgos don med ki mod/ 'on kyang 'di ltar bsdur ba'i sgo nas ma bltas na/ 'u tshang gi slob gso'i nag nyes kho na gleng ba tsam gyis gsal 'byin mngon gyur ba zhig byed mi thub ki bsam ni yin/ de'i phyir a ri'i grogs po zhig gi gleng mol dang dpe deb 'ga'i mthong thos brgyud nas rang gi bsam tshul 'di drang mor gleng ba yin/ gsham nas gong du bshad tshar ba'i tshan pa re rer dogs slong dang slar bsdu re byas na/ka dus tshod ni skad cig tsam la yang mi sdod par phyir yong med pa'i gnas su kye+od kyin yod na/ slob gso yang de bzhin du bskyar zlos med par mdun phyogs su mu mthud du skyod thub dgos/ khyed tshos 'di'i thad la 'dang rgyag e myong / 'dang ji ltar brgyab ni yin 9kha khyim tshang ni myi tshe gcig gi slob gso thog ma myong sa red/ pha ma ni byis pa'i dwangs gtsang gi bsam blor ches thog ma'i skya thig rgyag —mkhan yin/ 'o na goms srol rnying ba'i bag chags la dam gyis 'tham pa'i pha ma tsho'i 'gram gyi khyim tshang slob gso de ga 'dra yin gyi red/ klog pa po lags/khyed kyis 'di la ji ltar bsam gzhig gnang gi yod dzig slob grwa ni khyim pa ba'i shes yon pa skyed bsrings byed sa yin la/— 141 —

'dren byed/dgon pa ni chos lugs pa'i sgrub pa sbyong sa red/ 'o na 'u tshang gi dgon sde dang slob grwa'i slob gso gnyis la khyad par chen po med pa ci zhig red dam/'u tshang gi slob ma tshos dge rgan dang goms srol bskyar dpar byed pa las rang nyid kyi mgo bo dgye dgye byed mi shes/ khyed cag gis bltas na ga 'dra red 9nga spyi tshogs ni myi rnams 'tsho sdod 'cha' sa'i khang khyim lta bu yin na/ khang khyim de'i phyi nang gi bkod pa mtha' dag myis bzhengs skrun byed dgos pa las khang khyim rang ngos nas byed mi nus/ gal te lo zla'i 'khor skyod khrod khang khyim la gas zhig byung na/ de ni khang khyim gyis myi la bton pa'i re ba yin srid/ re ba de shes yon pa gtso byas pa'i myi rnams kyi sgrub dgos pa'i 'gan khur yin pa las/ phar khang khyim la bltas te/ gas zhig byung mi chog pa'i re ba dang smon lam 'debs pa ni glen rtags shig red/'o na 'u tshos spyi tshogs la ji ltar kha gtad na 'grig gidzilha dzi2007 2 16nyin mdo la rdzong nas bris/200〈 2 16lung drug grong khyer nas bcos/

nga khru ge khri /ṭ+wāṃ / spyo rdza 5nyu1ji/skasnyi 7ni sku pu5sgripa /5khri dzo 5si ༈ // ) ya t+t+waṃsnye'i rtswa5 sbya tshar 5 rgyu5 smrisdi 5pa/nyul+lī5sbyo tho ga snya'ipardza lhasnasnedi5/ rgoci /coslo5/ ma khri ṭ+wāṃ5mroldi)/ / stu rdza5rang /9raspyu//〈 shaṃ5sle5nas/5 //pa57ོspi+opa/ s+hor5lga/lhi da598kro rtswa'i snar 5 shā lko5ga k+ṣiṃrdzapaspyu speglu/ gyi na5lod 5smrod/ rdza'i5nayi/ 55pa5 'i zhi skru ma//slu' zhi khri dro5rdza 9slo 5pa/( / da sau 1ngo5/snye5 trīsnyi phaklolto ra 5 khye pa'i5p+lu5pa//yu5sngo/ ski po5des rdzazhislo55dus/ sdi rdza5 ā+oṃzhi5rdza/5 / kun5tu5 napasaug5slong 5ginakyupas // rdzas/rtswatshod tshod5 sdi smrid5rdza /ra 7 5rdza nyid 5kyi5bla slog5saur5'ju sdi5spyu5smripasri da8/ / byams phrug

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/klog pa po'i thang gzhung nas/ snyan ngag gi rta rgyug byed/deng skabs bod kyi rtsom stegs steng skabs 'phral gyi tshor drag(7 khyo)de nyid rkyen byas te pir ming dzig po res mjug bzlums pa'i rtsom yig thar thor 'ga'/ dus deb dang tshags par khag las rgyun par mthong thub ki 'di ltar rang nyid kyi dga' skyo chags sdang dag yi ge'i brda byed kyi rmya na gzugs lam nas phyir mtshon byed pa ni skyon gyi gras su bgrang bar mi rigs mod/snyan ngag mi/ dus rabs kyi cong brda dang snyan ngag pa ni dus rabs kyi mgrin tshab pa yin zhes pa ji bzhin/ rtsom rig gi las kar 'ju mkhan zhig yin na khyed kyi smyug rtse nas nges par du mi rigs kyi las dbang dang spyi tshogs kyi dar rgud la do khur mdzad nga/'i 'od lam lam kyi skad cha dag brjod dgos pa las/— 145 —
