byams drugaganam gyi nyi ma dgung na yod bzhin du ma mthong ma rig mdog gis sa yi nyi ma 'tshol ba'i byed las la brel ba ni g.yag zhar gyis rtswa zos pa'i rnam thar las ma 'das/ de la rgya nag gi na gzhon dpyad brjod pa yus ce lags kyis‘‘'jig rten steng ches gud yangs gtong mi thub pa ni yi ge'i gad snyigs red’’ces pa bzhin/ nga tshos ches ma mtha' yang rang gi lag tu 'chang ba'i smyu gu 'di dang mdun du bting ba'i shog bu 'dir khrel med byed mi nyan par rtsom rig gi las don la shi yang rgyab mi gtod pa'i blo dkar sems dkar zhig byed dgos ang /ji ltar u ru su'i rtsom rig smra ba dang snyan ngag pa kor cis‘‘rtsom rig gi las 'gan ni spyi tshogs steng gi mi bzang don bzang gi bya ba rnams phyogs bsdoms kyis khyab bsgrags byas te mi ya rabs kyi rigs la bsngags brjod dang sngon skul byed rgyu dang / mi ngan don ngan gyi bya bar mtshang 'byin gyis skyon brjod dang dgag pa rgyag rgyu de red’’ces pa bzhin rtsom rig de nyid nges par du bdag gzhan gsal ba'i me long ngam khrel grags mjal ba'i rgya shing /legs nyes 'byed pa'i tshad thig lta bu zhig yin dgos/ rtsom pa po bzang bo zhig yin na ni dus nam yang rang nyid kyi rtsom yig gi kha gtod sa ste klog pa po'i khrod du 'grengs mkhan zhig dang klog pa po'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'du — 146 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/shes la spar 'thams dang hur 'jug gdung sems skyes mkhan zhig yin pa ni no'o pel tsom rig bya dga' mnos myong ba'i rtsom pa po dag dang klog pa po'i sgang 'bur nas rtsom rig chen po'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng gin pa'i mi bu rus pa sra mo can dag la bltas pas shes yong /nga tshos nub gling lo rgyus kyi bar brgal dus/ skabs re rer 'khyug tsam lta dus/ lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams re re na rdo ring ltar krong nger 'gying yod pa ni rtsom rig ces pa'i yig 'bru bajid po 'di gnyis red/ tan ting dang po ca chi/ phis thad lā khe sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i rig rtsal bskyar dar kho nas kyang gnad don 'di dag gshag bcos sgos/gnas lugs bden thub can 'ga' re nga tshor gsal rjen du ston gyin pa ma yin nam/ 1ṭ+wāṃ6ṭ+wāṃlo'i rgya nag gi hong tsun zhwan gyi rang sems rang gis 'bri(tshohrotha7gre)dang rjes kyi thān tshi thung dang zhwa tsun yo'i sogs kyis‘‘snyan ngag sa/sar ba'i grub mtha'’’gsar 'dzugs byas pas da bzod rgya nag lo rgyus thog rtsom rig steng gi gsar brje dang bsam blo'i steng gi dkyogs mtshams/skad cha'i steng gi thod brgal bcas kyi dus 'gyur du brtsi gyin pa'i lnga bzhi'i las 'gul gyi me kha gsos pa red/ de las kyang nga tshos rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi sgul shugs dang mi'i bsam blo'i 'phel rim steng gi skul — 147 —

byams phrugargyu(smar+sā)gtso bo zhig yin par nges shes gsal bo 'drongs 'ong / rang rer yang de las ma 'das ste/ sku zhabs rang grol lags kyis rang mos snyan ngag gi rtsom thabs bod la drangs pa kho nar yang dge mtshan smra mi shes pa zhig 'dren rgyu yo da do/ dus las ma yol ba'i rtsom rig cig yin na ni mi rigs kyi bde sdug dbyangs su gyer ba dang rang nyid kyi bla srog gi dwangs ma gtsub pa'i byed las cig tu chags rgyur shi 'tham ro 'tham byed dgos/ rgya grol lags kyis snyan ngag pa zhig byed rgyu sla mod mi rigs rang gi snyan ngag pa zhig byed rgyu ha cang dka' zhes pa las spyir btang tha snyad gang yag yag dang tshor 'du gang grim grim phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas snyan ngag 'khyog po re rtsom rgyu ca tshocang sla mod/ dma' rim mang tshogs kyi sems 'dun dang bshad na 'dod pa'i skad cha dag rang gis mgrin pa sngon du bkyags nas bshad rgyu ha cang dka' zer gyin pa 'di las kyang / rtsom yig 'bri ba ni gtsang chu bde thang du bzhur ba ltar ma yin parari dog mo'i grogalam brgyud pa lta bu'i nyen tshabs shin tu che/ brdab gsis/ 'di dang sun gtser 'di'i rkyen gyis gna' deng krung phyi'i snyan ngag rngapre dag giru/ snyelan rer snyan ngag gi bslu brid bzod ma thub par skya lam nas phyi bsnur byed pa'i gtam kyang go rgyu yod/rang re'i sgang pa tshang la'ang dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal sogs — 148 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/ mthe bong rtser bskyon pa'i rtsom pa po kha shas las mang che ba ni dpe 'gre(r+sā7)snyan ngag 'bri mkhan tag tag las ma 'das/ kho tshos rgyun par gangs ri dang rtswa thang / sbra nag dang zla 'od sogs shi 'das brgyab pa'i tha snyad rmas ma 'ga' bskyar dpar gyis‘‘do dgong nam mkha' na zla 'od med’’dang‘‘khyod kyi me tog lta bu'i brla sha’’‘‘do nub nga zi ling na yod’’sogs 'bri rgyu las spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul ga ge mor 'khang ba'i brla brdung rgyu dang / skyug bro'i mdzad pa 'ga' rer sdang ba'i so 'cha' rgyu med/ deng skabs bod kyi rtsom stegs steng ljang bu dang 'ju skal bzang / gcan me stag sman bla skyabs dang dpa' rtse sogs mi bu 'ga' las ma dzub mo nang 'gug gis brtsi chog chog yin pa'i snyan ngag pa ga tshod yod dam/ mang che shas shig gis gad snyigs spungs shing de dag gis dngos gnas shog bu dang snag tsha sogs thon khungs 'phro brlag gtong gin pa las 'os med/ snyan rtsom legs shos shig yin na ni re gnyis tsam gyis kyang mi'i sems rtsa sgul thub mod/ rang re la ni de las ldog ste spus tshad kyi cha nas ya nga ba dang grangs ka'i cha nas ha las pa'i‘‘ne tso'i snyan ngag’’thon skyed byas drags pas dngos po ji ltar nyung na de ltar brin(7lor+ṣarkir+sā)zhes pa dang ldog sdur grub 'dug rgyun par snyan ngag gi deb chung dag gis sa rdul gyi na bza' gtos che ba re mnabs nas ting 'dzin — 149 —

byams phrugagyi bde bar bzhugs 'dug pa mthong yong dus/ ngas a khu yi dam tshang gi〈〈rnga chen rol dbyangs〉dran yong gi dran nas kyang skad gseng mthon pos gyer 'don thengs shig byed na 'dod girtsom rig ni spyir tshor shes khyad par ba zhig gi sha chad bu phrug tu bgrangs rung mod mtha' gcig tu tshor shes kho nar brten pa'i chig rkyang ba zhig dang rkya 'thab pa zhig yin par mi rigs te des nges par du rang nyid kyi mtha' 'khor na mchis pa'i spyi tshogs dang khor yug mi dmangs kyi sems la lag snyob sgos sha gseng na 'thim 'dug pa dang rus gseng na zug 'dug pa dag sngog 'don byas na khyon nas 'grig de ltar ma byas na khyod nyid nam yang mi dmangs kyi snyan ngag pa zhig tu 'gyur mi thub la tshabs che na kher gling 'bud kyin lcebs thag bskon te rang shi rgyag dgos pa'i tshad la yang mi lhung bar sus kyang kha tshon gcod dka'o/ khru'u rgyal rabs kyi snyan ngag pa chus yon(ṭhaṭha)gyis mi tshe gang bor rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi sad rtogs ched du snyan ngag bgrangs las 'das pa brtsams kyang re 'bras don du ma smin/ mjug mthar mus lo'o gtsang bor lding ba des kho dang mi dmangs kyi bsam blo'i go rtogs thad te bag che ba'am mthun thabs med pa'i bsam blo'i 'gal zla gnas yod pa dang / rang re'i bod la mtshon na yang mi chos ring lugs kyi — 150 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/sngon skyod pa mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi‘‘lung ba kha byang lta zhig na me tog snying rje bo zhig skyes 'dug par sus kyang mnyam ma bzhag pas skam song’’dang‘‘ngas dka' las tog trem brgyab pa de yin rgyu ni bod kyi don du yin yang ’’zhes pa'i shugs ring 'di dag dang / bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba'i ded dpon sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyi‘‘ngas bsam gzhigs zhib mo zhig btang ba na rang rigs blun rmongs dang rjes lus kyi klong du 'khyams shing /de'i don du kho bos kyang rtsom yig kha grangs longs pa zhig bris te kho tsho'i go rtogs de sad na snyam yang / pham kha rang gis nyo dgos byung rkyen/ ngas rang nyid kyi nyam chung ba'i tshe srog blos btang ste dung brda gsal bo zhig bsgrags pa yin’’zhes pa'i skyo gdung 'di dag gis mtshon par zhe smreng ba'i zlos gar re res nga tsho'i lus steng gi ba spu krong nger gzengs bar byed/ de dag tshang ma ni rtsom rig rang steng nas brjod na nag nyes med mod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang kha sbubs su sbyor skabs de 'dra'i 'gal zla'i phung bo mang po spungs yong ba red/ gong bkod kyi dpe 'di gsum ni rtsom pa pos smyug kha klog pa po'i bar gseng du skor skabs kha gtod sa'i mang tshogs kyi rnying zhen dang phyi sgo bkag bcad kyi bsam blo'i rmongs mun gyis bzos pa'i skyo gar red/ de yang mi'i sad rtogs dang spyi tshogs kyi grags med 'gul med kyi lhing 'jags — 151 —

byams phrugabar nas rtsom pa por brdab gsig rabs dang rim pa btang yong ba red mod/nga tshos gom kha phyir mi bskor bar am gtsigs shugs kyis bsdams nas smyug kha mang tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang bsam pa'i 'khyer so yis yang yang brdar du 'jug rgyu ha cang gal che/rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba las mtho ba'i sgyu rtsal snang tshul zhig yin/'phur sa dgung sngon gnam yin rung 'bab sa dog mo thang zhes pa ltar mtha' ma rnga ma klog pa po'i sems gzhong du 'bab dgos pa ni kha tsha dgos gtug cig red/ bdag gis rgyun par rtsom pa po'i sems khong gi snyan ngag ni snyan ngag min la klog pa po'i sems khong gi snyan ngag ni snyan ngag yin(ltos bcas kyis bshad pa yin)zhes brjod kyin yod/ snyan ngag pa la las gsar rtsom byed dus rang gi thub tshod kyis tshor 'du drag po zhig gi srog shing la mdzes pa'i tshig sbyor mang pos spud nas snyan ngag zer ba 'di lta bu yin dgos zhes nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis bris pa yin mod/ rtsom de rim bzhin klog pa po'i myong rol gyi stegs bu'i steng babs dus nyams 'ur thon pa'i rgyu tshogs ma grub pas bltas kyin bltas kyin‘‘'dis ci zhig 'chad kyin yod dam/ dngos gnas ha go ba mi 'dug’’zer bzhin klog 'don gyi yi ga 'chu bar byed/ de ni rtsom pa po dang klog pa po'i bar yid gzugs kyi mthun snang ma grub pa dang rtsom pa — 152 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/pos gsar rtsom gyi go rim khrod klog pa po'i dang len mdzes rig(༈rketshohrūr+ha)la 'dang ma brgyab pas lan pa red/ mo'o tse tung gis‘‘rtsom rig dang gtam bshad ni ched du mi gzhan la bag chags bsgo ba'i ched du yin la mi gzhan pa'i bsam blo dang bya spyod la kha lo bsgyur bar byed pa'i ched du'ang yin’’zhes pa ba'in gal te khyed kyi brtsams chos des pha rol bor ba spu gcig sgul ba'i mthu nus kyang thon mi thub tshe/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi las 'gan 'grub mi 'dug la rtsom rig gi kha phyogs gtod yul de yang gol lam 'ig tu lhung tshar 'dug rtsom mkhan dang klog mkhan ni rtsom rig gi thad ka'i shugs rkyen thebs sa yin pa'i cha nas de gnyis bar mthun sbyor legs po byung thub tshe da gzod rtsom rig gi 'gan nus 'grub pa yin la spyi tshogs la phan yang btags tshar ba yin/ gangs can kha ba ri bo'i ljongs su1khaṭ+wāṃ5—19〈khalo'i bar rtsom rig gi gar stegs steng 'khrab ston mi sna gtso bor gyur mkhan gyi sku zhabs lja nga bu lags ni 'khrab stangs ga'an pa 'ig gi kher bro'i stangs stabs bsgyur mkhan zhig red/ sku zhabs ljang bu lags kyis mi'i tshogs drug snang ba'i tshor shes kyis zin par dka' ba'i yid gzugs khyad mtshar ba re rer brten nas/ e sha ya'i spyi gtsug gi nyi zer mthong bar re zhing bsnyegs pas bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sde ru‘‘khyod kyis kher rkyang gi sdug — 153 —

byams phrugabasngal bzod thub kyang nga tshos snyan ngag gi bslu brid ldog dka'’’sogs 'o dod 'bod dgos byung song / de yang kho'i sger dbang gis kun nas phyug pa'i yid gzugs kyi tshogs dang nga tsho'i bar mtshungs chos ma grub pas ljang bu'i snyan ngag go dka' ba dang ljang bu zhe na cung zad lkog gyur ba'i brda chad zhig tu grub don yang de red/ klog pa por 'dang rgyag rgyu ni rtsom pa po zhig gis rtsom ma bris gong ches thog mar thugs gzhig gtong dgos sa red/‘‘kho tshor dbang shes rno bas sngon du 'chad pa tsam mo’’(lu'u zhun gyi tshig)zhes pa ltar klog mkhan dang rtsom mkhan bar tshor 'du'i mthun snang grub ste rang rang so so'i sems sgrar nyan thub song tshe da gzod klog pa pos gdung sems mnyam skyes byed srid/ rgya'i rtsom rig mkhas can lu'u zhun gyis kyang〈nga ro〉nas bzung bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rul sungs lam lugs rtsa slo ga byas te/bzo zhing mna' 'brel gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs 'dod pa'i mi dmangs kyi sems 'dun ji bzhin blos bslangs dang phyir mtshon byas pas kho la dus skabs de'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor chen po thob pa dang / krung go'i nga rgyal dang sgal tshigs mkhregs po can zhes bstod bsngags thob pa red/de yang kho'i rtsom rig gi dmigs rtse gtod sa ma nor bar klog pa po dang dpung ba mnyam gshib sgos rno ngar gyi smyug rtse re res mang tshogs kyi ches phra — 154 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ba'i zhib cha 'khyer nas kho tshos brjod 'dod pa dag rang gis sngon du brjod thub song ba kho na red/ deng sang gzhon skyes rtsom pa po la lar khyod kyi snyan ngag dag de 'dra go ba len dka' don ci red ces dris dus/ phyir‘‘nga'i snyan ngag mi rabs rjes ma dag la gzas nas bris pa yin’’zhes dang / ‘‘nga'i snyan ngag la dpyad brjod gtong thub mkhan med/’’ ‘‘snyan ngag gi khyad chos go dka' ba'i steng na yod’’ces bden cog cog gis 'chad srid/ don la de lta bur snyan ngag pa'i cho lo sbyor mi rigs la des bris pa'i rtsom dag kyang rtsom legs gras zhig gang nas yin/ spyir na spyi tshogs dang kha bral ba'i snyan ngag cig la sger gshis yod ces gleng sa mi 'gro zhing / rtsa lag dang 'gal phyir yan lag dang nying lag ces dgar rgyu zhig gtan nas yod mi srid/ klog pa po med pa'i rtsom yig de dus nam yang gzhan gyis shes thabs med la klog pa po med pa'i rtsom yig de dus nam yang sems gzhong du sim 'dzul byed thabs med do/rtsom rig gi legs nyes ni klog pa po'i rgya srang steng gzhal na da gzod yang lce tshor 'ong la rtsom rig gi bzang ngan ni klog pa po'i bsam blo'i dpyad gsum dag pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas rjes da gzod rin thang rtogs thub pas/ klog pa po ni rtsom rig gi mjug mtha'i — 155 —

byams phrugalog mal dang ches mtha' ma'i 'bab tshigs lags/ rtsom mkhan rnam pa/nga tshos smyug kha nges par du klog pa po'i bsam blo'i gzhi rkang steng 'dzugs dgos la/ klog pa po'i bsam blo'i dgos mkho bskang thub dgos pas klog pa por gzhol med bden drang gis zhabs 'degs bsgrub ya/ /2007lo'i zla7pa'i tshes12tshes nyin/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/yid sems blong tshang bor byed pa'i laskad cha gsum/ de ring slob grwa'i brda tho sbyor sar bod rang skad kyis bris pa'i brda tho zhig mthong byung / zhib tu bltas pa na de ni dpon postuyis rig gzhung 'chad khrid cig spel rgyu yin pa'i skor bshad 'dug dpon posmoni sngar gyi kan su'u zhing chen gyi srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa yin la/ kan su'u zhing chen gyi bod rigs dpon khag dag gi gras nas go sa mtho shos can dang dbang cha che shos can gyi gras gcig yin/spyir yin na deng sang dpon gnas lam lugs kyi khor yug na ltag sgo dang ngo thang / rgyu nor sogs‘‘dmar po'i tha snyad’’ches cher brin pas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' blon sngon ma kru'u rin cus‘‘ngas ro sgam brgya bzos ge 157 —

byams phrugayod/ dgu bcu go dgu gzhan la bzos pa dang / gcig rang la bzos pa yin/ dpon po sus dmangs rgyu lkog nas zas na de la srog khrims gcod dgos/ nga rang gis dmangs rgyu lkog nas zas na de dus srog khrims bcad chog’’ces bden lugs kyi rgya shing thogs nas drang bden gyi stegs bur 'bud mkhan gyi dpon po dga' shos ni gcig dang gnyis tsam las mthong tshod mi 'dugadapon poṣāyis srid kyi bya ba ji ltar bskyangs tshul thad nga la gsal cha cher mi 'dug mod/ mi mang gi kha na kho ni mi rigs kyi las don la thugs gzhig gtong mkhan dang la rgya yod mkhan zhig red zer mkhan yod la/rang nyid kyi go sa 'phar ched mi rigs la rgyab gtod dang pha yul rdog brdzis gtong mkhan zhig red kyang zer mkhan 'dug gtam mi kha zer ba de sprin las langs sla ba dang thog las dbal tsha ba/ chu las rgyun drags pa zhig yin pas bshad yams tsam por blo ling gis 'gel rgyu med/ gtso bo ni rang nyid kyi semyo/sa ngo nas mi de la go thang ga tshod ster min dang gdeng 'jog ga tshod byas min der rag las/ da ni khong gi gam du bcar ste khong nyid rgyus lon byed pa'i bskal ba nyug tsam shar song snyam bzhin de ma thag 'chad khrid byed sa'i slob khang sgor gzas nas song / da thengs kyi 'chad khrid spel sa 'di ni — 158 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/nged slob grwa'i rig gzhung snyan zhu khang ste khod yangs la gra dag pa'i slob khang chen po zhig yin mod/ nga rang yong ba 'phyi song bas los yin/ slob khang du gral gnas thems yod pa tsho gral gnas steng bsdad 'dug thems med pa tsho thang du tsog 'dug tsog sa yang thems med pa tsho yar 'grengs 'dugang thon dus phal cher rkang ba spo sa zhig kyang mi rnyed pa'i tshod red/ mdun ngos kyi brnyan gzugs ngos su‘‘mtsho bod mtho sgang gi khor yug dang 'phel rgyas skor bshad pa’’zhes bod yig klad dang rgya yig 'gab du bris 'dug la mar phyogs na 'chad khrid gnang mkhan gyi ming bod rgya yig rigs gnyis kas bris 'dug nyan mkhan dag las brgya cha'i dgu cu go lnga ni bod rigs rkyang rkyang yin la gzhan nye sgrib mig shel gon pa'i rgya'i slob ma 'ga' yang zin tho 'bri deb steng ci zhig 'god nga ra brel nas 'dug rgyun par bod yig slo/ba gling gi slob ma tsho slob gling gzhan pa'i ched mkhas pa tshos 'chad khrid gnang dus nyan du 'gro mi srid/ da reb 'di 'dra'i nyan mi mang tshul la bltas na brda tho bod rang skad kyis bris pas yin shag shag red/yud tsam nas dpon rigs mtho gras 'ga' dang mnyam du dpon posmoyang kho tsho'i dkyil tshad nas phebs byung / sku gzugs brjid por lwa ring nag po zhig bklubs 'dug pas ngo ma dpon po gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig — 159 —

byams phrugared/ (skyo dgos pa gcig ni skra lor dkar thig babs yod pa de red)kru'u zhi stegs bur bzhugs rjes slob ma tsho 'tshang ka shig shig gis yod pa mthong nas 'dug stegs thems med mkhan tsho kru'u zhi stegs bur yong nas sdod chog pa'i gnang ba byin/ slob grwa'i mgo ba kro'o te an gyis gleng slong dang ngo sprod kyi tshul du dpon posmol bstod pa rnam gsum re sngon du 'then bzhin kho'i dpon sa mtho tshul/ dbang cha che tshul/ bya ba mang tshul/ da thengs nga tshor 'di 'dra'i 'chad khrid thengs gcig gnang ba ni nga tsho'i bsod nams yin tshul/ da thengs tsam ma zad rjes sor kyang nga tshor bka' slob mang du gnang dgos tshul sog/sa mang po mang po zhig lab rjes 'chad khrid dngos su mgo brtsam/sa/ khong lta bu srid gzhung gi bya ba brel 'tshub che ba zhig la mtshon na phal mo che'i snang ngor rig gzhung slob gnyer thad de 'dra'i lag rjes mi che bar 'dod mod dpon poṣāni de lta bu'i mi zhig ma red/ ngo sprod byas pa ltar na khos snga phyir khor yug srung skyob skor gyi deb gnyis gsum tsam brtsams grub byung la rig gzhung dpyad rtsom nyi shu lha ga rgyal nang gi dus deb 'dra min steng bkod/ da dung lan gru slob chen sogs nas slob ma tshor dpe khrid kyi rgyun skyong mus yod tshul go dus dngos gnas rgad po ngar ba zhig red snyam pa'i 'du shes rang shugs kyis skyes yong / de ni khor mtshon na rang nyid kyi mi tsher — 160 ge

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/gser mdog gi 'od snang spros pa red la tshe thog da thengs mi lus blangs par don go chod song snyam bzhin yid smon skyes ni zhig red/ re smon dang yid ches kyi mig zung kho sar cer nas cung tsam zhig las 'gor med mod de ma thag bdag skyo lhang lhang / grang shur shur/ 'khyag sib sib can zhig tu btang byung / ‘‘bdag gis de ring gi 'chad khri/ da 'di bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling la kha gtad pa yin/ nyan mkhan mang che ba bod red/ mi rigs gzhan pa 'ga' re yang 'dug mi rigs gzhan pa de dag gis bod skad mi go 'on kyang bod kyi slob ma tshos rgya skad go de bas ngas spyi yongs la kha gtad nas rgya skad kyis bshad rgyu yin’’zer/ dus skabs der tshogs ra yongs mig hrig ger sdod pa las sus kyang mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur mi ston/(spyir bod phrug tshor rgod gshis cung drags pas rang nyid kyi bsam thog du ma yong na mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dra min ston srid)skad cha des nga rang blong blong bor byas la/ de ma thag bye sgang gi lcang sdong kher skyes de yang dran yong ni zhig red/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba tshang 'tsho gzhes gnang dus bod mi mang che shos kyis gal te paṇa chen khong lta bu bcu bod yul du yod rgyu na/bod 'di myur mor yar langs thub rgyu red ces bshad dang shod kyin 'dugapaṇa chen khong lta bu bcu bod yul du yod rgyu na zhes pa ni spyi mtshan rang bzhin — 161 —

byams phrugagyi bsam gzhig gtong stangs shig lags mod khong rin po che kho nas kyang lce brgyar sprul nas smras kyang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i phyag rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod/ de'i rkyen gyis ngas dus nam yang rang rer mar dri dang rtsam dri ma yal ba'i dpon po gsha' ma re 'khrungs par re smon dang rgyang bltas byas yod/krung dbyang las rigs so so na bod ming can gyi dpon po 'ga' re yod mod de tsho rang rigs kyi la rgya'i phrag steng du 'dod sred kyi rkang ba bzhag ste gzhan gyi 'phongs rkub bldags mkhan dag dag las ma 'das pas ngas kho tshor‘‘spyang ki’’dang‘‘phag rgan’’zhes pa'i mtshan gzhi gzugs snang can re 'jog gin yod/brtsams sgrung ljoribring gras〈ra lo〉las‘‘mi zhig yod na khyi zhig gi yan red’’ces pa ba'in ngas ni dpon po zhig yod na zhal ngo zhig gi yan red ces bsams yod/ rang rer sha tsha mkhan gyi dpon po zhig yin na ni de zhal ngo tsam ma zad lha zhig gi yang yan red mod bod kyi dpon po spyir btang ba zhig yin na yang zhal ngo ltar khyim tshang gi khur bor 'gyur mi dgos par ches ma mtha' yang rang kha rang gso tsam byed thub pas red/ dpon posnuni mi'i nang gi dpon po dang dpon po'i nang gi kru'u zhi red/ mi dmangs kyis〈dpon po mkhyen〉(a khu sman bla'i kha shags shig) zer bzhin gnya' sgur sgur dang nywa lhob lhob byed sa red/ dor zhi rin po ches rdza bum seng ge'i 'o mas bkang ba dang / /— 162 —

da wa mtshanasmagagis bdas pa'i nga cho/gser bum mi gtsang rtug pas bkang ba'ang yod/ /seng ge'i 'o ma gser bum gnyis 'dzoms rab/ /min na snga ma de len phyi ma spongs/ /zhes pa bzhin khong lta bu ming thog nas gser gyi bum pa yin ni red/ don thog nas seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu byas par spobs na ni stag mor gshog pa thogs pa dang a na ma na red mod/ gong gi skad cha 'di lta bu dag go dus ‘6de cang med ki’’re lce thog nas dka' las med par shud 'gro gi khyos bod yig slob gling la kha gtad pa yin zer na rang skad tshad ldan zhig bshad na 'os/ khyos spyi yongs la dmigs rgyu yin zer na rang skad rnal ma zhig 'chad na 'grig srid gzhung gis tshogs 'du gang zhig 'tshogs na yang mi rigs sa khul/ mi rigs sa khul zhes gleng rgyu gleng rgyu zhig dgongs don yig cha gang zhig bkrams na rang skad gtsor 'dzin/ rang skad gtsor 'dzin zhes bsgrags rgyu bsgrags rgyu zhig 'on kyang don dag rang steng du babs dus gnad don 'bud rgyu 'bud rgyu zhig 'di tshogs 'du gang gi gleng gzhi don thog tu bkol ba yin/'di yig cha gang gi dgongs don lag len du btab pa yin/ lag pa'i thag nye sa nas sad mi thub pa'i mdzad pa 'di dag la nga tshos phyi rnam ring lugs pa zhes btags na ha cang 'phrod po yod/ khyos rgya skad shes rgyu red/ los shes mod 'dir rgya skad ma bshad kyang nga tshor khyos rgya skad e shes snyam pa'i the — 163 —

byams phrugatshom su la yang yod mi srid/ de las rang skad dag ma zhig bshad btang na khyod 'chad mkhan la bde (kho'i rgya skad bshad stangs de yang rgya'i tha snyad 'ga' rer bod skad kyi dbyangs sbyor gyin pa las med) nga nyan mkhan tsho'i blor 'bab pa yang de ma yin nam/ chu mgo nas rnyog na dwangs pa med pa ji bzhin rang skad rang spel dang rang srid rang bdag gi las don dag bshad mkhan tsho'i kha nas 'chol te lag nas 'thor song na/ dma' rim mang tshogs tshor ci khag mi rigs 'grub byed kyi cha rkyen chen po bzhi las ches gtso bo ni skad yig 'di 'jog pa yin na snang tshul 'di 'dras gtan tshigs de 'drar 'grel ji ltar rgyag gam/ gang ltar kyang ngas khyed kyi zur ngos gang rung nas dpon nyams ring lugs pa'i ngo gdong zhig rma thong yong la mi rigs kyi las don dag don gyis mgo nas mar 'chol nas yong gin pa'i nyen tshabs rang bzhin zhig kyang mthong yo nga ngo /mjug mthar tshogs 'du'i gtso skyong bas khong las brel che bas 'chad khrid 'di nas mjug rdzogs pa dang slob ma tshoru/ dri ba gnyis gdon chog pa'i go skabs byin/dri ba dang bo ltar na 'di lta ste/— 164 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho gtsang gsum mgo khungs kyi chu bed 'dzugs skrun thad rgyal khab kyis ma dngul chen po btang yod na yang don ngo ma las grwar dngos su sgor mo nyung tsam las thon gi med pa'i tshul dris byung / drang mor bshad na dri ba 'di ni dpon po tshor mtshon na gnyan po gsang ba zhig dang kho tsho'i thun min gyi gsang ba'i yon tan zhig yin pas dpon posnul yang nan cag gis mgo bkyags nas lan 'debs pa'i spobs pa ma byung la‘‘red/ dngos gnas de 'dra yod ki nga tshos de'i phyogs su dag ther gang thub bya gi yod’’ces dris lan stabs bde re 'debs bzhin sa cha gzhan pa'i dpon po 'ga' res lkog za skog 'thung byas pas rgyal khab kyis khrims la spyar tshul sogs dpe 'jog re drud yong nas rang nyid dang nye 'khor gyi phag rgan tsho gang thub kyis 'gebs ci thub byas/ krung dbyang dang gzhi rim bar gyi kha thag ring bas yin nam/yang na dpon po dang mi ser bar he bag che ba gang yin cha ma mtshal mod dngos gnas krung dbyang gi tshogs chen steng stong sgra gras/ gin pa'i srid jus te gzhi rim sa khul du thon dus re'u 'gas 'ba' skad sgrog gin pa las med/de bzhin du gong nas mang tshogs la 'tsho ba'i kha gsab dang grong gsar 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i ma dngul 'bor chen btang na yang krung dbyang nas zhing chen rim pa/ zhing chen rim pa nas khul rim pa/ de nas rdzong dang — 165 —

byams phrugazhang thog tu thon dus sa rdog rbab 'gril byas pa bzhin mang tshogs tsho'i lag tu rtags tsam las thon gyin mi 'dug nga ni rgyun par rtags tsam gyi rogs dngul de bzung nas da dung dga' krog krog byed pa'i mi ser tsho'i so dkar lpags pa'i 'dzum mdangs la bltas nas 'di'i ltag rgyab na bar zas rgyag mkhas kyi lag pa ji 'dra'i ring bo zhig yod ang snyam bzhin dogs pa dang the tshom zos yong / dpon po zhig la mtshon na che za chung za re byas yod pa su la yang gsang thub med mod ngas kyang dpon posnuyis lkog za byas song zhes mtha' gcig tu bsgrags pa ma yin/ dngos gnas〈mi ro rtse sgrung〉nang gi rdzun mi smra ba'i rta rdzi lta bu'i mi gshis dwangs mo can gyi rigs dag dus rabs sngon ma'i nang khungs 'brug(྾2)rmeg med du phyin pa bzhin sa'i go la 'i steng nas nyams rmas su bud song ba 'dra/dri ba gnyis pa ltar na 'di lta ste/mtsho bod lcags lam gyis mtsho bod mtho sung gi skye khams thad dge skyon gang 'dra thebs yod dam ces pa de red/ spyir dri ba 'di ni ha cang gi rno ngar rang bzhin ldan pa zhig lags pas bod mi dag ma re re'i sems khong la tshad 'dra min gyi 'dri rtags dang tsha tsag slong srid pa red/ dri ba 'di 'dra — 166 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/bton pa 'grig song snyam bzhin khos ji ltar lan ldog par sgug yod dus/‘‘bzang cha los yod/ de min na krung dbyang srid gzhung 'thad pa ches byung /’’ zer bzhin kho rang gad mo lhug lhug byas/ phal cher dri tshig gnad la phog byung snyam pa'i mdangs bstan pa red/ kho'i bgad pa'i kha la bltas nas slob grogs 'ga' re ri bong cal la 'drogs pa bzhin dgod rgyu zhig thon gyin yod na yang / dgod sgra des nga'i sems kyi zab sar na zug chen po bslangs song / dris lan des nga'i khrag rtsa'i sbubs su zhe sdang chen po bslangs song / mdo dbus rtswa thang gi brang gzhung gshags nas gnyan chen thang lha'i glo snying 'big gin pa'i mtsho bod lcags lam gleng yong dus 'dzum mdangs shig dang dgod sgra cig gis der tshad 'jal byas pa yin na khyed tshos dngos gnas 'chi bdag gi sgal tshigs steng btsan rdzong bskor gyin pa'i mi rigs 'di bsam gyin mi 'dug khyed tshos dngos gnas mi mngon pa'i dbyings rim na sprul gzugs 'dra min ston gyin pa'i rig gnas 'di bsam gyin mi 'dug mtsho bod lcags lam de lcags lam tsam du bsam na/ de dngos gnas rno lcags gzhu brdungs byas pa las nyi ma lha sar 'then pa'i lam riring po zhig red/ 'on kyang / nga tshos mtsho bod lcags lam de lcags lam tsam du bsam mi nyan/ de chom rkun zhig tu bsam na 'grig ma zin na ge 167 —

rang nyid kyi yod tshad kho'i yin pa ltar khyer 'gro khyod la mgo rus skam po'i brjed byang 'jog nges/ zin song na nga tshos gcar rdung byed chog tsha 'dri gtong chog khrims thag gcod chog tha na mgo ngo thur du ston kyang chog pa ma yin nam/da wa2 007 12 2 2nyin rang shag tu/

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/gcen bur bud pa'i nag nyes/gleng gzhi/nye lam bod yig zin bris las bod kyi gzhon skyes snyan ngag pa khri sems dpa' mi rabs gsum pa las phyir bud pa'i gtam zhig thos/ gang yin gyi gnas tshul shes par 'dod de myur mor sems dpa'i zin bris su 'dzul/‘‘de ring nas bzung kho bo dngos su mi rabs gsum pa zhes pa'i tshogs pa 'di'i khrod nas phyir bud pa yin zhes gsal bsgrags byas pa yin la/ phyin chad kyang mi rabs gsum pa'i skor gyi don bya mtha' dag kho bo dang 'brel ba ye nas med ces kyang zhu'o/’’ zhes pa'i tshig 'bru dag dngos gnas kho'i zin bris las mthong thub song / phyogs kyi rlung bu gang 'dra zhig gis kho mi rabs gsum pa las phyir bdas byung snyam la der ljags yod ljags med mang pos — 169 —

byams phrugagang yin de min gyi dpyad gtam kyang mang du spel 'dug rang nyid kyis kyang stobs ldan glang chen gyi khur bo 'bu chung grog mas mi theg kyang rang sems na yod pa'i skad cha 'ga' khri sems dpa' dang bcas pa'i snyan ngag gi mi rabs dgar mkhan tshor bgro gleng gi tshul du 'bul na 'dod/gcig khrod dang khrod kyi bla spog〈bdag gi tshoms〉las/ bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du 'dzin/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon gyur pa/ /mya ngan nang du gdung mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dum bu gcig mthong yong / 'di 'brel gyi bshad phyogs la a me ri kha'i sems khams rig pa ba grags can ol pu khri ho pe tes rang nyid gzhan la mi do ba'i sems khral zhig gis ci zhig bya/ khyod ni khyod rang nyid yin/ sngon chad khyod lta bu'i mi zhig byung ma myong la rjes su yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes dang / rgya'i rang dbang rtsom pa po li'u cun nyin gyis mi ni mi rang nyid yin byed ni/ kho la lhan skyes nas gzhan la ster du med pa dang 'phrog tu med pa zhig yod de/de ni nga yin no/ de ni mi gzhi yin no/ de ni rtsis thang yin no/ ston pas gsungs pa ji bzhin rang nyid ni dus nam yang rang nyid kyi mgon po — 170 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/'khrul med de yin pas nga tsho bya ba gang zhig bgyi ba'i sta gon la zhugs kyang /dang po dpyad gsum dag pa'i blos de nyid brnags shing dpyad mthar de la 'jug min dang gzhug rjes rkang rjes ji ltar dgod rgyu yin pa sogs blo rnal du phab rjes da gzod phyir mi bzlog pa'i dam bca' zhig dgos/ ci yin ma shes par nang du 'dzul/ gang yin ma shes par phyir bsnur ba ste 'jig rten gyi bya ba kun la rtsed mtshar gyi 'du shes 'dzin pa ni ha cang mi 'os pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ khri sems dpa' lta bu'i gzhon skyes snyan ngag pa zhig la mtshon na 'grig rgyu 'dod nas mi rabs gsum par btsangs/ yang mi kha dang rang nyid kyis mi 'jon par dogs nas mi rabs gsum pa las bud pa yin zhes brjod pa ni dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa kha yod mig yod cig gi‘‘grub rtags’’ma red/ mig dpe ma red/khri sems dpar mtshon na bod kyi rtsom pa po'i dpung rdang khrod spobs pa'i mgo bo dma' mi dgos pa'i snyan ngas/ pa dga' sa zhig red/ khong gis bris pa'i〈zhi bder smon pa〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag la skabs gsum pa'i sbrang char smyug gsar bya dga' thob cing2 0 07lo'i〈sbrang char〉'don thengs dang por ngo sprod mdzad/ 〈nyi 'od lam lam khrod kyi lha sa/ zla 'od bsil bsil khrod kyi lha sa〉la rgyal yongs skabs dang po'i gangs rgyan me tog rtsom rig bya — 171 —

byams phrugadaga' thob cing2 007lo'i〈gangs rgyan me tog〉deb dang po'i rkang gling le tshan du mtshams sbyor zhus pa red/ 'di ni snyan ngag pa khong sgyu rtsal gyi las kar bstims pa nas bzung zhabs rjes 'od du 'tsher te/ 'jig rten mi yul du bzhag pa'i zas rin yin la/ snying nye ba'i klog pa po dag la phu'/ ba'i gya nom gyi legs skyes kyang lags so/ 'on kyang nye lam khos rang nyid kyi mi gzhir dma' 'beb byas pa'i mdzad pa 'i/ga bstan pa ni mi rabs gsum pa'i tshogs gral nas bud pa de red/ khyod kyis kyang rgyun par mi rabs gsum pa'i tshogs gral nas bud pa ni rang nyid kyis snyan ngag la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur tsam mo zhes nan cag cag gis brjod kyin yod mod/ mi rabs gsum pa zhes pa'i tshogs pa 'dzugs mkhan yang khyod yin/ bod kyi snyan ngag gsar ba'i sgal tshigs steng ke rer 'grengs pa'i mi bu de yang khyod yin na/khyod kyis nges par du rang nyid la bya ra rnal ma byos na red/ lta rtog nan mo byas na red/ de min na rang nyid tshogs dpon yin pa'i thob thang la ji ltar gdong gtod rgyu/ mi bu sgal tshigs can zhig gi snang brnyan ji ltar rang ngos nas bzhengs skrun byed rgyu ang / rang re'i bod la rgya yig thog dang bod tshig thog skyes pho rab kha na tshig gcig sogs bshad zin pa'i skad char rang nyid kyis 'gan khur ba dang dam tshig brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i skor gyi gtam — 172 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/ dpe dang bshad pa mang du yod/ stag gi rnga mar 'ju mi nyan/ 'jus pa'i nyin mor gtong mi nyan zhes pa ltar bya ba gang 'dra zhig la dbu khyud bris zin phyin khyed kyis der bzhi shad 'god par blo gcig sems gcig byed pa las zhag gsum lon tshe rjes med g.yeng bas 'khyer song na‘‘grogs po/ 'byor tshe nye ba'i drung na zhum zhum du 'gro zhing rgud tshe ring ba'i sa na mdzub ker gyis 'phya mkhan de khyod e yin/ yang gna' mi'i kha dpe la 'phongs la rtsam skya byugs nas dgo ba'i nang du 'gro mkhan dang mgo la ru thur btsugs nas shwa ba'i nang du rgyugs mkhan de'ang khyod e yin nam/’’(skyabs chen gyis)rang gis rang nyid la yid ches rgyu dang rang gis rang nyid la brtsi srung /rang brtsi'i bsam blor mthong chen byed rgyu ni mi ru 'grengs pa'i ma mtha'i cha rkyen yin pas nga tsho gangs ljongs gsar pa'i rjes rabs pa tshor tag tag snying stobs 'di dgos pa ma yin nam/ chu mgo nas rnyog na dwangs pa med pa bzhin khyod kyis mgo nas o chi mus lo'o h+phu(chi kho h+phu'i sgrung gtam〈mdog 'gyur da byid〉nang gi mi sna gtso bo zhig)lta bu'i mig dpe bzhag na khyos 'dang rgyobs dang 'di bya las yag po zhig red dam/ de las kyang gal che ba ni khyod kyi mtha' 'khor na yod pa dag dang khyod kyi tha tshig klog mkhan dag gi snang ngor 'du shes gang 'dra skyes srid rgyu red/ rang nyid kyi mi gzhi'i rtsis thang dang bcas — 173 —

byams phrugapa mig gi zur la'ang mi 'jog par khas blangs pa'i dam bca' dag 'di ltar gang byung phangs med du dor na khyod las shes bya'i chu tshad skas rim 'gas dma' ba dag dang ka ngo yig ngo mi chod pa'i mang tshogs dag dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i gsar gtod kyi snying stobs kyis phyug pa'i mi bu sger tshugs can zhig tu nam zhig chags thub bam/ gang ltar kyang ngas khyed kyi grib ris las ngogs gzhan zhig gi grib gzugs kyang mthong yong ngo /gnyis/ rdog thos gzhus pa'i mi nabs gsum pa/mi rabs gsum pa zhes pa'i tshogs pa 'di ni2005lo'i zla6pa'i tshes20nas zla7pa'i tshes2bar bsdus pa'i lang tsho'i rbab chu'i snyan ngag gyer 'don tshogs 'du'i steng du dngos su dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags mdzad la skyabs chen bde grol gyis de 'brel gyi snyan ngag cig kyang gyer 'don zhus/2skyu06lo'i zla7par skabs dang po'i bod kyi snyan ngag gi mi rabs gsum pa'i bgro gleng tshogs 'du zi ling du bsdus/ dang blangs mgo 'dzin pa skyabs chen bde grol dang khri sems dpa' gnyis kyis so sor〈bya ba lam du song ba zhig la snyan ngag rnyed byung〉dang〈〈gtor brlag gi yon tan dang nyes dmigs〉gnyis sgrog sbyong byas te mi rabs gsum pa zhes pa'i tshogs pa dngos — 174 —

mtshan smag tha/sa bdas pa'i nga cho/su dbu brnyes khul byas/ mi rigs dang la rgya sogs brjod bya'i srog tu bkol nas snyan ngag 'bri gyin pa'i rang grol ni mi rabs dang po dang / rtswa thang dang sbra nag sogs yid gzugs bkol nas brjod snying mtshon gyin pa'i ljang bu ni mi rabs gnyis pa/ de gnyis dang mi ma tshungs par mtshon thabs gang gi cha5 tsha/sa kyang gsar rkyang du grub yod pa'i skyabs chen rang nyid dang bcas pa ni mi rabs gsum pa yin par 'dod kyin yod/ snyan ngag gi 'phel rim thad mi rabs kyi sgo nas go mtshams 'byed rgyu 'di ni rgya nag la sngon chad dar mod( rgya nag pa tshos lnga bzhi'i las 'gul gyi 'khrug klong khrod snyan ngag de gna' rtsom gyi gras nas len mkhan gyi phal skad rtsom pa po dag la mi rabs dang po dang / rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul gyi rjes su snyan ngag de chab srid kyi ra skor nang nas len mkhan dag la mi rabs gnyis pa/ de'i rjes kyi snyan ngag de mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes kyi phyi shun las len mkhan dag la mi rabs gsum pa zhes btags 'dug)kho tshos ni lugs srol de dag 'khyer nas bod kyi snyan ngag steng bkol ba red/ spyir kho tshor de 'dra'i tshur len gyi snying stobs yod na ni mthe bong bsgrengs sa'i gnas lags mod bshad ma shes tshig sne so la thogs/'gro ma shes rkang sno rdo la thogs na ni dngos gnas bzhad gad du 'gro ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig las ma 'das/ kho tsho'i tshogs pas phyi gling na bsdus brjod kyi — 175 —

byams phrug nags tshal du bgrangs bzhin pa'i snyan ngag pa bho ti ler dang shig se pher sogs la lad zlos kyis brtse dung snyan ngag gam ser po'i snyan ngag brjod bya'i srog tu 'dzin la/ rlig spu dang myos bum/ mo mtshan/ brla sha sogs 'das mchod byas zin pa'i tha snyad chag ro 'ga' bskyar bsgrig gis‘‘nam rgyun bud med tshor 'khrig pa spyod dus’’dang‘‘rang gi pho mtshan mo'i mo mtshan la shed kyis rdzong gin’’‘‘gcer bur bud dus snying bo mi 'dug’’sogs ches mi 'dod cing / ches mi sdug pa'i tshig dum 'di 'dras mi rabs gsum pa dag gi ngo gdong dang brang gzhong ston gyin pas na rnam pa tshos soms dang / 'di ni rang re'i snyan ngag 'phel rgyas khrod kyi 'phar lding zhig yin nam lam khar bkag rdo zhig bzhag pa red dam/ 'di ltar byas na spyi tshogs kyis snyan ngag la bton pa'i 'gan khur ma 'grub par ma zad klog pa po khri p+tong mang po'i myong rol gyi ngo gdong la yang tshad 'dra min gyi rma kha bzos pa red/ khyod tshos rang nyid kyi snyan ngag la thun min gyi khyad chos brtsi rgyu yod zer na/dngos gnas rten 'brel zhu dgos pa'i don dag gzhan zhig las 'di ltar klog pa po'i myong rol tshu chad la 'dang mi rgyag spyi dmangs tsho'i mi chos kun spyod kyi rnam bzhag tsam por yang 'dang mi rgyag spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho til 'bru tsam yang bskong bar mi nus na shog bu de dag dang snag tsha de dgage 176 ge

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/da dung khyod tsho mnyam du 'dus dus kyi chang rin dang du rin dag chud zos su btang ba las med/ (khyod tshos chang 'thung zhing du ba 'then pa'i don dag la ngas the gtogs bya mi thub mod ches thabs rdugs pa'i skad cha zhig bshad na dngos gnas 'di 'dra zhig red)nub phyogs bsam blo rig pa'i lo rgyus 'byeng/ stangs de yang ko pe'e nyi'i(kho1khu0/'i5ci bu0ji01ba1 khupusdu)nyi lte smra bas lo ngo stong phrag ring mkhregs 'dzin byas pa'i yā li si tho ther gyi sa'i go la lte bar smra ba'i lta ba la thad kar gdong gtug bzos pa lta bu dang / tar lbun(khu1'i11'u3 bam171 ba)gyis 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i gzhung lugs bton rjes ye shu chos tshogs kyis mi ni dkon mchog gis bskrun to snyam pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs la thad kar rdung rdeg btang ba lta bu/(1870—lo ra mar khe si mu'i lī'i yis〈chos lugs rig pa'i spyi bshad〉ces pa'i dpe gzhung brtsams rjes chos lugs ni dad bya kho na zhig yin pa'i 'du shes bsgyur nas de yang dpyod bya zhig yin tshul bshad pa sogs)kho tshos kyang dus rabs 'byed stangs de bden lugs kyi cha nas phyes pa las mi rabs kyi cha nas phyes pa ma red ang /nang bsam blo'i steng gi thod brgal gyis phyes pa zhig las phyi'i dbyibs rnam dang kha dog tsam gyis phyes pa zhig ma red ang / skyes mchog rig smra ba don grub rgyal lags kyis gnad don la la dang lhag par du rig gzhung skor gyi — 177 —

byams phrug gnad don ni re zhig bden rdzun gyi phu thag gcod dka' bas dus yun ring bo zhig la rtsod pa bya dgos pa dang dus yun ring bo zhig gi tshod bgam brgyud dgos zhes pa ltar dus yun ring tsam 'gor rjes mi rabs rjes ma dag gis rang shugs kyis rting thag gcod srid pas khyod tsho ci zhig la rngam pa yin/ ci zhig thob 'dod kyi mig zung hrig hrig byed pa yin nam/ gang zhig shor dogs kyi lag zung zed zed byas pa yin nam/ tshogs pa'i 'phel rgyas dang dgos mkho ltar snyan ngag pa 'ga' re ni gang 'dod kyis mi rabs gsum pa'i nang du 'then gyin 'dug a rdor gyis‘‘grogs po 'gas bshad pa ltar na/nga mi rabs gsum pa yin tshul bshad yod zer/ 'on kyang ngas de lta bu zhig gtan nas shes med’’zer ba bo/ bos dngos su thos myong / gzhan gnyan dang mdo smad he ru ka the'u reng sogs kyis rang nyid mi rabs gsu ma pa'i min tshul dang de'i thad dga' bo med tshul mang du bshad kyin 'dug don gnad 'di'i zur ngos nas skyabs chen gyi sger gcod kyi ngo gdong zhig dang /mi gzhi'i khe dbang la btsan drag gis 'jigs ston gyin pa'i bran khol gyi ngos shig kyang mthong thub ki khri sems dpa' 'di ltar tshogs gral nas 'bud tshul la bltas na khyod tsho deng ma phyogs rlung gang zhig gis ded de lhan du 'dus pa dang 'dra la nges 'byung skyes te 'bud na bsam dus 'gro yang chog — 178 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/pa'i 'khyam po tag tag las lta sa gzhan med ki 'di ni mi rabs gsum pas lag rjes 'jog pa'i dan rtags yin nam/ 'di ni mi rabs gsum pas lab lab thams cad don thog tu 'khyol ba'i bden pa'i rang sgra yin nam/ngo ma bshad na mi rigs kyi bde sdug phrag par len phod mkhan tag dang mi 'dra'o/ /gsum/ thod brgal rang snang ma/ nye sngon nged bod yig slob gling gi da lo'i zhib 'jug slob mas mthar phyin dam bca' 'jog pa'i nyin mor slob dpon chen mo dor zhi lags kyis dam bca' ba ge sar la 'di ltar dris byung ste/ bod kyi snyan ngag gsar ba dar nas lo ngo nyi shu rtsa bzhi las lon med/ 'di 'dra'i dus yun thung ngu'i nang mi rabs gsum byon song ngam/ gal te dngos gnas de ltar byon song na mi rabs dbye spyad kyi khyad chos dang tshad gzhi gang 'dra 'jog rgyu yod ces mtshar nyams kyis dris byung / ngas 'dir ched du gleng 'dod pa ni snyan ngag gi mi rabs bzhi ba'i dpung khag yin/ mi rabs gsum pa btsugs nas lo ngo gcig kyang 'gor med par nga tsho'i snyan ngag la tshad mthon po'i‘‘thod brgal’’dang‘‘dkyogs mtshams’’byung ste mi rabs bzhi bar slebs byung / kha — 179 —

byams phrugasang de ring dra thog na dge chos zhes pa zhig dang chos shul ba zhes pa zhig gis‘‘nga tsho'i rtsa don ni sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs gsar bar snyeg pa dang bod mi'i 'du shes kyi gting na nyal ba'i bsam blo phyir mngon byed du 'jug pa'am/ 'u cag thams cad kyi lus steng na khyab pa'i pin la tin gyi cha shas rnams mngon du 'jug rgyu de yin’’zhes bsgrags gtam cha ma 'chol spel te snyan ngag gi mi rabs bzhi ba zhig yod tshul lab kyin 'dug zer/ skad cha 'di ni ngas nyin der grogs po'i kha nas thos pa'i skad cha zhig yin/ skyabs chen sogs kyis snyan ngag gi zhing sar dar tho btsugs te rnang ma bkar ba nas rang re'i gzhon rabs snyan ngag 'bri khul byed mkhan tshor ri bong cal 'drogs dang / ston lo rlung 'khyer/ drag 'drogs 'ur zhogs kyis phung 'dre 'di tshos rang rgyud brlams nas hol rgyug gis yang gang 'dod kyis mi rabs re dgar srid dam snyam pa'i sems khral dang dogs gzhi snga mo nas yod myong / sun snang zhig gis yongs su gtses pas/ ska da cha 'di thos ma thag rna g.yas pas bsus te g.yon pas tshod tshod med par rgyang phud du gtong dgos pū 'i/ga tu gyur song /nga la yang khag med de ngas ni ngag rgyun khrod kyi khyab 'jug gis rkang ba spo thengs gnyis kyis 'jig rten khams bzung ba'i rig byed gtam rgyud de dang de'i rigs can du ma rjes su 'gro ba'i chos dag zhe thag pa nas dang len byas — 180 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/thabs med pas so/ /‘‘mi rabs bzhi bas(a rag kho nas nyi ma mi 'phud cingamomo mtshan rkyang bas snyan ngag kyang mi 'bri(mi rabs bzhi bas(stong bsam gyi sgrub phug mi bzhengs shing(nam mkha'i dbyings su sgyu rtsal la'ang mi 'tham(mi rabs bzhi bas(dngos thog gis nag nyes ther 'don byed cing(bden lugs la brtsi 'khur yang dag byed(mi rabs bzhi bas(rlabs chen gyi brtse dung la bstod glu len zhing(rang dbang gi 'tsho bar de las gcesadzemi rabs bzhi bas(gnas lugs 'khyer nas spyi tshogs la zhugs shing(chos nyid 'khur te rgyal khams 'grim(mi rabs bzhi bas(ngo srung bcad de drang bzhag srung zhing(khe phan ched du bran 'bangs mi byed(mi rabs bzhi bas(stong nyid rten 'byung gi gdangs dbyangs mi gyer zhing('tsho gnas dang bde skyid la re snyeg byed’’sogs tha tshig 'ga' re cig car du sgrog dus/ gsar zhen g.yam rgyug pa kha kher gyis kyang mi rabs bzhi bas snyan ngag gi dar cha so ma 'ig bsgrengs byung zhes bstod glu gyer bar rtsom gyin 'dug snyan ngag pa'i lo tshod ltar mi rabs dgar ba tsam gyis snyan ngag kyang der bstun gyis gong du 'phags 'gro na rang re'i snyan ngag ni rtsed spyad tsam du zad paṭashaṃ ngu bro/ des na mi rabs ma bgos pa'i kha sang bar du snyan ngag la 'phel rgyas ma byung ba yin nam/ mi rabs dgar rjes kyi de ring nas mgyogs 'gros me shugs —— 181 —

byams phruga'aphur mda' bzhin stong khams brtol nas 'phur 'gro bar e snyam/ mi rabs bzhi btsugs pa ni rang re'i snyan ngag 'phel rgyas kyi gol lam zhig red/mi rabs bzhi bas ni g.yag gtong na rkang snam phud dgos(ṭhaṣ+ṭhachatshiṭha)zer ba dang 'dra bas dgos pa spu tsam med pa'i las bya lhag ma zhig las ma 'das/lo ngo nyi shu lhag las lon med pa'i rang re'i snyan ngag gsar ba 'di mi rabs kyis go thang phyes te/ 'di kho'i red dang de nga'i red ltar tshong zog bgo bgo byas na nga tshos ngo ma rang nyid kyi snying nye ba'i rig gnas dag la ji ltar gces spras byed kyin 'dug gam/ khyod khyod kyi sa na dzig nyams kyis 'gying / nga nga'i sa nas sgam mdog gis mi bo che zhig yin tshul ltar 'grengs na mthun sgril dang mnyam las zhes pa su tshang la dbang ba'i nom rdzas yin nam/ da dung gangs ri'i ring lugs mi rabs 'byed pa'i nad yams 'di gud yangs su gtong drags na mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi khrod nas thon zhing mjug mthar yang spyi tshogs kyi khrod du sim 'dzul bya dgos pa'i snyan ngag sgyu rtsal dag nam zhig mang tshogs tsho'i lag tu yang tog tsam re lhung srid rgyu red dam/ khrigs khrigs med na/ sa skyes rdo skyes byed kyin pa'i snyan ngag pa'i mi rabs 'di dag gi rkyen pas mi rabs lnga ba dang drug pa/ bdun pa sogs kyis kyang sdom tshig khra la 'khrul le — 182 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/re 'god kyin/ skad cha rdza na rdzun ne re shod kyin/ snyan ngag smya sa smyo se re 'bri kyine ngo tsha med par bod kyi rtsom stegs steng thon na thang / u ru su'i rtsom rig mi sna'i khrod kyi mi lhag ma lta bu'i snyan ngag pa'i mi rabs tsho ang /gzhon sha dod pa'i nga tsho'i snyan ngag gsar ba 'di dag skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs byung ste nam zhig 'dzam gling snyan ngag gi dpung khag khrod nas kyang mgo bo smad mi dgos par 'grengs thub bam/ dmigs 'ben de dang phugs bsam der slebs par nga tshos da dung gus rtag brtson pas sems pa nang du bkug nas bden pa brdar ba'i snyan ngag mang du thon skyed byed rgyu las kha phyir 'khor te mi rabs dbye ba'i las kar da dung slebs ran mi 'dug de'i rkyen kyis thod brgal 'di ni rang snang rang lugs kyi thod brgal zhig dang mi rabs 'di ni rang re'i snyan ngag 'phel rgyas kyi gzhung lam nang 'phred tshugs kyis 'grengs dgos zer mkhan tag tag yin pas/ nga ni de dag gi gnyen por gzhom gzhig bral ba'i drag po'i sku ru bzhengs na 'dod do/ /2 0 07lo'i zla6pa'i tshes5nyin slob khang du bris/

byams phrugabod kyi pe cin slob chen/ rgya mi rigs lta bur mtshon na spyi tshogs tshan rig gi phyogs su yon tshad ches mtho ba dang byas rjes ches che ba ni pe cin slob grwa chen mo red/ ngas 'di nas pe cin slob chen lta ba'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ni nub byang mi rigs ༄slob grwa chen mo red ces brjod na/ so skyes pa mang mang zhig gis kha sha brdzes brdzes dang sna sha gnyer gnyer gyis/ ‘‘'di ni phyogs lhung ba'i skad cha yan gar ba zhig red’’ces zer bzhin rna g.yas pas bsu ma dang rna g.yon pas skyel ma byas srid na thang mod/ lag pa brang la bzhag nas bsam gzhig rno la brdar dus/ 'di ni ngan pas rang bstod dang kha tas sgro bstod byas — 184 bhe

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/pa'i gtam nyog tsam ma yin par/ skad cha 'di dag de ltar lab chog chog yin la thogs kyang rung rung yin pa'i gzu bo'i gtam du lags so/dgon sde khag phud pa'i bod la rgyal gnyer slob chen 'ga' re las med/slob chen so so'i shes bya'i sgrig gzhi'i grub lugs mi 'dra ba dang / dge slob kyi dpung sde'i rdzong stug min sogs kyi cha nas slob chen so so'i rig gnas mkha' dbugs la yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod mod/ rgya nag gi lnga bzhi'i las 'gul khrod pe cin slob chen gyis las 'gul gyi mgo rnga mjug gsum khrod du gtso khrid kyi nus pa gang 'dra thon pa ltar/ ngas yang 'di 'dra'i sngon byung la mig ltos sgos rig gnas snying stobs kyi gsar 'dzugs dang / shes yon pa'i grag 'gul sogs kyi mthong sne( slopaṃ)'di bed spyad nas skad cha tshig 'ga' zhu bar 'dod pa la/ rgya nag pa tshor pe cin slob chen ma the ba'i chin hwa slob chen dang / h+phu tan slob chen/ nan kha'e slob chen sogs slob chen ming grags can mang po yod mod/ 'on kyang pe cin slob chen la gzhan las lhag pa'i gong bkur dang brtsi mthong byed don ni/rgya nag pa tsho'i lo rgyus kyi dkyog mtshams dang / dus rabs gsar bar gdong kha phyogs pa'i gom stabs dang po 'di nas bsgyur bas red/ de yang brnan tshig gis bshad na/ lnga bzhi'i las 'gul gyi bsam blo'i me stag thog — 185 —

byams phrugamar 'di nas mched la/ dus rabs gsar ba'i ru 'dren du grags pa'i na gzhon khyu gcig gis mi bu'i rang skad thog mar 'di nas bsgrags pas red/rang re'i bod lta bur mtshon na/ rig gnas dgag bzhag gi tsha rlabs ches cher 'phro zhing / bsam blo'i brdar gtsub kyi gdong gtug drag tu ma ched kyin pa'i dus skabs 'di 'drar/ nga tsho bod kyi slob chen pa zhig yin pa'i thob thang 'di'i thog nas/ spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur dang 'gro ba mi'i bde sdug gi gnad don dag gser ltar bor ba'am thal ltar 'dor ba gang rung mi byas par/ ki 'don thub mkhan gyis ki shugs 'byin thub mkhan gyis shugs bton na ni‘‘me dang tsha la 'phrad pa las/ /kha dog gzhan zhig skye bar 'gyur’’mod/ rang re'i slob chen pa mang che ba ni khung chung sar 'dzul nas kha rog ger ngag sdom mkhan gyi srog chags snying chung can dag dag las ma 'das/ sngon chad lta bu yin na g.yul 'gyed dang 'thab 'khrug khrod nas pha rol dgra yi mgo bo snye ma 'breg 'breg byas btang na tshang mas de la mthe bong bsgrengs bzhin mi'i nang gi dpa' bor brtsi ni red/ sa'i go la yongs rdzogs khyim tshang gcig dang 'gro ba mi kun gnyen tshan nye du ru 'dod pa'i dus 'dir/ don gyi dpa' bo gcig gi mtshan gzhi 'jog dgos na/ spyi ba'i las don la do khur dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes drag pa/ 'gro ba mi'i thob — 186 —

mtshan spag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/thang thad sha thang thang gis 'bad mkhan gyi shes yon pa dag la da gzod nga tshos mi rigs kyi dpa' bo zhes btags na 'grig pa red/ kha phyogs 'di ltar khog rtsis brgyab na/ rang re'i slob chen pa dag gi nang na mdzur mo nang 'gug gis brtsi chog pa'i don gyi shes yon pa rnal ma ga tshod 'dug gam/nga dang khyod/ kho sogs bye brag pa mang pos mi rigs zhes pa'i tshogs spyi gtos che ba 'di grub pa yin la/ mi rigs mi rigs zhe na yang mdzub mo btsugs nas pha rol ba zhig bstan du med par de nyid mthar ded nas mdor dril na mi rang rang ba'i steng na gzhi grub du yod/ ‘‘rang nyid 'khyongs par gyis/ spyi tshogs la khur bo ma snon’’zhes pa'i 'ja' phan gyi gtam dpe 'di ltar gal te khyod nyid mi rang skyes dang rdza ma rang 'khol sgos mi bu dpyod shes can zhig tu chags yod na khyod kyis mi rigs spyi'i bya gzhag dang mdzad 'phrin gong du 'phel bar legs tshogs kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa bskrun pa las/ spyi tshogs kyi gad snyigs dang mi'i rigs kyi khur bo ru 'gyur mi nyan/ gal te mi rigs de nyid sa sgang ril mo'i steng nas rkang ma tshugs par rgud pa'i lam du zhugs gyur na/ khyos kyang bsam blo'i brdab gsig nas mgo brtsams te mgo rus skam po thang la thor dgos rgyu red/ 'di ltar bshad na bye brag khongs mi dang tshogs spyi mi rigs gnyis ni phan tshun dgar du med la dbyer mi — 187 —

byams phrugabatub pa'i spyi tshogs 'brel ba(rnye1ṣ+pecholko)gnyis yin/ de ma zad deng sang nga tshos kha zad zad dang lce 'dar 'dar sgos bshad dang shob kyin pa'i rig gnas gsar ba yin na yang / khyod kyis nga la gsar zhen g.yam rgyugs pa zhes sdang mig bgrad kyang / nga yis khyod la rnying zhen mkhregs 'dzin pa zhes sdig mdzub ker kyang / bshad stangs ma 'dra ba ma gtogs mi rigs 'di bsam pa 'dra 'dra red/ go thob ma 'dra ba ma gtogs bod kyi rig dze gnas zhes spar 'ju byed kyin pa 'dra 'dra red/ gnad don gang dang gang yin na yang‘‘mi mang kha na gros yod’’ces pa ltar mang pos bsam 'char bton te bgro gleng gi stegs bu che ru bskyed na/ sa 'phyar na rdo lhang la 'bud rgyu zhig yod mod/ bod kyi slob chen pa mang po de 'dra'i brdab gsig mod pa'i tsher ma'i lam khar rkang ba mi 'jog la spo yang phod kyin mi 'dug lo sngon mar lho nub mi rigs slob chen gyi dus deb rtsom sgrig pa zhig nga'i sar yong myong / khos khyed tsho'i nub byang tshang na rig gnas dgag bzhag gi las 'gul zhig dar gyin yod mod/ don gyis bshad na de ni nga tshos kha gang sngar bltas nas bshad dgos ni zhig ma red/ dus tshod kyi 'phel 'gros dang bstun nas don dag rang shugs kyis thag chod yong zer/ skad cha de 'dra rna rtsar lhung dus/ yi chad kyi shugs ring ngar mas snying rtsa kun lcug 'dar rgyag — 188 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/ni zhig dang / kho tsho'i phyi bshol dang khung 'dzul gyi gti thug bsam blor zhe gting nas skyus bro ni zhig red/ gal te dge chos rin po ches‘‘'dod pa'i khams 'di 'dod chags sa pa ste/ /skye bo thams cad 'dod pa don du gnyer/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun gyi phul byung ba/ / pho mo gnyis sbyor 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid/ /’’zhes〈'dod pa'i bar+sha na bcos〉mi rtsom rgyu na/'dod sdom ring lugs(/bo76lhaspra)kyi 'jigs rung gi rig gnas ma lag des nga tsho'i bag nyal 'du shes kyi khrod na zed zed du yod pa'i 'dod pa dang chags pa dag‘‘spang bya’’dang‘‘nyes ltung’’du brtsis nas/ nga tsho'i 'jig rten pa la gong thang cung tsam yang gcod rgyu ma red/ rin thang nyug tsam yang 'jal rgyu ma red/ gal te don grub rgyal gyis‘‘bstod pa bris na los chog kyang / /ha cang bstod pa thal che na/ /gang gā'i chu bo rgya ma tshor ba'in/ /smad pa'i ba tshwar nges par 'gyur/ /’’zhes〈bstod pa bklags pa'i 'char snang〉mi 'bri rgyu na/ rang re'i rtsom rig gi gnam sa na sku bstod dang gnas bstod lta bu'i khyong/ bzang nga bzang nga tsho tshang ma bzang ba'i bstod tshogs kyi rkya 'thab pa'i rtsom 'bri'i rnam pa zhig las mi bu'i sger gshis kyi brtan srung dang / mi bu'i tsis thang gi rgyang 'bod/ mi bu'i bla srog gi dwangs ma ma nogs pa'i bris rtsom legs po nyung rgyu red/ ‘‘'jig rten steng mdzes sdug med pa ma yin — 189 —

byams phrugamod/ med pa ni mdzes sdug gsar rtogs byed pa'i mig med pa de red’’ces pa ltar shes rab dang blo gros kyi mig gis rtogs 'jug dang 'tshol dpyod byed dgos pa las gnad don yod sa nas ma mthong ma rig mdog gis btang snyoms su bzhag na/ de shes yon pa zhig gi bsam bya ma red/ las bya ma red/ 'o na/ nga tshos da dung kyang sgug nas 'dug gam/ gnam nas me tog cig lhung srid dam zhes re nas brten nas 'dug gam/ gzhan rigs me shugs 'phur mdar zhon nas zla ba'i go lar 'dzeg shul du/ nga tshos da dung skya mo'i rkang lam nas rta ba'i bde skyid kho na gleng nas 'dug rgyu yin nam/go skabs dang khe bzang ni rang nyid rang 'gul can du btang bas da gzod thob rgyu zhig yin pa las/ rtag par byi long khung 'dzul gyi brtul zhugs kho na bzung na khyod la ci zhig thob rgyu red dam/ ngas khyod la bshad de khyod la gshin rje'i pho nya'i brda yig las 'byor rgyu gzhan cang med/ 'di ltar sdod yu/na drags na nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di yang 'dzam gling chu klung chen po'i shabs rgyug khrod nas lbu dkar re rer gyur te tha mar stong khams su tshod tshod med par 'thims 'gro bar bsam blo e btang / dmag dpon byed mi 'dod pa'i mi ni dmag mi bzang bo zhig yin thabs med 'a/ rtogs sad pa dang sngun skyod pa byed mi 'dod pa'i mi ni dus nam yang mi bu gsha' ma zhig tu gyur da 190 da

dz+wa mtshanasmagagis bdas pa'i nga tsho/thabs mi 'dug1917lor tsha'o yon phe pe cin slob chen gyi slob spyir bsdad pa nas bzung khos slorngapre chen ni spyi tshogs kyi lag rtsal slob grwa ang dang po yin par bsam la/ slob chen slob ma ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i rmang rdo dang stobs shugs yin par 'dod/ phyi phyogs nas 'i tā kra'o dang kru'u tsi chi'ang sogs gdan 'dren byas nas dge rgan gyi dpung sde brtan po zhig chags par byas/ 1917lo'i zla dang por〈rlabs rgyun gsar ba〉(〈lkotshe〉)zhes pa'i tshags par de bton pa nas bzung / pe cin slob chen du lo rgyus kyi las 'gan lce mo phrag tu len phod pa'i na gzhon gsar ba'i khyu zhig byung ba red/dpung sda des bsam blo gsar ba dang rtsom thabs gsar ba'i kha g.yang dron mo'i 'og nas rig gnas gsar ba'i las 'gul thengs shig gi dbu khyud bslangs song / bsam blo rnying ba bskyur nas bsam blo gsar bar phyogs pa dang rtsom thabs rnying ba dor nas rtsom thabs gsar bar gzhol ba'i rlabs rgyun zhig pe cin slob chen nas 'phyur bas/ skabs de'i rgya nag sa khul yongs kyi shes ldan pa tshang mas dga' ba'i bsngags brjod byed cing bstod pa'i me tog stor/ 'bri thabs gsar ba'i sngon 'gro'i rol dbyangs de'i 'og nas da dung〈〈na gzhon gsar ba〉dang / 〈〈gza' re'i dpyad gtam〉— 191 —

byams phrug〈〈rgyal dmangs〉sogs dus deb dang tshags par mang du thon/ da dung hu'u hri'i〈rtsom rig gsar ba'i gsar brje'i 'jugs skrun〉dang khrin tu'u zhi'i〈rtsom rig gsar brje smra ba〉zhes pa'i bris rtsom de gnyis kyis rtsom thabs gsar bas bsam blo gson po ston pa'i dgos nges la sngon skul dang khrid ston byed cing / mgo bo sgur nas rtsom rig gi las kar 'jug gin pa'i na gzhon rnams kyi spobs sems sngar las je brtan du btang / dag dag dus skabs de 'drar pha ri si'i rgyal spyi'i gros tshogs steng rgya nag srid gzhung gi re 'dun dang du ma blangs pas pe cin slob chen gyi slob ma tsho snum la me 'phrad pa bzhin khong khro bzod glags med pa skyes shing de ma thag rngam ston khrom skor dang slob ma'i 'du tshogs bsdus te rgyal spyi'i srid gzhung la kha rdung btang zhing rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang slar gso byed dgos pa'i re nan zhus/ skabs der pe cin na yod pa'i hu'u hri'i dge rgan a ri ba tu'u lbe yis nyin de dag gi gnas tshul mthong 'phral‘ ‘kho tshos slob ma'i ngos thad nas bsam blo gsar ba'i dar cha slong gin 'dug nga tsho'i rgyal nang lta bur lo bcu bzhi yan gyi mi sus rgyal khab kyi las dbang gleng myong ngam/ 'om/ kyang krung go'i slo ba ma sa chab srid bcos bsgyur las 'gul la mgo khrid byed kyin yod la/ da dung tshong las phyogs khag gi mi sna tshang ma yang ngo ma chod par las 'gul nang zhugs kyin — 192 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/yod par bsam na/ 'di dngos gnas rgyal khab rang ga ba zhig ma red’’ces brjod myong yod/ soms dang / 'di ni rgya nag lo rgyus steng skad grags chod nga 'i lnga bzhi'e las 'gul red/ na gzhon slob ma'i dpa' spobs kyis krung go'i mi dmangs yongs la dus chen zhig gi tshul du rjes dran byas su 'jug gin pa'i lnga bzhi'i las 'gul red༈ 'di dag tshang ma pe cin slob chen gyi na gcon gsar ba tshos kung tse dang mong tsi sogs rgya'i snga rabs pa mang po'i ngo gdong du phab pa'i rma kha red/ 'di dag tshang ma pe cin slob chen gyi na gzhon gsar ba dag gis yus ce dang lpang le zhun sogs rgya'i phyi rabs pa kri/ khri 'bum 'bum la bshams pa'i gsol ston gyi thog ma red/rig gnas dgag bzhag dang bsam blo gsar ba e/sa gleng yong dus/mang rma nga zhig 'drogs nas zhogs 'gro rang nyid dang 'brel ba spu tsam med snyam bzhin thag ring thag ring du bkyed nas ltad mo ba kho na'i brtul zhugs 'dzin// drang mor bshad na rang re'i bod la kha sang de ring gsar ba 'ig gi tshul gyis thon gyin pa ma gtogs sa sgang ril mo 'di'i steng brtan brling ngang krong nger 'gying yod pa'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs/ tshang mar las 'gul 'di snga mo nas byung tshar/ 'jar man gyi bsam blo ba dang mtshan nyid rig pa ba nyi tshes‘‘dkon cog shi song / khyed tsho rgyun par mchod mjal du — 193 —

byams phruga'agro sa'i chos khang de ni dkon cog gi dur sa red’’ces pa'i rim 'das can gyi skad cha 'dis ye she'u chos lugs la dad mos rtse gcig byed kyin pa'i mjal ba tsho'i bsam blor g.yo bskyoms bzos la/ dad pa rnam dag gis ye she'u chos khang du gshar gyin pa'i gom stabs la 'khyog gzugs spros/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gsar ba zhig red la/rang re'i bsam blo gsar ba'i las 'gul dang bsdur na dus rabs gcig lhag gi he bag 'dug rgya nag gi lnga bzhi'i las 'gul gyi‘‘khung tshang lam lugs rtsa gtor’’zhes pa'i kha g.yang dang bsgrags gtam gyis rgya nag pa tsho'i rus rkang du sim/ pa'i bag nyal 'du shes la phog thug bzos/ ru'u lugs pa dang to'o lugs pa'i las dbang gnam la bcol ba dang bsam blo phyi la 'khor ba'i 'dzin pa mtha' dag rmeg med du gzhom par 'bod cing skul ba 'di ni1919lo'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gsar ba red la/ 'di dang rang re'i bsam blo gsar ba'i las 'gul gnyis bsdur na lo ngo90lhag gi bar khyad 'dug gong gi dpe mtshon 'di gnyis las 'phros na/ rang cag gi 'di da dung yang las 'gul gsar ba zhig red dam/ min ste de ni gsar rnyed ma byung ba'i las 'gul rnying ba zhig red/ yong ba 'phyi med na len pa snga med pa'i las 'gul 'di nub byang tshang gi na gzhon tshos rig gnas gsar ba'i ge 194 ge

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rang skad sgrog dus spyi tshogs kyi gru ga so so nas‘‘gson 'dre’’dang‘‘ro langs’’sogs tha snyad zur kha can re bkol nas na gzhon tsho'i blo rig gzhog gtub byed kyin yod/ ‘‘bod 'di a gsar che bas’’zhes pa'i slob dpon pad 'byung gi gsung 'di ltar rang rer snga mo nas 'phya smod rig gnas kyi bag chags de dang 'grogs pa'i 'bur 'joms gtong ba'i lag rtsal 'ig 'dugargyal dbang bcu gsum pa rgyal phyir 'grims nas1912lor phyir bod du log rjes 'di 'dra'i skyo gar mang du 'dug mod lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras bton nas yar lung khog tu spyugs pa de ni ches 'thus tshab rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpe gson po zhig red/ mar khu 'thung rgyur goms pa'i 'brog pa zhig gis mar khu'i tshab du phag sha za dgos zer na rem por dang len byed dka' mod 'dris cha je cher song ba dang bstun nas de yang goms pa zhig tu log 'gro/ 'on kyang ngas 'di nas ches bsam blo mi thongs pa zhig yod pa ni da dung yang spyi tshogs kyi gru ga so so nas bod mi byings kyis nub byang tshang gi bsam blo'i thon rdzas gad snyigs su lta zhing / nub byang tshang gi mi bu re re 'dre srin gdon bgegs 'ba' zhig tu ris phab byed kyin pa de red/phyogs bzhi gangs ris bskor bas bsam blo yang kha sbubs khog gzhong can du yod (rang byung khor yug gis mis bsam blor 'di lta bu'i shugs rkyen thebs ge 195 —

byams phrugasrid)pas yin nam gang ltar kyang nga tshor da dung dkyel yangs kyi rig gnas mkha' dbugs shig grub mi 'dug dpyod shes kyi bsam blo'i ljang myug 'bus pa nas‘‘nyi zla zlum por 'tsho ba'am zlum por 'khor ba'i dus tshod kyi mal stan steng du(nga tsho ni rmi lam zur gsum rmis mkhan gyi thog ma yin’’dze(sman bla skyabs kyi tshig)pa'i mi mang du byon mod cung tsam 'thus sgo tshang ba'i ngang nas nga tsho'i mig zung rgyal mor skar chen zhig gi tshul gyis shar yong ba ni〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉nas rtsis na 'grig par sems/ dpe deb 'di mi yul du sku bltams pa nas‘‘khong gis 'bad pa brgya yis 'tshol ba'i rgyu mtshan dang rgyu mtshan de las byung ba'i ngos 'dzin ni byis chung klad med kyi gtam du zadasna’dang‘‘khyed kyis rig gnas gas ra skrun gyi khungs lung ni nyes kun phung bo ste bcings 'grol byas phyin rgyal nang du byung ba'i‘ngo rgol bzhi'i las 'gul’dang ‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo’la bcol ba yin nam’’(a sngags tshe ring bkra shis) ‘‘gzig lpags gyon pa'i mgrin bzang gis rang gi de nyid bsta na pa'i gtam rgyud kyi bro ba zhig bags kyis tshor ro’’dang‘‘da nas bzung khyed cag yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa gangs can yul gyi dus rabs gsar ba'i 'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i lta ba 'dzin pa'i khri la rigs lam kā ma sha'i chu rgyun gyis rgyal thabs spyi — 196 —

mtshanasmagagisabadasapa'ingacho/ da blugs kyi tshul du dbang bskur ba yin no’’’(rme sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho)sogs kyis mtshon pa'i snyad brko gseg 'dru'i dgag rgyag mod pos〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉kyi tshe srog yam yom du bzos/ (tha na btsong gi yang mi 'jug)skabs der dag dag mi bu drug gi bdag nyid can gyi〈bdag dpe tshogs〉thon pas snga ma gleng slong dang gnad don 'don pa'i tshul du song zhing phyi ma gros chod dang gnad don thag gcod pa'i tshul du song / thams cad la dogs pa dang dpyod shes kyis 'jug dgos pa'i shes pa bstsal ba 'dis bod mi sa ya drug po rang dgar sdod du ma bcug la srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ gsar ba dang rnying ba/ lha chos dang mi chos kyi 'gal 'du'i bar gseng nas mang pos 'di ltar gdam ga byas byung ste/ la las srol rgyun rig gnas la shi 'thams ro 'thams kyis‘‘klad pa gsar ba can’’tshor lta log pa dang smyon pa/ rgyang 'phen pa'i ro langs zha bo/ rgyal khab kyi nyul ma sogs zer zhing smod/ la las deng rabs rig gnas la rkang 'ju spar 'ju sgos‘6klad pa rnying ba can’’tshor gna' mi dang rnying zhen mkhregs 'dzin pa/ sa'i go la'i khur bo sogs zer zhing sdigs/ grags skam 'ud kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang ri bong cal gyi sgra la 'drogs pa sogs rmongs 'thoms kyi las kas snang ba snang ba dang mun pa mun par phyes pa las snang stong zung 'jug gi sgo nas dbu ma'i lam du 'grengs — 197 —

— byamasaphrugamakhan nyung tsam red/ kha shas kyis zhogs dung gis mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la gnod pa btang song zer mod dngos gnas gong ltar byas na gnod pa thebs rgyu red/ nga tshor rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bod rang sa'i bon po'i chos lugs gnyis mnyam 'dres dang 'brel mthud la brten pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs 'di 'dra zhig byung chog na/7paṇa chen bcu ba tshang gis‘‘deng gi tshan rig bod kyi rig yon gnyis/ /gong du spel nas shes brgya dar bar 'tshal/ /’’zhes pa ltar rang rer da lta bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs la deng rabs bsam blos zur brgyan pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig gsar du byung na cis ma chog de yang phyogs zhen gyi dbang du song bas dpal na len+d+ra'i dkyel ya ngas kyi rig gnas mkha' dbugs shig nga tshor chags med pas red/ gzu bo'i blo dang drang bo'i mig gis zhogs dung la bltas na yang khos nga tshor dgag sgrub dang dogs slong gi spyan ras shig gnang gin pa 'a/sa chos lugs la mtha' gcig du mdung rtse sprod kyin med par/ mi chos rig gnas kyi ngos thad nas lha chos rig gnas la gdam gses rnal ma byed kyin 'dug gdam ga 'di tsam yang nga tsho'i blo ngor shong mi thub na thub bstan rig gnas kyis nga tshor dngos gnas phan thogs kyin mi 'dug gzhung kun na byams dang snying rje/— 198 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin dgos tshul sogs gal bo che la nan tan gyis bshad kyin yod mod/ chags sdang dbang gis rgyal bar mi 'dod pa ni lta zhogasgom pa'i gnas skabs su mar gyur sems can sgom rgyu phar zhog khab mig tsam po sgom rgyu yang dka' ba'i gnas so/rtsod pa med na bgro gleng med/ bgro gleng med na 'phel rgyas med pa bzhin du nub byang tshang gi bsam blo'i thon rdzas kyis bod kyi rig gnas pa'i sde la bgo bsha' rgyag rgyu'i kha zas shig gnang byung / ljid tig tig gi 'dri rtags rgyun chad med par bstsal byung / 'dri rtags de dag gi 'brung khungs la 'dri rtsad byed dus/ ma gzhi de dag ni nub byang tshang nas mthar phyin pa dang ma phyin pa'i mi bu dag gi mi skad yin 'dug gal te lan gru grong khyer na gnas 'cha' ba'i slob chen 'di ru srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rdzong stug po zhig med na/ gal te chu mig lnga ldan ri 'dabs su gzhi chags pa'i slob chen 'di ru dogs dpyod kyi blo mig mnga' ba'i rtogs sad pa'i dpung zhig med na/rig gnas gsar ba'i ljang myug de 'bus par yang drod lud brlan gsher sogs lhan cig byed rkyen kyi rgyu ma tshang ba red/ krung go gsar ba dbu brnyes tshun gyi mi rigs slob chen ang dang po 'di ru snga mo nas bod kyi rig gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas dbang rje bsam 'grub rgya mtsho tshang dang /— 199 —

byams phrugatshe tan zhabs drung tshang / a lags dor zhi tshang / blo bzang rgya mtsho tshang sogs kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs rkyen 'di na gnas lnga rig pa'i slob khrid kyi rgyun ma chad par yod/ da dung nang don rig pa dang sgra rig pa sogs 'bum rams pa dang rab 'byams par rgyugs sprod skabs kyi sprod byed gtso bor bzhag 'dug dngos gzhi'i slob ma dag gis kyang sgra dang tshad ma/ snyan ngag dang skar rtsis sogs bslab gzhi'i gtso bor byed cing brtson pa chen pos bod brgyud nang bstan gyis srog snying bzung ba'i bod kyi rig gnas la thos brtson khab 'gro 'big 'gro'i tshul du 'jug nan 'dugade ma zad chos lugs rig pa dang dmangs srol rig pa/ mi rigs rig pa dang rig gnas mi'i rigs rig pa sogs deng rabs rig gnas kyi kho lag kyang yo ngas su 'dzoms pas slob ma tshang mas rig gnas sna tshogs kyi nu zho ngoms med du bsten gyin yod/ sku zhabs me lce lags kyis‘‘nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo na nga rang ches dga' sa zhig yod pa ni/ rig gnas gnyis ka dus mnyam du gnas pa de red’’zer/ dngos gnas skad cha 'di ni blo gzu bor gnas pa'i bden pa'i gtam du lags so/ pe cin slob chen kyang 'di dang a 'dra cha 'dra ste1898lor pe cin slob chen(phyis nas ming btags)'dzugs dus nas ru'u lugs pa'i gzhung lugs slob gnyer thad — 200 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/shugs chen po bkal zhing〈〈krung go'i gna' rabs rtsom rig〉sogs khrod gzhir bkol myong yod/ 1919lor lnga bzhi'i las 'gul bslangs pa nas hu'u hri sogs kyis rig gnas gsar ba dang bsam blo gsar ba'i 'dzugs skrun thad thugs mnyam chen po bzhag pas spyi tshogs tshan rig gtsos pa'i gna' deng krung phyi'i rig gnas kyi rig tshan(r+haṇishā)mang po'i bslab gzhi'i rgyun bskyangs pas rgya'i deng rabs rig gnas kyi gzhi grub dang / 'phel rgyas la cha rkyen gang legs bskrun pa red/ bya dngos gsar ba zhig gi phyin thon ni bya dngos rnying ba phan tshun nam nang khul kyi gdong gtug dang 'brel 'dris/ 'gal 'du ba'i rmang ga'i'i steng thon pa yin la pe cin slob chen gyi lnga bzhi'i snying stobs kyang na gzhon gsar ba dag gi bsam blo'i ru 'dren las byung bar gor ma chag de las 'phros byung du bshad na grong khyer can dang 'dzam gling can du phyogs kyin pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la yang deng rabs mi'i dgos mkho ltar cha rkyen bton na rig gnas kyi gzhi'i ma lag la gtan tshigs dam po'i sgo nas 'gyur ba gtong dgos pa ni kha gsal mngon gsal red/ tag tag nub byang tshang gi slob bu rnam dpyod can tshos 'di 'dra'i gnas babs la mno bsam gtong bzhin nga tshor 'gro lam gnyis kyi gdam ga ster bzhin 'dug la/ srol rgyun la rkang btsugs nas deng rabs — 201 —

byams phrugal mig phyogs na ji 'dra red ces sgang pa tshang gi bod mi re rer sgor mo rnga yi gros ra bshams kyin 'dug 'di tsam gyis kyang kho tshos gru zur so so'i rig slob pa tshang mar khong khro slong gin 'dug nub byang tshang gi bdud phrug tsho dang zhogs dung gi rjes 'brangs pa tsho zer bzhin snyad brko gseg 'dru'i dmod tshig mang pos kho tsho phyir btsir nas yong gin 'dug 'di dag tshang ma slob dpon chos grags kyis〈tshad ma rnam 'grel〉mdzad dus nang bstan gyi rjes 'jug pa tshos khyi'i rnga mar btags te bsregs pa dang / lung shar bas rkang drug rtsed stangs bod la spel dus lha sa'i sku drag tshos ston pa'i dbu la rdog thos gzhus pa red zer bzhin mig 'bras bton pa dang ji 'dra'i mtshungs ang / thabs rdugs pa'i byed las 'di 'dra kho tsho'i srog thog tu 'bab don ci red dam/ ma gzhi kho pa cag gis mi mang gi sngon du mgo bo dgye song bas red/ rtogs pa sad song bas red/ ‘‘rdzun gyi lan tsha bral ba'i gtsang ma'i chu/ /nan gyis sbyin pa'i ngal ba kho bos byas/ /’’(dge chos kyi tshig) song bas red/ nub byang tshang gi slob bu tshos kyang mig mthong lag zin gyi gnad don re la khab gtsag 'big gtsag byed bzhin gzu bo'i gtam dang drang mo'i skad cha 'dra chags re shod kyin pa las gzhan ci yang med/rig gnas gang zhig rtsa ba tshugs shing rtse mo rgyas dgos na der dge mtshan — 202 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/brjod pa'i zhor la skyon mtshang kyang slog dgos pa ma zad gtor gshig gtong ba'i zhor la gsar 'dzugs kyang bya dgos pa red/ 'on kyang rang re'i lha chos rig gnas kyi gzhi'i ma lag na the tshom nyid rtsa nyon drug gi nang gses su bgrangs nas dngos po dang 'du byed gang la yang bsam blos zhun brdar byed rgyu med/ 'on kyang rig gnas gsar ba'am rjes dpag gi tshad ma gtso bor byed pa'i rig gnas ma lag gis dpyod shes dang rtogs 'jug gi gong thang gtso bor 'jog la‘‘lag len ni bden don zhib bsher byed pa'i tshad gzhi nyag gcig yin’’zhes brjod srid pa red/ nub byang tshang na 'di 'dra'i blo khog dogs rig gis bzung zhing yid sems rig stobs kyis zin pa'i mi bu mang po yod pa red/ 〈〈shar dung ri〉gtso byas pa'i nub byang tshang gi dus deb dang tshags par khag gis dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'gro lam 'di gar hur thag gis 'jug gin 'dug skya mo'i lam khar kya tse gom tse spo gyin da dung rang rigs rang rigs zer bzhin spobs pa chen pos mdun du bskyod ba'in 'dug de yang mi bu 'ga' re red/ 2007—200ṭ+wāṃlo'i bar nub byang tshang na bod phrug chig stong sum brgya lhag yod mod de dag gi nang du don gyis mi rigs kyi las don la sha thang thang gis 'bad mkhan mi bu nyi shu lhag las med/ rig gnas gnyis kyi 'gal 'du dang 'thab rtsod la mig cer — 203 —

byams phrugabazhin 'di yin de min gyi smra lce 'gul mkhan nyi shu lhag las med/ 'di las dpag na/ bsam blo gsar ba'i dpung khag de ha cang nyag phra ba zhig yin pa shes thub mod/ chal chil 'phyo ba'i rba rlabs kyang zer zer 'khyug pa'i zegs ma re re'i rgyu tshogs las grub pas na mgo brtsam sa rung yin pas 'di tsam yin rgyu red snyam 'ongs/ de ma zad kyi chen po chen po 'ig su la yang bshad du med/ gtso bo ni nga tshor legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig dgos pa red la tshur len byed dgos mod rang srol nyams su 'jug mi srid pa'i sgal tshigs sra mo zhig dgos pa de red/ 'di yod na nga tsho su la yang 'drogs 'drogs dang dogs dogs byed mi dgos/ de bzhin du mi 'ga' res ji ltar bshad kyang chog la gang ltar lab kyang 'os mod/ nga tshos ni dus nam yang‘‘legs par brtag la nga yi bka'/ /blangs par bya yi gus phyir min/ /’’pa'i bka' slob 'di sems kyi tshad gzhir 'dzin dgos pa'o/gong nas kho bos rdzig nyams chen po dang yin mdog kha bos bod kyi pe cin slob chen ni nub byang mi rigs slob chen red ces dpe lung rig gsum gyis brjod song / phyir lta re byed dus kho bos kyang lha ha las shing / mi yid ches pa/ 'dre kho thag chod pa'i gtam zhig lab thub ma song / nub byang mi rigs slob chen ni bod kyi pe cin slob chen red zer na yin 'gro ba'i —— 204 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/nges pa med la min pa'i nges pa yang med/ dngos gnas gnas 'di na1919lo'i lnga bzhi'i las 'gul skabs kyi pe cin slob chen gyi rig gnas mkha' dbugs shig dang na sa/zhon pa'i dpung sde zhig chags nas yong gin yod la/ 'di'i thad bsam blo'i gar stegs lta bu'i dus deb dang tshags par kyang ston mtshan mkha' yi rgyu skar bzhin byung dang 'byung si/na 'dugangs gleng bar 'dod pa'i skad cha kyang snang tshul 9zeridis nga la byin pa'i tshor ba rnal ma yin/ kho bos kyang grags pa'i ched du grags pa 'tshol ba dang 'dra ba'i slad du rgyu mtshan btsal ba ma yin la nub byang tshang gi che ba ngom phyir pe cin tshang gi gnas/ sgo 'grims pa ni gtan nas ma yin/ rang rer 'di 'di dang gan gan 'es rnam dbye bkar ba tsam gyis rngo mi thogs par gtso bo ni dge chos ltar‘‘rang gi rigs la zhen pa dkar po'i mdangs/ /rang byung snying gi dbus na gnas pa 'dis/ /rang yul kha ba can gyi rje 'bangs la/ /rang gi nus pas sri zhu cung zad bsgrub/ /’’rgyu de'o/ / da wa200ra 05 25nyin/bhe 205 —

blosang stebakas/zhan bkod/grag 'gul med pa'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i nyen tshabs gleng ba/da wa nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs7tshogs thengs zhe bzhi ba'i steng gi gtam bshad/mgo 'dzin pa the'u deng gi gleng slong ba'i gtam/slob grogs tsho/ da do dgong gi sgrub thengs zhe bzhi ba'i rang mos gleng stegs dngos su 'go rtsom rgyu byed/ spyir na rang mos gleng stegs 'di slob grogab/ mang che bar cha rgyus yod ni red/ de'ang gtso be+e rang mos gleng stegs kyis 'u tsho'i shes yon pa'i sde gtso byas pa'i spyi tshogs las sgo so sor shugs rkyen mi dman pa zhig bzhag yod pas red la/ khyad par du rang mos gleng stegs kyis 'u cho'i slob gling 'dir mi rigretrari slob chen gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i da 206 da

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/bsam blo rang dbang dang blo khog dkyel yangs/ lta chul brje res kyi rig gnas bgro gleng gi khor yug legs po zhig bskrun nas de ring bar du thon pa red/ 'dzin grwa zhig nas sde khag la kha phyogs pa dang / sde khag zhig nas bod spyi tshogs la kha phyogs pa'i gleng stegs 'di'i rtsa don gtso bo ni gzhung lugs kyi skad cha'i sngun nas rang gi smra bajod la sa/shag btub byed du mi 'jug pa dang / gsungs tshad bden pa mthar thug gi tshad mar 'jog pa'i dbang 'bog len lta bu'i slob gso'i lam lugs la daphyod shes kyi blo mig rnon pos rgyas brda btang ste/ smra brjod rang dbang dang lta ba mnyam gnas kyi rig gnas bgro gleng gi mkha' dbugs bskrun te kher tshugs kyi mi bu re re yar slong rgyu de red/ 'on kyang / nye lam gleng stegs kyi mkha' dbugs sngon ltan 'khrug cha ngod po de 'dra med par 'chad mkhan dang nyan mkhan gnyis kyi rnam pa chig rkyang ba zhig tu 'gro gi 'dug pas/ nged cag mgo 'dzin pa tsho nas phan tshun gros kha bsdun te 'u cag dang na tshod mnyam zhing 'u cag dang rigs pa mtshungs pa'i nang khul gyi slob ma kha shas gleng stegs su mang du zhugs par bskul te bgro gleng gi mkha' dbugs legs por yong ched du shugs rgyag gi yod pa dang / do dgong 'u cag dang mnyam du bgro gleng byed mkhan gyi mi bzhi bo ni rang re'i slob gling gi rang skyed smyug tshogs yin la/ kho tsho ni ban+de — 207 —

gleng stegs/ skyabs(sgren po)dang / dpal chen/ (khro bu) ban+de mkhar/ (byams phrug) a rig mkhas bzang / ('dren byed)bcas red/ des na gzhug nas 'dren byed lags kyi gtam bshad khrod nas do dgong gi bgro gleng dngos su 'go rtsom rgyu byed/ (thal mo rdeb sgra)'dren byed kyi gtam bshad/yad da 'u tshos do dgong gi kha brda byed pa'i mgo rtsom ya/ thog mar ngas 'di nas nged rang skyed smyug tshogs kyi tshab byas te khyed tsho tshang mas dus tshod dang dka' tshegs la ma 'dzems par 'dir phebs par bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ (thal mo rdeb sgra)de ring nga tshos gleng bya'i ming la‘‘grag 'gul med pa'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i nyen tshabs gleng ba’’zhes btags yod/ kha byang 'di 'dra zhig bdams pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer na/ nga tshos nam yang myi'i 'tsho ba dang thag nye ba'i skad cha bshad ni yin/ lhag par du rang nyid dang thag nye ba'i skad cha bshad ni yin/ de'i phyir de ring 'di nas kyang rang nyid slob chen pa zhig yin pa'i ngos thad nas yar 'greng ste slob chen pa rang steng gi gnad don 'apre/'a gleng rtsis yin/ spyir btang slob chen pa zhig la mtshon na 'gan khur — 208 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/ljid ni red/ lhag par du da lta'i bod kyi slob chen pa tshor 'gan khur ljid na 'grig gi 'dod/ nga tshos rang gi mi rigs la sne khrid byed dgos la/ nga tshos rang gi mi rigs kyi nyen tshabs gleng dgos/ 'u tsho gtan nas kha rog ger 'dug mi nyan/ rang gi yab mes kyi lo rgyus shes dgos/ lo rgyus shes pa'i mi tshad snying stobs dang na zug skye dgos/ snying stobs ra(dang) na zug yod na da gzod rang nyid kyi 'gan khur shes ni red/ 'u tsho mi rigs gzhan pa'i slob chen pa tsho ra(dang) bsdur sa 'gro ni ma red/ yab mes kyi lo rgyus 'dra ni ma red/ da lta ba'i gnas babs 'dra ni ma red/ ma 'ongs pa'i skyid sdug yang (kyang) 'dra ni ma red/ de bzhin du da lta'i nga tsho'i bod kyi slob chen pa dag la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gan khur lhag ma 'ig yod na 'grig gi bsam nas/ grags med 'gul med kyi g.yang gzar nas lhung nyen che ba'i da lta'i nga tsho bod kyi slob chen pa tsho'i gnad don 'di la do dgong‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’ki (kyi) go skabs 'dir bstun nas 'u tsho tshang mas kha brda (bsam blo brje res) zhig byed ya/ 'o 'di nas tshang mar kha gsal rgyu zhig la/ do dgong nged tshogs pas rang nyid khyer nas 'ong ba las gzhung lugs khyer 'ong ba min/ de'i phyir rang gi bsam tshul drang mor bshad rgyu yin pa las gzhung lugs shig bskyar zlos byed rgyu min/ mtshams 'di nas — 209 —

gleng stegs/ngas de ring gi gleng bya dngos kyi khag dang po ste‘‘bod kyi slob chen pa'i skad yig gi nyen tshabs’’skor nas rang gi bsam tshul 'ga' bshad rgyu yin la/ gong du bshad pa de dag chogs pa spyi'i gleng gzhi lta bu yin/byung gi(spyir btang)yin na skad yig nyams rgud kyi gnas tshul 'di slob chen pa zhig gi ngos nas tshang mas shes rgyu red/ ngas 'di nas bshad na yang tshang ma'i rna lam du bskyar zlos yin gyi red/ 'on kyang 'u tshos shes bgīn du tshang mas 'di la do snang byed ki med ki ngo ma bshad na do snang byed ki med pa 'di gnad don zhig red/ gnad don tshabs chen zhig red/ des na ngas do dgong 'di nas gnad don 'di tshan pa gnyis su bgos te tshang mar dogs gzhi zhig slong ya/ lta tshul zhig bshad ya/ de ma gtogs ngas 'di nas rang gi zhe 'dod nya ge nyog ge(don med nyog gtam)mang bo zhig gleng nas 'u tsho thun mong gi dus tshod 'phro brlags byas na mi 'grig gi do dgong gi dus tshod 'di 'u tsho tshang ma'i yin ni red/ gtso bo tshang mas 'di nas bsam blo brje res byas na 'grig gi de'i phyir nged tshos gong nas skad chatshonyung nyung zhig bshad nas de la khyed cag gi dri ba dang lta tshul gyi khrod nas 'u tsho thun mong gi kha brda mang bo zhig byed thub na bzang gi tshan pa dang po/ skad yig nyams rgud kyi da lta'i gnas tshul nyung tsam bshad na/ da tshang ma'i mig gis — 210 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/rig sa dang rna bas go sa na yod pa 'di red/ skad dang yi ge ni mi rigs shig yun ring gnas byed kyi bla srog yin pa'i gnas lugs 'di 'u tsho slob chen pa tshor bskyar bshad byed dgos kyi ma red/ phal cher mang che bas shes ni red/ 'on kyang lag len dang don dngos kyi steng nas bltas na 'u tshos ci yang 'khyong gi med pa 'di red/ dper na 'u cho tshang ma bod kyi slob chen pa tag tag red/ 'u tsho'i ched sbyong ra(yang) bod yig yin ni red/ yin na'ang ched sbyong bod yig yin nga/'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i sde 'di na bod yig gis gnang zhu'i yi ge tsam yang dag mo zhig 'bri mi thub pa mang pa gsang rgyu yod ni ma red/ tshang mar gsal no du(de)red/ rgya skad ma bsres na bod skad gtsang ma zhig bshad mi shes pa'i gnad don 'di da lta mdo dbus khams gsum na rgyun ldan du gyur 'dug 'u tsho bod yig sbyong ba'i bod kyi slob chen pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas gnad don 'di dag ma go ma shes khul byed mi nyan ginye ba'i lo 'di dag gi ring la 'u tsho slob grwa ba'i sde la bod skad gsar ba skor 'ig thon yod ki dpe bzhag na/ chu len pa la‘‘chu rgyag gi 'gro’’dang kha par gtong ba la‘‘kha par rgyag’’lta bu sogs bod skad rang steng gi bshad srol bskyur te rgya skad kyi‘‘༈17khri’’dang‘ ༈1thuṣ+ṭha’’sogs thad bsgyur byas nas bshad ni mang bo yod pa red/ da dung dpe zhig bzhag na/ rgya skad kyi‘‘7’’zhes pa'i ge 211 —
