gleng stegs/bya tshig de thad bsgyur byas nas‘‘mdzes ma bda'’’zer ni ra(yang)yod ki(nyan po'i dgod sgra)khyed tshos 'dang zhig rgyobs ra(dang)rang la thob na 'dod pa'i mdzes ma zhig‘‘bda'’’dang na thob rgyu ci zhig yod ki (nyan po'i dgod sgra)gong gi dpe 'di dag bod rang skad na yod pa'i skad cha bskyur nas gzhan zhig gi skad cha btsan bsgyur byas te spyod pa'i snang tshul 'di nga tsho slob grwa ba'i nag nyes red/ de 'dra'i skyug bro ba'i bod skad bshad srol 'di'i 'byung khungs gtso bo gang red zer na/ rgya yig rgya skad la mgo thu(bo)khen pa'i 'u tsho bod kyi slob chen pa rang nyid red/ da rung de'i tshad ni ma red/ rgya skad kyi 'gros dang bstun te skad cha'i mgo mjug ldog nas bshad ni mang gidaper na‘‘dge rgan’’dang‘‘sku zhabs’’lta bu'i thob thang gi ming dag rgya skad kyi bshad srol ltar ming gi rjes su bzhag ste/ ‘‘bdud lha rgyal dge rgan’’zhes pa lta bu dang / ‘‘bkra shis sku zhabs’’lta bu/ ‘‘tshe ring skyid dge rgan’’zhes sogs zer nas bod rang gi skad kyi lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bod skad bshad srol ngan pa mang bo yod kā9 da skabs 'u tsho bod skad nang du rgya skad bsre rgyur lobs yag red/ lobs pas mi tshad byang yag red/ (nyan po'i dgod sgra)dpe bzhag na rgya skad kyi tha snyad ma nga bo bod skad du khyer 'ong nas/ de la de dang 'tsham pa'i byed sgra dang 'brel sgra'i phrad sogs sbyar te bshad srol zhig ra— 212 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/(kyang) yod kādzi ‘6ngamastso 'i nang na yod zer ba 'dra 'dra/ khyodastsalo/ sa 'bod kyin 'dug’’zer ba lta bu'i rgya skad la bod skad kyi phrad sbyar na e yag gimador na 'di dang 'di lta bu'i skad yig nyams rgud kyi nyen tshabs chen po yod ki 'u tshos 'di'i thad la kha brda re byas na ci 'dra red/ 'di don tshan dang po yin/gnyis pa/ 'u cag tshang ma bod kyi slob chen pa tag tag yin pa'i ngos nas gong gi gnad don 'di dag la sems khur byed dgos rgyu red/ sems khur tsam byas pas mi chog gi thog mar rang nyid nas 'go brtsams te lag len dngos su zhugs na 'grig gi red/ de ma gtogs kha stong nang gi tshig stong bshad nas nyi ma skyel thabs dang thang ma skem thabs byas nas bsdad na 'grig gi med ki gong du bshad pa'i gnad don dang nyen tshabs 'di 'u tshos spyir btang gi snang tshul zhig gi steng nas bzhag na gtan nas mi 'grig gi bsam gi rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zer na/ 'di ni 'u tshang gi mi rigs 'di'i bla srog dang 'brel ba zab mo yod pa'i gnad don tshabs chen zhig red/de'i phyir gnad don 'di snang med du 'jog mi nyan gi rtsa ba nyid nas 'jog mi nyan gi 'dod ki de ring 'dir 'dus pa'i 'u tsho phal cher gzhi rim gyi bu phrug tag tag yin rgyu red/ rgyu mtshan bod kyi las byed pa'i bu — 213 —

gleng stegs/phrug mang che ba pha ma dang mnyam du gzhan rjes su khyi ltar brgyugs nas kho tshos bod yig phar zhog bod skad ra(kyang) shes ni ma red/ de'i phyir ngas 'di nas 'u tsho bod yig sbyong mkhan phal cher gzhi rim gyi bu phrug tag tag red zer ba yin/ des na 'u cag gi ma 'ongs pa'i kha gtod sa yang phal cher gzhi rim yin gyi red/ de ma gtogs dpon sa phal cher dpon phrug bod dri mi bro ba'i bod mying can de tshos khyer 'gro ba da lta'i spyi tshogs na mig gis rig rgyu dang / rna bas go rgyu mang no de red/ 'dir ngas zhor du gcig bshad no ma gtogs do dgong gi gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba chen po med ki 'u tsho tshang ma bod yig sbyong ba'i slob chen pa tag tag yin pa'i ngos nas/ mi rigs skad yig gi nyams nyes 'u tshos mi gleng sus gleng nas/ 'u tsho mi rigs kyi sne khrid pa yin ni red/ 'u tsho tshang ma pha yul gyi mi ser tshos mig gis lta sa dang rna bas nyan sa yin ni red/ khyed rnam pas 'dang zhig rgyobs ra(dang)'u tsho bod yig ched sbyong gi slob chen pa'i sde nas bod skad gtsang ma zhig mi shod na bod kyi gzhi rim sa khul nas ci zhig byed rgyu/ da ngas 'di nas mang bo mang bo zhig ma bshad na yang tshang mas shes rgyu red bsam gi mdor na/mi rigs la sha zhen yod na/ zhe bsam pa'i gting na na zug cig yod na/khrag dri bro ba'i dus 'gyur gyi lo rgyus snang brnyan dran na dus tshod gcig skar — 214 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/ma gcig skar cha gcig da lta nyid nas 'u tsho slob chen pa tshos 'go rtsom ran red/ lag len dngos su zhugs te 'go rtsom ran red/ skad cha chen po bshad nas 'dug khom med ki zhes pa 'di tshan pa gnyis pa yin/ gsham nas nged tshogs pa'i grogs po byams phrug gis‘‘bod kyi slob chen pa'i 'du shes’’skor nas kha brda byed rgyu red/ ngas bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog rgyu yin/ bka' drin che/ (thal mo rdob sgra)byams phrug gi gtam bshad/gong nas 'dren byed kyis slob grwa chen mo ba'i skad yig gi nyams nyes rang bzhin nas brtsams te/ nga tshos nges par du rang re'i bla srog lta bu'i skad dang yi ge 'di 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos tshul bshad btang thal/ngas do dgong khyed rnam par bgro gleng byed rgyu'i nang don yin na rang re'i slob chen par mi rigs kyi 'du shes gson po zhig ldan dgos tshul de brjod rgyu yin/nga tsho tshang ma slob gso rabs dang rim pa/ rgyugs che ma chung gsum sogs brgyud nas slob chen du yong ba red/ mi zhig gi mi tshe gang bor las dbang gi dkyog mtshams mang bo yod ni ma red/ rang re'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba tag tag la mtshon na/ gal te nga tshos rang gi mi tshe'i steng thod — 215 —

gleng stegs/brgal zhig dang / 'phur mchongs thengs shig bzo rgyu zer na/ slob grwa chen mo ba'i sgo them du brgal ba 'di ni da gzod nga tshos dngos gnas mi tshe'i bzhud lam steng gi dkyog mtshams shig tu 'dod na 'grig pa red/ mi tshang mar rang rang gi 'dang rgyag stangs dang klad pa 'gul stangs yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob 'bring nas slob chen du rkang ba 'jog dus kyang dmigs yul 'dra rgyu ma red/ yong stangs 'dra rgyu ma red/ gal te mi che ge mo zhig skra 'o ring bo 'jog rgyur ha cang dga' mod/ gnon btsir che ba'i slob 'bring gi ma/ya' dbugs 'og nas/ kho la skra lo ring bo 'jog pa'i rang dbang ma thob pa zhig yin tshe/ kho'i sems par slob chen du thon dus sa 'drud la khad kyi skra lo ring bo zhig 'jog rgyu snyam bzhin slob chen du yong rgyu red/ de las 'phros te bshad na/ nga tsho slob chen du yong dus kyi dmigs yul dang cig byed rgyu/ myig byed rgyu bsam pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs kha kha so so yin ni red/ ngas 'dir dpe zhig 'jog mtho 'bring lo rim gsum pa'i skabs nga'i slob grogs gnyis kyis phan tshun dga' rabs dang dungs rabs mang ngo sogs bshad bzhin/ slob sbyong ma yin pa'i 'jig rten snang ba mang bo zhig bshad ki 'dug nyin zhig dge rgan gyis gnas tshul de dngos su shes pas/'dzin grwa'i tshogs 'du zhig gi skabs su nga tshor slob gso gtong ba'i tshul gyis— 216 —

da wad mtshanasmagagis bdas pa'i nga tsho/‘‘da nas khyod tsho de'i phyogs su ma rems/ slob chen du thon dus dngos su mgo rtsom rgyu byos’’zhes zer myong / skad cha 'di la bsam blo gtong dus/dge rgan de'i langs phyogs shes yong gi slob chen ni na gzhon pho mo zung gi brtse mthun gleng sa/ dga' rogs bsgrigs sa/ brtse dung gi me tog skyong sa zhig tu bsam/ dngos gnas/ slob chen nas rang brtsi rang spel gyi lugs srol drin chen zhig yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang dbang gi nam mkha' yangs ni red/ khyod kyis bud med 'dod pa btsal na/ a rag stobs kyis 'thung na a ro zer ni yod ni ma red/ 'on kyang / nga tshos lag pa brang khar bzhag nas rang sems la tsha 'dri nan mo zhig btang na 'grig mi mang shos thig slob chen du thog dang por yong dus kyang phal ba phal ba 'ig red/ mthar phyin khar yang grag med 'gul med cig byas nas 'gro gi 'dug 'di lta bus don ngo ma slob chen nas lo ngo bzhi ci bsam 'di bsam med par bskyal btang zig mi tshe'i bgrang bya ring mo'i nang gi lo ngo bzhi ci yin 'di yin med par tshar song zig 'di ltar nyi ma gtong thabs dang /thang ma skem thabs tsam gyis gser lta bu'i dus tshod rang dgar brlag god gings ni mi 'di dag gis lo rgyus shes kyin mi 'dug ces zer bzhin yod/ lo rgyus shes kyin mi 'dug pas/ rang re'i slob chen pa mang bo chang rag gi — 217 —

gleng stegs/bzhes rtsal 'gran mkhan/ brtse dung gi me tog gnyor mkhan tag tag tu gyur 'dug gal te nga tshos glegs bam dag gi ga/seb dang rdo ring dag gi ngos nas/ rang re'i mes po tshos rta mchog rgod po'i bang rtsal gyis e sha ya'i brang khog brdung ste 'dzam gling sum gnyis sa yi dkyil 'khor bdag tu bzung myong ba'i lo rgyus dran na/ rang nyid ci 'dra'i mi 'dra med cig bla bsgul zhig mig rdzob cig red ang zhes mi dran nam/ nga tshos nges par du de ltar dran dgos ki dran nas kyang rang sems la skul ma'i lcag 'debs dgos gi lo rgyus ma shes pas/ mi tsho'i sems na mi rigs kye la rgya dang rigs zhen/ 'gro ba mi'i thob thang rtsod pa'i 'du shes med song ba red/'du shes de nyams rmas su 'gro don yang nga tshor phyi nang gang rung gi bar chad dang shugs rkyen thebs pas red/ 'di yang khag med sa zhig yin mod/yang khag med zer bzhin 'dug mi nyan bi/ 'khum mi nyan gi gtso bo rang ngos nas yar langs dgos/ lag pa'i thag nye nas yar langs dgos giyar langs dgos zhes bshad na/ mi mang shos kyis rngam ston khrom skor dang drag po'i 'os langs lta bu zhig dran yong na thang mod/ des rang re lta bur mtshon na phan ci yang thogs ni ma red/ nus pa ci yang thon ni ma red/ nye char nga'i pha yul dang thag nye sa'i 'bo ra nas slob ma mang bos bod rang — 218 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/btsan zhes kha g.yang dang yi ge la lung du sbyar bar/ phyi'i nangs mor spyi bde cu'u dang nyen rtog khang gis slob ma tsho 'dzin bzung dang sa cha de bkag sdom byas byung / ltos dang / dmar po'i me mda'i srid dbang gi 'og nas/smyug thogs pa dag dag gis rgol lan sprod rgyu zer na ngo ma sgo nga brag thog du brgyab pa ma yin nam/ mi rigs kyi 'du shes shugs drags ldan pa dngos gnas dga' 'os pa dang rjes su yi rangs byed dgos sa red mod/ la rgya 'dzin tshul gyi thad nas/ thabs lam de 'dras go chod ni ma red/ gal te 'thab 'khrug cig langs rgyu yin na/ lus la khrab rmog gon/ lag tu me mda' bzung ste g.yul sar song zer rgyu na/ 'u tshos phar dgra bo zhig gsod thub rgyu e red/ thubru ni ma red/ me mda' bzung nas myi gsod lag dmar byed rgyu de 'u tsho'i las ka ma red/ smyug thogs par smyug thogs pa'i las ka yod ni red/ de dang de bzhin gyi mi rigs kyi la rgya skyong tshul dang bsam blo'i 'dzin stangs yod ni red/ mi re re bas da gzod mi rigs grub pa ji bzhin mi rigs kyi las don de yang / mi bu so so'i rang thad kyi hur brtson dang 'bad 'thab kyis grub pa red/ rang ngos nas hur brtson byed rgyu de da dung nga tshor mtshon na stong cha zhig du gyur 'dug de dang gan sogs la mi rigs kyi 'du shes drag po ldan pas nga lta bur mi rigs kyi 'du shes med — 219 —

gleng stegs/ kyang mi skyon zer rgyu 'dra/ kho dang kho sogs la tshang ma mi rigs kyi 'du shes ci yang med pas nga kho nar yod pas yod go mi chod sogs zer bzhin kha re g.yor/ khag re bzhag nas rang nyid dus nam yang rang 'gul can(rtsa7)du gtong rgyu med/ 'di ni bod mi re re ba'i gshis ka'i ngos na chags pa'i nad yams shig red/ nga tshor nges par du‘‘ngas mi rigs kyi las don ma bah+pheb na/ sus sgrub rgyu’’zhes pa'i snying stobs 'di shin tu mkho/nga tsho su yang skyes pa nas khyod mi rigs kyi las don bsgrub mkhan yin/khyod kyis ma bsgrubs kyang chog ces sus kyang kha tshon bcad med la rtags mtshan bkod med/ mi rigs kyi 'du shes dang rang rigs la sha tsha rgyu'i 'du shes ni nga tsho la nges par du mkho bas mi tshad nga tsho'i rus rkang dang sha khragabla srog lta bu yin/ slob chen slob ma kha shas shig la 'di lta bu'i 'du shes med/ kho tsho'i mdun du mi rigs kyi 'du shes bshad btang na/ ma go khul byas te rna cog 'gebs rgyu zhig tu gyur 'dug nga tsho'i mi rigs la spyir yang slob grwa chen mo ba nyung nyung las med/ yod pa tsho'i nang na yang mi rigs kyi mdun ljongs la bshol nas 'gro mkhan yod na/ 'angang rgyobs dang / nga tshos nam zhig bod mi sa ya drug po yar slong thub bam/ nga tshos nam zhig skya rengs gsar ba'i 'og gi nyi gzhon de rig thub bam/ slob chen slob ma mang — 220 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/bos rang nyid slob chen du yong don/ khang chung nang nas bsam gzhig btang ste mtha—ra khang chung nang nas bya ba bsgrub rgyu yin pa'i 'gan khur de tsam las mi rigs dang la rgya'i 'du shes sogs rang nyid dang thag ring sa ring sa zhisko tu gtad 'dug de ni sger sems che rgyu mang drags pa'i bya spyod cig red/ bag med bya rgyu mang drags pa'i byed stangs shig red/ mi rigs 'di dusmo sīn ring bor sa sgang ril mo 'di'i steng nas gnas thub na/ khyed kyang de'i phang ba nas 'tsho thub pa byung ba yin la/ gal te mi rigs 'di 'gal rkyen gang rung gis nyams rmas su bud song ba yin na/ khyod yang de dang gtan du/ dur 'jug byed song ba yin no/ /de bas mi rigs kyi las don la nga tsho ni khrag rgyun gcig 'brel yin la shi na mnyam shi dang gson na mnyam gson yin pas/ bdag gi slob grogs rnam pa/ ma yum bod pa tshang gi sku tshe khri lor brtan phyir nga tshos srog bsdos byed dgos/ de ring nas bzung / da nas bzung / (thal mo rdeb sgra)khro bu'i gtam bshad/grag 'gul med pa'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i nyen tshabs gleng ba las ngas bshad rgyu ni bod kyi slob chen pa'i‘‘'gan 'khri'i’’skor yin/— 221 —

gleng stegs/thog mar bsam blo gtong dgos sa zhig yod pa mi rigs so so'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab mi 'dra ba'i steng nas/ slob chen pa tsho'i phrag steng la babs pa'i 'gan 'khri yang 'dra ni ma red/ rgya mi rigs la mtshon na/dpal 'byor dang chab srid/ dmag don la sogs pa phyogs gang yin rung /las tshan re bgos yod pa 'u tshos mig lam du yod pa 'di red/ nga tshor rtsis rig dang dngos lugs rdzas 'gyur/ sa khams dang lo rgyus/ skye dngos sogs ched las zhig dmigs su 'dzin spyad kyi gzhung med pa 'di red/de'i rkyen/ rtsom rig tag tag gis mi rigs kyi bde sdug 'bri ba dang / mi rigs skyong thub pa byas yod ki da rung ngan pa'i rang bstod zer ba zhig yo/da pa ltar/ ri ra ba khang khyim la sogs par bstod pa byed pa dang / mi rigs 'dir lo rgyus kyi rgyun ring tshul/ rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa yod srol bshad nas rang gis rang la sems gso byas nas bsdad yod/ de'i dbang gis da lta bod kyi slob chen pa rnams kyi phrag la babs pa'i 'gan 'khri ha cang lci ni red/ rgya'i bshad tshul zhig la slob chen pa ni spyi tshogs kyi sne khrid pa yin zer ba ltar/ rang cag bod kyi slob chen panetshos bod spyi tshogs kyi dpung 'dren pa'i nus pa thon dgos 'dug①tshur len gyi snying stobs dgos pa/— 222 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/mi rigs gzhan gyi skad dang yi ges 'khyongs mi 'khyongs byas nas nga tsho la 'di yod de yod ces gzhan la bshad pa las/ spyi tshogs su mkho ba'i rig gnas phran tshegs re nang 'dren byed ci thub dang / lag len brgyud de'i dge mtshan blangs na bzang gi 'dod ki 'dir ngas bshad pa ni tshang ma gzhung lugs pa tag tag tu 'gyur dgos zhes pa min/ mi ya rabs spyod bzang zhig rang lam zin ni zhig bzang ngan shes ni zhig skyid sdug rtogs ni zhig yong ci thub byed rgyu de yin/ da rung rang tshugs yod ni zhig rang gzhan shes ni zhig gtso rnga4la phye shes ni zhig yong dgos/ 'u cag mi rigs la rang nyid rang gis skyong ba'i bsam blo zhig ye nas med ki dper na/ gsar bu sha rgyudar khrag rgyas re srang lam na sgor zur gcig gnyis re bslangs nas bsdad 'dug pa lta bu/ kho g.yog la bsdad na mi chog gam/gla re len thabs byas na deng gi spyi tshogs 'dir sgor mo nyung nyung re len thabs tag tag red/ nga tsho'i phyug po tsho yang rang rlom dang khengs dregs kyis rgyags 'dug de tsho mi rigs gzhan gyi phyug po tsho dang bsdur na ngo ma gzhan gyi zla yong rgyu ma red/ med po tsho'ang gzhan gyi med po dang gtan nas mi 'dra ki gzhan kyis thabs brgya jus stong gis ches ma mtha' yang rang gi kha gso rgyab 'geb la rang gis ngal rtsol byed ki yod ki snying stobs dang — 223 —

gleng stegs/yid ches/ sdug rus gtan nas med pa'i 'u tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i kha lo sgyur rgyu ni 'u cag mi rigs rang gi slob chen pa tsho'i phrag thog la ljid tig tig gis babs yod ki don chung chung 'di dang 'di 'dra ba tshang ma rang lugs kho na gnyer dgos don med ki gzhan gyi thabs dang bkod par rgyus lon byas nas rang gis lag len du bstar na chog chog red/()gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dgo pa/rang gi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas dngos po gang rung zhig gsar du thon chog dus kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun nas 'tsho ba'i rnam pa dang rol stangs mi 'dra ba yod chog ni red/ nga tsho'i pha mes tshos ri dwags kyi sha me la bsreg nas zos na/ da lta chu nang du btsos nas za ba dang / kho tsho'i gyon chas shing lo dang zas su shing tog zos na/ da lta gon pa sna tshogs dang zas rigs mang bo za ba sogs ni 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang dus rabs kyi 'gyur dang mthun pa'i gsar gtod red/ a phas phyug 'tsho na bu yang phyug rdzi/ a mas bzhon ma bzho na bu mo yang de'i rjes 'brangs na 'tsho ba de drang thig gcig gi snyom ngos nas nam yang 'phar thub rgyu ma red/ der bltas na/ khyod kyi mi rabs 'dir phyug 'tsho na/ bu'i ring la zhing rmo ba dang / tsha bo'i ring la tshong byed pa bcas bya ba sna tshogs su — 224 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho zhugs na nyams myong mang bo 'thob la/ rang nyid kyi ngos nas gsar gtod kyi cha zhig kyang yod ni red/ nga tshos nam yin rung gzhan gyis gsar gtod byas pa'i dngos po dag dang gzhan gyis bkol spyod byas tshar ba'i dngos po dag bed spyod byed bzhin pa mthong rgyu mang ba ma gtogs/ nga tshos gsar gtod byas pa'i dngos po zhig gzhan gyis longs su spyod bzhin pa mthong rgyu med ki nga tshos nam rgyun bsam pa ni gzhan ji ltar 'gro na nga yang de ltar 'gro thub na chog gi bsam pa las/ nga ni de dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs gzhan zhig snyeg dgos bsam gyi mi 'dug da rung nga tshos bsam gzhigs mang bo byas nas rang lam rang gis btsal ba'i snying stobs dang / rgyu dang dngos po bsam blo gang rung gi ngos thad nas gsar gtod kyi spobs pa skyed dgos kirjochos lugs pa dang 'jig rten pa'i dbye ba 'byed nus dgos pa/'jig rten pa 'tsho bar dmigs pa zhi/ga dang chos lugs pa 'khor ba 'dor mkhan zhig yin pa'i steng nas bsam na de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres thabs med gi chos lugs pas sems can thams cad la rang gi ma'i bsam pa 'dzin ni red zer gi ma gtogs ngas chos mi shes/ 'jig rten pa rang gi kha la za rgyu dang rgyab la gon rgyu'i ched du rgyug dgos ni red/ chos pa tshos slob ma che ge mo zhig gis cig cig zer gi ci yang shes ki med ki lta — 225 —

gleng stegs/log red zer gi 'dug rung / khyod kyis der kha ya byed mi dgos/ khyod kyis chos shes ni ma red/ chos ma sbyangs pa zhig gis ji ltar shes/ khyod kyis de la ngan mtshang dang skyon 'dogs byed dgos don yang med ki 'u tsho slob grwa ba tshos grwa ba che ge mo zhig gis cig cig byed god ki zer gi ma 'duga'ajig rten dor ba zhig gis 'jig rten shes ni ma red/ nga tshos rang gi kha la za rgyu dang rgyab la gon rgyu 'grig po zhig 'dzoms song na/ chos skyong rgyu'i 'gan yod ni ma red/ chos lugs pa tsho la'ang 'jig rten skyong rgyu'i 'gan yod ni ma red/ chos lugs pa yang min/ 'jig rten pa yang min na‘‘nga tshor sa min rdo min zer ba zhig yod pa’’de dang a na ma na red/ (dgod sgra)nga tshos gcig gis gcig la dgra ru 'dzin dgos don med ki rang lam re yod pa red ang / rjorang nyid ngos zin dgos pa/rang nyid la lhan skyes su grub pa yin na chog mi ru 'greng byed yin na chog mi bu rang nyid mtshon byed yin na chogre/ sger tshugs kyi bsam blo zhigre/ dang rang tshugs shig yod dgos/ de ring cig gis cig bshad na de 'grig ni 'dra 'dra/ sang nyin gzhan 'ig gis cig bshad na de yang 'grig ni 'dra 'dra/ don dngos su rang nyid la sger tshugs kyi bsam blo zhig gtan nas — 226 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/med pa'ang ha cang mang gi grong khyer che sa zhig nas mi gcig gis yin rung mi rigs la phan thogs pa yod la/ ming btsong yang gang mang red/dper na/ de+o ring 'gyur med(mi che ge mo zhig gi ming la go)kyis srang nas rdung res byas bzhag na/ srang gi mi tshang mas bod cig gis rdung res byas thal zer ba las/ 'gyur med kyis rdung res byas thal zer rgyu ma red/ slob grogs la las srang lam nas ngo tsha dgos pa'i don dag sna tshogs spel skabs/de 'dra ma byed/ ngo tsha spyad red ces tshe/ phyir nga su red zer/ sang nyin nas gzhan gyis nga rig rgyu ma red/ ngas gzhan rig rgyu ma red zer/ don dngos su khyod mi rigs de yin la/ mi rigs de khyod yin pa las dbye ba 'byed stangs med ki bsam blo yag po zhig bcangs nas mi rigs bsam pa'i na zug cig ngas bltas na nges par du sems la 'dzin dgos kigang ltar/ bod kyi slob chen pa'i sde 'di mi rigs rang gi kha mig yar lta byed sa yin pas/ nga tshos ci yang ma 'khyongs na nor lug gi rdzi bo tsho dang zhing tshigs nas 'jor dang lcags khem thogs pa tshos skyong yong zer rgyu yod ni ma red/ de bas 'dir 'dus pa'i slob grogs tshang ma rang rang gi ngos thad nas yar 'greng rgyu gal chen po red/ ngas bshad tshar song / (thal mo rdeb sgra)— 227 —

gleng stegs/sgren po'i gtam bshad/da gong nas rnam pa tshos re re bzhin slob grwa chen mo ba'i skad yig gi phyogs dang / 'gan 'khri'i skor/ 'du shes kyi skor bcas nas mang po gleng thal/ da ngas 'di ru bod kyi slob chen pa'i bsam blo'i snying stobs kyi skor bshad rgyu yin/ sngar bzhin do dgong ngas nga rang nyid khyer yong yod pa ma gtogs/ nang bstan gzhung lugs dang de las phan chad kyi mang po zhig nga lta bur mtshon na khyer nas yong rgyu med la/ nang bstan gzhung lugs bshad rgyu de ngas rang nyid kyi las ka min zer gyin yod/ grwa ba tshos bro 'khrab na nga tsho bod mi'i mdzes dpyod kyi snang ngor mi mdzes ka da de lta bu red/ (nyan pori dgod sgra)da 'u tsho gleng gzhi dngos la rkang 'dzugs pa la/ da lta'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba zhig yin na/ bsam blo ci lta bu zhig yod dgos ki zer na/ dang po/ rang nyid kyi skad cha rang nyid kyis 'chad thub pa'i bsam blo dang snying stobs dgos ki gna' nas da lta'i bar bod mi tshos rang nyid kyi myong bar gzhi mi bcol bar/ srol rgyun gyi bstan bcos la gzhi bcol ba'am khen yun ring ba'i mjug 'bras su/ bod 'dir kher tshugs can gyi mi ha cang — 228 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/nyung nyung yin pas/ da nas bzung nga tshos/ blun pos yon tan kha ru 'byin/ /mkhas pas yon tan khog tu sbed/ /ces pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bag chags 'di'i 'ching sgrog gtor dgos/ de dang po yin/gnyis pa ni/ gnas lugs kyi ched du margo mi sgur ba'i bsam blo dgos ki gnas lugs kyi sngun nas mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin dgos mod/nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di lta bur mtshon nas bshad na 'dra mnyam yong gi e yod king tshor rang nyid kyi bden lugs gal chen red dam yang na bla ma'i skad cha gal chen red/ bla sprul tsho'i skad cha'i sngun nas nga tsho'i gnas lugs la bden kha med ga bden lugs med sa na bran gshis ma gtogs med pas/nga tshos mdzub mos gang bstan shar/ /bla mas gang gsungs chos su 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bag chags 'di'i srog shing gtor dgos/ de gnyis pa yin/gsum pa yin na/ mi rigs rang gi gnas bab shes pa'i bsam blo dgos ki mi rigs kyi gnas bab zer na'ang 'dra/ lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs shes mkhan gyi slob chen pa zhig yin na/ 'gan 'khri'i khur bo ha cang lci ki gcig nas phyi'i dpal 'byor gyi gnon shugs dang / gnyis nas nang bsam blo'i 'thab rtsod kyi dbang gis/ nga tsho lta bur mtshon na lo rgyus kyi — 229 —

gleng stegs/dkyog mtshams na 'greng yod ki de bas nga tsho slob chen pa tshos gnad don 'dir 'dang mi rgyag rang rgyag tu gyur 'dug mi rabs 'dir mi rabs 'di'i 'gan khur yod ni red/ 'o na nga tsho'i 'gan khur gang red zer na/de ring gi lo rgyus 'bri rgyu de red/ 'u tsho dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i slob chen pa tsho ma gtogs 'bri ni yod ni ma red/ da lta'i bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba tshos rang rigs kyi gnas bab tshor gyin med ki de yang phyi dang nang gi rkyen mang po mang po zhig la rag las yod mod/ ches gtso bo ni ngas slob chen pa tshos bod rang gi lo rgyus dang lhag don stong char lus pa'i nye rabs lo rgyus ma shes pa'i stabs kyis red 'dod/ nye rabs lo rgyus steng byung ba'i dmag 'khrug dang / btsan 'dzul/ gnya' gnon/ me mda'i bo'u kha nas shor ba'i ya nga ba'i dmar gsod chen mo de'i lo rgyus kyi skyo gar snying gi bar khyams na bskyil yod mkhan zhig yin na/ gnas bab dang bstun nas na zug dang 'gan 'khri med sa mi 'gro ga nga tshos nam yin yang rang rigs kyi lo rgyus brjed mi nyan gi de gsum pa yin/bzhi pa yin na/ mi rigs kyi nyen tshabs la ma no bsam gtong shes pa'i bsam blo dgos ki ngas bsam na mi rigs 'di'i khongs mi phal mo che su yin yang rang nyid kyi mi rigs la sha tsha rgyu red/ yin na yang sha tsha shes mi — 230 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/shes gnyis ka yod ni red/ dper na/ nga tsho zhing grong gi pha ma tshos rang nyid kyi bu phrug la sha tsha nas slob grwar bskyal yod ni red/ 'on kyang kho tshos slob gso ma myangs pas/ sha tsha srol mi shes/ de dang gcig 'dra red/sha tsha tshul mi shes ka de dang gcig 'dra red/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i slob chen pa zhig yin na/ spyi tshogs kyi sne khrid pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes yod dgos par ma zad/ mi rigs 'di la sha tsha srol shes mkhan zhig yin na 'grig gi red/ gong gsal gyi 'di dag 'dzoms dgos na/ bsam blo'i go rtogs mthon po dgos ni red/ rig gnas gsar ba tshur len byed thub pa'i bsam blo dgos ni red/ da ngas skabs don gyi gleng bya bshad tshar song / gsham nas nga tsho tshang mas bgro gleng byed/ bgro gleng byed skabs rab yin na/ yar langs nas dri ba 'don rgyu ni nga tsho'i re ba yin/ (shog dril gyi ngos nas mi 'dri ba) nga tshor mtshon na 'di ni snying stobs sbyong brdar gyi go skabs dga' zhig red/ yang bskyar gsal bshad bya dgos rgyu zhig la/ do dgong ngas rang nyid dang rang nyid kyi snying stobs ma gtogs gang yang khyer yong med/ da ngas bshad tshar song / (thal mo rdeb sgra)mgo 'dzin pa gtsag 'big gi mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/

gleng stegs/slob grogs rnam pa/ gong nas nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi‘‘rang skyed myug tshogs’’kyis gtam bshad gnang ba'i〈grag 'gul med pa'i bod kyi slob chen pa'i nyen tshabs gleng ba〉zhes pa 'di ni ched du kha sang de ring gi bod kyi slob chen pa'i sde la gzas pa'i mi bshad thu med kyi mig snga'i gnad don zhig red/ kho tshos rang nyid kyi bsam gzhig byed stangs dang mi che'i lta tshul sogs re re bzhin mi bu rang thad nas gsong bor brjod 'dod pa'i nang sems kyi skad cha dag rang nyid dang ches nye sar bcar nas bshad don ni/grag 'gul med pa'i gnas bab 'dis kho bo cag 'dug thabs med par bzos byung la/ brel sems drag po zhig gi kun slong gis rgyu byas te/ rang nyid cho'i na chod dang bstun pa'i blo spobs kyi sgo nas rang nyid dang rang nyid kyi skud cha khyer te/ rang mos rang dbang gi gtam bshad 'di 'dra ba zhig spel ba yis 'dir 'dus kyi slob grogs tshang mar rang rang sa nas gzab nan gyis bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad don 'ga' bstan byung bar don snying ldan no snyam/ de bas na/ ngas 'di nas‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’kyi mgo 'dzin pa yongs kyi tshab byas te/ kho tshor snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu ba dang chabs cig kho cho bzhin rang nyid kyi snying stobs dang skad cha khyer nas‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’su zhugs te rig gnas bgro gleng gi rnam pa sngar ge 232 —

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho/las 'khrug cha dod cing phun sum tshogs pa'i phyogs su bskyod par re ba zhu'o/ /ya/ do dgong gi gtam bshad 'di nas mtshams 'jog rgyu yin/ da bde mo byos/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra dang 'ur sgra)mjug tu gsal bshad byed rgyu zhig la/thengs 'di'i nged tsho'i gtam bshad kyi mjug gi dri ba dang dris lan/da dung slob grogs skor zhig gis rang gi lta tshul bton pa sogs sgra phab pa mi gsal bas 'dir ma bkod/ rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ gzhan gyi bsam tshul dang skad char go nor thebs te 'chug skyon byung na mi 'grig par bsam nas 'dir bkod med par dgongs 'jags 'tshal/2 0 0〈 1 15 nyin sgra phab las yi ger bshus/

dgos dbang gi skad cha lhag ma de bshaṃd na/dgos dbang gi skad cha lhag ma re bshad na/da warang skyed smyug tshogs kyi lam gleng ba/〈mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho〉zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di'i ma rtsom cha tshang bris tshar la nye ba'i skabs 'dir/ dgos dbang gi skad cha lhag ma re'ang khyed cag klog pa po'i spyan sngar mi bstabs ka med byung / spyir na mi chen ga ge mos dpe deb khag gi mgo brjod dang mjug gtam bris yod pa'i bod khul gyi dpe deb khag gi skyugs ldad kyi rnam pa de dang / grags snyan dang ngoms so kho nar 'bad pa'i rtsom mkhan de'i rigs kyi ngo gdong la/ nga rang tsho zhe drag sun po byung yod na'ang / nga rang tsho tshogs pa zhig gi ngos nas sam yang na mi bu bzhi'i mnyam las kyi sgo nas deb chung 'di 'grub pa lags pas na/ mi bu bzhi bo dang 'brel ba'i rang skyed smyug tshogs kyi song — 234 ge

mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga cho/zin pa'i lam bur phyir dran zhig byed dgos byung /mi lo gsum yar sngon gyi ston kha'i dus tshigs der/ rang nyid las su la'ang yid ches bral ba'i gsar bu rang snang can bzhi/ phugs 'dun dang dga' kha 'khyer phyogs kyis gong bu gcig tu sbrel/ kho tsho ni rang skyed smyug tshogs kyi tshogs mi ste/ khro bu dpa' chen dang / sgren po ban+de skyabs/'dren byed a rig mkhas bzang / byams phrug ban+de mkhar bcas red/mi lo bzhi'i slob chen gyi 'tsho ba'i brel zing gi klong nas/ dga' zhen gyis kho rang tsho'i sems pa gcig tu bsres yod na'ang / kho tshos kho tsho rang sger dang 'tsham pa'i bsam gzhig gtong stangs shig chags par 'bad kyin yod pa las/ tshogs pa'i bsgrags gtam zhes pa lta bu'i mi'i rang mos dang rang dbang la 'bur 'joms gtong ba'i sna tshogs sgrig khrims la gtan nas dga' bo mi 'dug kho tsho ni rang mos dang rang dbang la spro/'di ltar tshogs pa 'di kho tsho'i mtho tshad kyis bsdad de/ 〈〈mtshan smag gis bdas pa'i nga tsho〉zhes pa'i pho gsar 'di dang 'grogs nas lam la chas byung / spyi lo nyis stong brgyad lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga la/— 235 —
